jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
Senior Project Manager | Utility-Scale Solar

We're looking for a Senior Project Manager who knows how to run a project like a business.
Not someone who just attends meetings, updates a schedule, and tells us everything is tracking.
We want someone who knows their numbers. Someone who understands self-perform construction and can look at labor, production, cost, schedule, and contract exposure and tell us where a project is going before it gets there.
At Enervia, our Senior PMs own the commercial and financial performance of utility-scale solar projects from turnover through closeout.
You'll have experienced Construction Managers and field leadership running the work in the field. Your job is to make sure the entire project performs.

What you'll own

Budget, forecasting, Cost-to-Complete, WIP, billing, and cash flow
Self-perform labor, production, productivity, and installed quantities
Contracts, change orders, RFIs, and commercial correspondence
Procurement, subcontractors, and major material coordination
Project schedules, risks, and recovery plans
Owner relationships and progress meetings
Change-order pricing, negotiation, and recovery
Ultimately: the financial and contractual success of your projects

Who we're looking for

You have experience managing utility-scale solar, heavy electrical, substation, or similar construction projects, and you've had real exposure to a self-performing contractor.
That part matters.
We don't simply subcontract the work and manage it from a spreadsheet. We put our own people and equipment in the field, which means our PMs need to understand production, labor productivity, quantities, equipment utilization, and how today's field performance affects tomorrow's forecast.
You should be comfortable with Excel, forecasting, production tracking, scheduling, contracts, and difficult conversations.
A degree isn't what will get our attention. Knowing how to build, lead, think ahead, and own the outcome will.

Where you'll work

We're flexible.
This position can be remote, provided you're willing to travel when the job requires it. That could mean our office, project sites, client meetings, or wherever you need to be to lead effectively.
We care a lot more about results than where your laptop happens to be sitting.

Why Enervia?

We're growing, we're ambitious, and we're building a company where talented people can have a meaningful impact without getting buried under layers of corporate bureaucracy.
If you're looking for a job where someone hands you a checklist and tells you exactly what to do every day, this probably isn't it.
If you want real ownership, direct access to leadership, challenging projects, and the opportunity to help build something, we should talk.

Come help us build Enervia.

Recruitment Notice: Enervia is not accepting inquiries, resumes, or candidate submissions from third-party recruiters or staffing agencies for this position. Unsolicited submissions will not be considered.

Job Title: Senior Project Manager (Construction)
Location: Full-Time Remote (LATAM)
Working Hours: Full-Time, Monday to Friday, 7:30 AM to 4:30 PM EST
Compensation: $2,000 - 2,500 USD per month (based on experience)

About The Company

Our client is a premier, New York-based exterior construction and restoration firm specializing in façade restoration, roofing, waterproofing, masonry, concrete, sidewalk replacement, and Local Law 11/FISP compliance projects. Having successfully completed 600+ exterior restoration projects across New York, including commercial, residential, historic, landmark, and New York State public works, they work closely with property owners, managers, architects, engineers, and municipal stakeholders.

About The Opportunity

With a growing team of nearly 60 internal office staff, field crews, and remote specialists,our client is expanding its operations. We are seeking an experienced Senior Project Manager to serve as a key operational leader, taking ownership of execution, building efficient processes, and helping drive scalable growth.

As Senior Project Manager, you will work directly alongside the Principal to oversee and streamline exterior construction and restoration projects from initial planning to final delivery.
You will act as a force multiplier; bringing strong operational organization, robust PM systems/tools, and refined delegation strategies to manage high-volume workloads.

This position is ideal for an experienced, proactive project manager who thrives in US-based construction environments, excels at managing complex cross-functional teams, and knows how to set up structure and project workflows that others can easily follow.

Key Responsibilities

Project Execution & Operational Leadership

Project Ownership: Manage multiple concurrent exterior construction and restoration projects (façade restoration, roofing, waterproofing, masonry, Local Law 11/FISP) from initiation through closeout.
Systems & Process Creation: Introduce, build out, and refine internal project management systems, tracking tools, workflows, and communication standards to optimize operational efficiency.
Team Delegation & Leadership: Delegate tasks effectively to remote team members and field crews to ensure accountability and balanced workloads.
Cross-Functional Coordination: Coordinate seamlessly between subcontractors, field site crews, superintendents, remote staff, vendors, clients, architects, and engineers.

Schedules, Budgets & Resource Management

Schedule & Timeline Management: Maintain detailed project schedules, track critical milestones, manage delays, and proactively clear operational bottlenecks.
Financial & Cost Tracking:Track budgets, change orders, procurement, and material deliveries to maintain project profitability and schedules.
Procurement & Logistics: Coordinate material shipments and field resources to ensure job sites have necessary equipment and supplies without interruption.

Compliance, Documentation & Stakeholder Management

Project Documentation: Oversee RFIs, submittals, permits, field reports, progress updates, change orders, and general project records.
Regulatory Compliance: Ensure projects meet NYC/NYS building codes, safety regulations, and public project standards.
Stakeholder Communication: Maintain clear, regular communication with property managers, NYC/NYS agency contacts, engineers, and internal leadership.

Must Have

Required Qualifications & Attributes

Experience: 5+ years of experience in construction project management, specifically managing US-based projects.
Industry Focus: Experience in exterior construction, façade restoration, roofing, waterproofing, masonry, concrete, or related specialty trades.
Leadership & Delegation: Proven ability to delegate effectively, establish PM processes/KPIs, and manage multi-disciplinary teams .
Systems Implementation: Openness to implementing or utilizing modern PM tools and platforms to create clear visibility across active projects.
Operational Process Improvement: Proven track record of taking unorganized project operations and establishing scalable systems, workflows, and transparent KPIs.
Communication: Exceptional written and spoken English communication skills; comfortable interacting with executive leadership, clients, engineers, and sub-contractors.
Work Ethic & Autonomy: Proactive, organized, and capable of operating independently without heavy supervision.

Nice to have: Standout Signals & Preferred Experience!

NYC / NYS Experience (Highly Desirable): Familiarity with NYC/NYS building codes, Local Law 11 / FISP, landmark guidelines, public works projects, and sidewalk shed/scaffolding setups.
Complex Exterior Scopes: Hands-on experience coordinating restoration projects involving scaffolding, sidewalk sheds, material hoisting, waterproofing, masonry, roofing, and structural repairs on landmark or high-rise buildings.
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Civil Engineering, Architecture, or equivalent practical industry experience preferred.
NYC Stakeholder Network: Established working relationships or previous experience collaborating with NYC architects, engineers, property managers, DOB inspectors, and contractors. (plus!)

jobs.title: Healthcare IT Workstream Project Manager
jobs.description:
As required by our governmental client, this position requires being a US Citizen AND must be able to obtain a Public Trust clearance ***

The Healthcare IT Workstream Project Manager manages an assigned workstream within the Indian Health Service (IHS) modernization program. This part of the program is migrating current patient data to a new Four Directions Warehouse environment to strengthen IHS access to accurate, timely, and usable patient information.

The Project Manager is responsible for planning, coordinating, executing, and reporting on their assigned workstream. This includes managing scope, schedule, risks, dependencies, resources, stakeholders, subcontractors, and delivery readiness. The role works closely with IHS stakeholders, technical teams, clinical and functional leads, data owners, vendors, and program leadership to ensure the workstream delivers aligned, high-quality outcomes that support the broader warehouse migration.

Compensation & Benefits

Estimated Starting Salary Range for Healthcare IT Workstream Project Manager
: $90,000 – $100,000

Pay commensurate with experience.

Full time benefits include Medical, Dental, Vision, 401K and other possible benefits as provided. Benefits are subject to change with or without notice.

Healthcare IT Workstream Project Manager Responsibilities Include

Manage an assigned workstream supporting migration of current patient data to the new Four Directions Warehouse for the IHS client.
Develop and maintain the workstream plan, schedule, milestones, dependencies, assumptions, risks, issues, decisions, and change-control documentation.
Coordinate workstream activities with program leadership and other technical, clinical, functional, data, integration, analytics, and site-deployment workstreams.
Support data-migration activities within the assigned workstream, including requirements definition, source-data assessment, mapping, transformation, validation, reconciliation, testing, cutover, and post-deployment stabilization, as applicable.
Coordinate with IHS stakeholders, clinical subject-matter experts, data owners, technical teams, subcontractors, and vendors to define priorities, resolve issues, and maintain delivery alignment.
Track workstream readiness and manage cross-workstream dependencies that affect the migration, integration, availability, quality, or use of current patient data in the new Four Directions Warehouse.
Establish and/or maintain workstream governance, including status reporting, RAID logs, decision logs, action-item tracking, and executive briefings.
Support data-quality and acceptance activities to verify that current patient data is complete, accurate, secure, available, and fit for intended clinical and operational use.
Facilitate workstream meetings, working sessions, readiness reviews, and stakeholder communications to drive timely decisions and accountability.
Support user acceptance testing, operational readiness, deployment planning, and post-implementation issue resolution for the assigned workstream.
Maintain program scope, schedule, and delivery commitments through disciplined risk, dependency, and change management.
Perform other duties as assigned.

Healthcare IT Workstream Project Manager Experience, Education, Skills, Abilities requested:

Required Qualifications

Active PMI Project Management Professional (PMP) certification is required and familiarity with both waterfall and agile delivery.
Experience managing a workstream or major functional area within a large, complex healthcare IT implementation, data modernization, or data-migration program.
Experience supporting patient-data, clinical-data, EHR, clinical data repository, data warehouse, data integration, or healthcare analytics initiatives.
Demonstrated experience managing workstream schedules, milestones, RAID logs, dependencies, change control, stakeholder communications, and executive status reporting.
Experience coordinating technical teams, clinical or functional stakeholders, data owners, vendors, and subcontractors in a multi-workstream environment.
Strong ability to communicate technical delivery status, risks, dependencies, and decisions to business and executive stakeholders.
U.S. citizenship, pass pre-employment qualifications of Cherokee Federal and must be able to obtain a Public Trust clearance through the Government.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience supporting IHS, tribal health, federal healthcare, or other government health programs.
Experience supporting patient-data migration, healthcare data warehouse implementation, clinical data repositories, data conversion, or data integration.
Knowledge of healthcare data standards and technologies relevant to the assigned workstream, such as HL7, FHIR, DICOM, ETL/ELT processes, APIs, clinical data models, or data-quality tools.
Experience with data validation, reconciliation, clinical/business acceptance, testing, deployment readiness, or cutover planning.
Experience supporting imaging, radiology, CT/X-ray, DICOM, clinical analytics, or other specialized healthcare data domains.
Experience supporting large EHR implementation, modernization, interoperability, or clinical systems integration programs.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, Architecture & Automation Deployment
jobs.description:
Job Description

Agilent is looking for a Senior Program Manager to lead the deployment of engineering tools, automation, and AI capabilities across our R&D organization. This role owns the full cycle from understanding what engineers actually need, to rolling out the tools and systems that meet that need, to making adoption stick. You will run internal voice-of-customer efforts with engineering teams across divisions, translate what you learn into deployment programs, and drive the systematization and execution that turns a new tool or capability into something engineers actually use day to day.

This role also runs the program management behind Agilent's cross-divisional automation initiatives, including coordination with our China Innovation Center on accelerated engineering projects. You will build and manage the program plans, governance, and reporting that keep divisional teams, the innovation hub, and the CTO office aligned as these initiatives scale.

This is a program leadership role built for someone who can move fluidly between listening to engineers, structuring a rollout plan, and running the execution discipline to deliver it. A systems engineering background is highly valued: understanding how engineering tools plug into the product development lifecycle and being able to speak credibly with engineering leads about technical workflows, will make you far more effective than program management experience alone.

Key Responsibilities

Voice of Customer and Tool Strategy

Run structured voice-of-customer efforts with engineering teams across divisions to understand where new tools, automation, or AI capabilities would have the most impact.
Synthesize findings into clear deployment priorities and business cases, partnering with engineering leadership to validate direction.
Stay current on emerging engineering tools and AI capabilities relevant to hardware and systems engineering workflows.

Architecture and AI Deployment

Own end-to-end deployment programs for architecture implementation and AI capabilities across the enterprise, from pilot through full rollout.
Drive systematization: turning a promising tool or pilot into a repeatable, well-governed capability that scales across divisions.
Partner with IT, engineering operations, and divisional leads to manage rollout logistics, training, and change management.
Track adoption and usage post-deployment, and course-correct programs that aren't landing.

Automation Program Execution

Lead program management for cross-divisional automation initiatives, including coordination with the China Innovation Center on accelerated engineering projects.
Build and run program plans, governance cadences, and status reporting that keep divisional teams, strategic marketing, and the hub aligned on scope and timing.
Manage cross-time zone program cadence with the China Innovation Center, keeping risks and dependencies visible to stakeholders.

Cross-Functional Governance and Reporting

Maintain a portfolio view across architecture and automation programs, including status, risks, resourcing, and timelines.
Partner with divisional program managers and engineering leads to resolve cross-program dependencies.
Report program health and key decisions to the CTO office and other senior stakeholders on a regular cadence.

Qualifications

10+ years of program or project management experience in a hardware/instrument R&D environment, including experience deploying tools, processes, or capabilities across engineering teams.
Systems engineering background or hands-on experience working within a systems engineering process strongly preferred.
Experience running voice-of-customer or internal stakeholder research efforts and translating findings into action.
Experience with engineering tool rollouts, digital transformation, or AI/automation adoption initiatives strongly preferred.
Experience running cross-divisional or multi-site programs, ideally including work with an offshore or globally distributed engineering team.

Required Skills And Competencies

Strong program and portfolio management fundamentals: scope, schedule, risk, and stakeholder management.
Comfort operating in a technical environment, able to hold credible conversations with engineering leads about systems-level and architecture workflows.
Skilled at running voice-of-customer processes and turning qualitative input into a structured plan.
Ability to build structure and process without slowing teams down, tuned to an engineering audience.
Strong cross-functional influence and communication, able to align divisional and hub stakeholders without direct authority.

Additional Details

This job has a full time weekly schedule. It includes the option to work remotely. Applications for this job will be accepted until at least September 22, 2026 or until the job is no longer posted.

The full-time equivalent pay range for this position is $179,931.00 - $315,300.00/yr plus eligibility for bonus, stock and benefits. Our pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. During the hiring process, a recruiter can share more about the specific pay range for a preferred location. Pay and benefit information by country are available at: https://careers.agilent.com/locations

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, Architecture & Automation Deployment
jobs.description:
Job Description

Agilent is looking for a Senior Program Manager to lead the deployment of engineering tools, automation, and AI capabilities across our R&D organization. This role owns the full cycle from understanding what engineers actually need, to rolling out the tools and systems that meet that need, to making adoption stick. You will run internal voice-of-customer efforts with engineering teams across divisions, translate what you learn into deployment programs, and drive the systematization and execution that turns a new tool or capability into something engineers actually use day to day.

This role also runs the program management behind Agilent's cross-divisional automation initiatives, including coordination with our China Innovation Center on accelerated engineering projects. You will build and manage the program plans, governance, and reporting that keep divisional teams, the innovation hub, and the CTO office aligned as these initiatives scale.

This is a program leadership role built for someone who can move fluidly between listening to engineers, structuring a rollout plan, and running the execution discipline to deliver it. A systems engineering background is highly valued: understanding how engineering tools plug into the product development lifecycle and being able to speak credibly with engineering leads about technical workflows, will make you far more effective than program management experience alone.

Key Responsibilities

Voice of Customer and Tool Strategy

Run structured voice-of-customer efforts with engineering teams across divisions to understand where new tools, automation, or AI capabilities would have the most impact.
Synthesize findings into clear deployment priorities and business cases, partnering with engineering leadership to validate direction.
Stay current on emerging engineering tools and AI capabilities relevant to hardware and systems engineering workflows.

Architecture and AI Deployment

Own end-to-end deployment programs for architecture implementation and AI capabilities across the enterprise, from pilot through full rollout.
Drive systematization: turning a promising tool or pilot into a repeatable, well-governed capability that scales across divisions.
Partner with IT, engineering operations, and divisional leads to manage rollout logistics, training, and change management.
Track adoption and usage post-deployment, and course-correct programs that aren't landing.

Automation Program Execution

Lead program management for cross-divisional automation initiatives, including coordination with the China Innovation Center on accelerated engineering projects.
Build and run program plans, governance cadences, and status reporting that keep divisional teams, strategic marketing, and the hub aligned on scope and timing.
Manage cross-time zone program cadence with the China Innovation Center, keeping risks and dependencies visible to stakeholders.

Cross-Functional Governance and Reporting

Maintain a portfolio view across architecture and automation programs, including status, risks, resourcing, and timelines.
Partner with divisional program managers and engineering leads to resolve cross-program dependencies.
Report program health and key decisions to the CTO office and other senior stakeholders on a regular cadence.

Qualifications

10+ years of program or project management experience in a hardware/instrument R&D environment, including experience deploying tools, processes, or capabilities across engineering teams.
Systems engineering background or hands-on experience working within a systems engineering process strongly preferred.
Experience running voice-of-customer or internal stakeholder research efforts and translating findings into action.
Experience with engineering tool rollouts, digital transformation, or AI/automation adoption initiatives strongly preferred.
Experience running cross-divisional or multi-site programs, ideally including work with an offshore or globally distributed engineering team.

Required Skills And Competencies

Strong program and portfolio management fundamentals: scope, schedule, risk, and stakeholder management.
Comfort operating in a technical environment, able to hold credible conversations with engineering leads about systems-level and architecture workflows.
Skilled at running voice-of-customer processes and turning qualitative input into a structured plan.
Ability to build structure and process without slowing teams down, tuned to an engineering audience.
Strong cross-functional influence and communication, able to align divisional and hub stakeholders without direct authority.

Additional Details

This job has a full time weekly schedule. It includes the option to work remotely. Applications for this job will be accepted until at least September 22, 2026 or until the job is no longer posted.

The full-time equivalent pay range for this position is $179,931.00 - $315,300.00/yr plus eligibility for bonus, stock and benefits. Our pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. jobs.title: Lead Partner Services Program Manager
jobs.description:
Your role at Dynatrace

Dynatrace partners deliver a growing share of the implementations that determine whether our customers realize value. The Partner Services Program gives us the frameworks to make that delivery consistent: the Partner Delivery Maturity Model, the Partner Delivery Enablement Framework, the Partner Delivery Toolkit, and the Services Endorsement Program.

This role owns operating them as a single governed system. You will own how Dynatrace assesses, certifies, and holds partners accountable for delivery quality worldwide. You decide what qualified looks like, you run the reviews that determine whether a partner has reached it, and you own the quality bar that protects our customers when we are not the ones in the room.

This is a build role inside an existing program. The frameworks are documented. Turning them into a repeatable, auditable, globally consistent operating system is the work.

Responsibilities

Certification and tiering:

Own the Partner Delivery Maturity Model as the single system of record for partner delivery capability, including the Entry, Growing, Proficient, and Advanced tier definitions
Run partner tier assessments and establish a re-certification cadence, so that a tier reflects current capability rather than a past achievement
Maintain the capacity and competency standards for each tier, including dedicated resource counts and role-based training and hands-on experience requirements
Serve as the decision authority on tier advancement, and communicate declines with a clear remediation path

Quality Governance

Operate the Services Endorsement Program: application intake, verification of customer-validated engagements in the trailing 18 months, and the Dynatrace-led delivery review
Own the pre-engagement and post-engagement quality review process and the partner quality audit cycle
Own the partner delivery health and quality gates currently in development, and take them to production
Hold partners to the 90% customer satisfaction commitment, and run the improvement plan process when they fall below it
Govern the Co-Delivery Rules of Engagement, adjudicating where a partner delivers independently, where ACE leads, and where ACE backfills competency gaps.

Program Architecture And Reporting

Maintain the Partner Delivery Enablement Framework and the Partner Delivery Toolkit as living assets, versioned and current with the platform
Define the post-sales RACI for engagements where partners are involved, resolving the handoff ambiguity that exists today across ACE, Enterprise Support Services, and Customer Success
Translate tier competency requirements into content specifications for Dynatrace University and Product Education, and for ACE where hands-on enablement is required. You define what a certified partner must be able to do. You do not build the curriculum.
Report partner delivery quality, tier distribution, and endorsement pipeline to Customer organization leadership on a standing cadence

Team

Lead a small team as the program scales, with initial focus on individual ownership and program build

Minimum Requirements

What will help you succeed

Six or more years in professional services, partner programs, or delivery quality, including two or more years owning a program with external accountability
Demonstrated ownership of a certification, accreditation, or partner competency framework, including the authority to grant and withhold status
Experience running quality assurance or audit processes against external delivery organizations
Track record of building program operating cadence from documented frameworks, not only executing an established one
Ability to hold a standard with a commercial partner while preserving the relationship

Preferred Requirements

Experience in observability, application performance monitoring, cloud infrastructure, or a comparable technical platform where implementation quality directly affects customer outcomes
Familiarity with global systems integrator and managed service provider delivery models
Background spanning both a vendor services organization and a partner or systems integrator delivery practice
Experience with learning management platforms and certification tooling
Comfort with delivery telemetry and building reporting that leadership can act on

Why you will love being a Dynatracer

Dynatrace is a leader in unified observability and security.
We provide a culture of excellence with competitive compensation packages designed to recognize and reward performance.
Our employees work with the largest cloud providers, including AWS, Microsoft, and Google Cloud, and other leading partners worldwide to create strategic alliances.
You'll get to work at the forefront of innovation with Dynatrace Intelligence—the industry's first agentic operations system. Bringing together deterministic and agentic AI, it helps teams understand what's happening, why it matters, and what to do next— automatically
Over 50% of the Fortune 100 companies are current customers of Dynatrace.

Compensation And Rewards

The base salary range for this role is $140K-$160K. When determining your salary, we consider your experience, skills, education, and work location.
Our total compensation package includes unlimited personal time off, an employee stock purchase plan, and a reward system.
We also offer medical/dental benefits and a company-matched 401(k) plan for retirement.

Equal Employment Opportunity

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

We offer competitive compensation, company-sponsored premium benefits, medical, dental, vacation/holidays, company matching 401(k) Plan, etc. Dynatrace is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. jobs.description:
About Arketa

Arketa is building the operating system for modern fitness and wellness. Our mission is to make wellness more accessible by empowering studios and wellness entrepreneurs to grow beyond in-person classes. We provide a powerful, all-in-one platform to manage and scale hybrid wellness businesses, whether online, in-person, or both.

With Arketa, studios can manage schedules, accept bookings and payments, build on-demand video libraries, host retreats, run automated marketing, and launch fully branded apps and websites. We make it simple for founders to deliver a seamless, professional experience across every customer touchpoint. We've raised $15M in Series A funding and are growing quickly. It's a unique moment to join us. We're building a category-defining company in a fast-moving space, and we're looking for a leader who is excited to help shape what world-class partner support looks like in the wellness category.

About The Role

We're looking for an Embedded Payroll Program Manager to own the strategy, process design, and success metrics behind Arketa's new embedded payroll offering — and to be a direct point of support for our partners. Day-to-day onboarding and support execution belongs to the Implementation Account Manager and Payroll Specialist, but you'll stay personally connected to partners, especially on the more complex or highest-touch relationships, while designing the playbooks the rest of the team executes against, owning the relationship with our payroll infrastructure partner and managing the two roles below.

What You'll Do:

Program Strategy & Process Design

Design the onboarding playbook, support triage process, and escalation paths, in partnership with the Implementation Account Manager and Payroll Specialist
Define the handoff criteria between onboarding and ongoing support, and refine it as volume and the team grow
Build the documentation and Help Center foundations the rest of the team executes against
Own the roadmap and priorities for the payroll offering's customer-facing operations

Metrics & Reporting

Define and track key metrics: time-to-launch, onboarding capacity, support resolution time, support volume per customer, CSAT, and documentation coverage
Own the reporting cadence to leadership on how the payroll offering is performing operationally

Partner Support

Serve as a senior point of contact for Arketa's payroll partners, especially on complex, escalated, or strategic relationships
Step in directly on partner issues that need program-level context or cross-functional pull
Build direct partner relationships that inform how onboarding and support processes should evolve

Team & Stakeholder Management

Manage and coach the Implementation Account Manager and Payroll Specialist, and unblock escalations they can't resolve on their own
Manage the relationship with our payroll provider, and coordinate with engineering, compliance, and customer success to keep implementations and support on track
Translate recurring customer pain points into feedback for Product and Engineering

What success looks like:

New customers launch on time with minimal friction, and support questions get resolved quickly and accurately
Clear documentation exists for both onboarding and support workflows
Partners feel a direct, senior point of contact is available for their more complex or high-stakes needs
The Implementation Account Manager and Payroll Specialist have what they need to execute independently day to day, with you focused on strategy, metrics, partner relationships, and escalations
A well-reasoned, evolving plan for how the onboarding/support handoff should work as volume grows

What we're looking for:

3-5+ years in program/project management, implementation, or customer-facing operations leadership, ideally at a fintech, HR tech, or payroll company
Experience designing processes and playbooks for a customer-facing function, ideally from scratch
People management experience, or strong readiness to manage a small team, preferred
Strong communication skills — you'll be explaining payroll mechanics to non-experts and translating customer pain points to internal teams
Ability to operate with ambiguity; this role and its scope will evolve
Experience with payroll, benefits, or embedded financial products is a strong plus

What we offer:

Ownership and Opportunity for Advancement
Competitive Salary and Stock Options
Unlimited PTO: our policy is designed to give you the flexibility to rest, recharge, and take care of personal needs — while staying aligned with your team and responsibilities.
Medical, dental and vision health insurance
Fitness Class Reimbursement: we’re committed to supporting both employee wellness and our industry relationships. As an Arketa employee we see movement as opportunity.
Parental Leave Policy

For this role, the estimated annual base salary is up to $100,000- $140,000, depending on experience and qualifications. In addition to base pay, we offer equity. We believe in compensating fairly and transparently, and we’re happy to provide more detail during the interview process.

jobs.description:
Join the People Helping People

Velera is the nation’s premier payments credit union service organization (CUSO) and an integrated fintech solutions provider. The company serves more than 4,000 financial institutions throughout North America, operating with velocity to help our clients keep pace with the rapid momentum of change and fuel growth in the new era of financial services. Our purpose: We accelerate partners’ success through innovative financial technology solutions and inspired service.

The Opportunity

The Risk Intelligence Program Manager
is responsible for identifying, prioritizing, coordinating, and advancing analysis initiatives across the Risk organization. This role serves as the primary liaison between business stakeholders within Risk Services, internal Data Science and Technology teams, and external AI vendor partners to ensure AI solutions deliver measurable business value while aligning with organizational goals, governance standards, and risk requirements.

The position will work closely with Risk, Product, Operations, Technology, and Data Science resources to develop and maintain an AI opportunity roadmap spanning both Machine Learning and Generative AI capabilities. The role is focused on business outcomes, use-case management, and solution delivery rather than hands-on model development.

Day In The Life

AI Strategy & Roadmap Management

Develop and maintain an opportunity backlog and roadmap for Risk Services through the lens of AI
Partner with business leaders within and outside of Risk to identify opportunities where AI can improve operational efficiency, reduce risk, enhance decision-making, or generate new business value for Risk Services.
Evaluate and prioritize AI initiatives based on business impact, feasibility, data availability, regulatory considerations, resource capacity, and probability of approval.
Establish success metrics and performance indicators for AI initiatives.

Vendor & Partner Coordination

Coordinate delivery activities, requirements, testing, implementation planning, and ongoing performance reviews.
Monitor vendor commitments, deliverables, project timelines, and expected business outcomes.
Facilitate communication between external partners and internal stakeholders.

Internal Data Science Partnership

Act as the primary business interface to internal Data Science and AI development teams.
Translate business objectives into clear requirements, user stories, and use cases in cooperation with Data Science.
Coordinate prioritization and scheduling of AI development efforts within Risk Services.
Assist in validating that delivered solutions meet documented business requirements.

AI Governance & Risk Coordination

Ensure AI initiatives follow established governance, compliance, risk management, and security requirements, as prescribed by the Velera AI Council.
Participate in AI intake, review, and approval processes.
Collaborate with Risk, Legal, Compliance, and Information Security teams as required.
Support documentation gathering related to AI models, decisioning logic, and business processes to support Audit and explainability to clients.
Research, evaluate, and pilot innovative AI, machine learning, and risk management technologies to identify opportunities for enhancing Risk Services capabilities, operational efficiency, and fraud prevention outcomes.

Business Enablement & Adoption

Promote awareness and adoption of AI capabilities across Risk Services.
Assist teams with identifying opportunities to improve existing AI solutions.
Develop business cases, presentations, executive updates, and performance reporting.
Monitor benefits realization and recommend enhancements to existing models and AI workflows.
Perform other duties as assigned

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Finance, Risk Management, Engineering, or a related field.
Professional certifications in project management, business analysis, data analytics, AI governance, or related disciplines are preferred (e.g., PMP, CBAP, Agile, AI governance-related certifications).
6+ years of experience leading or supporting analytics, artificial intelligence, machine learning, data science, or related business transformation initiatives, including responsibility for stakeholder coordination, requirements development, prioritization, and solution delivery.
5+ years of experience working with AI governance, model risk management, responsible AI principles, AI regulatory considerations, explainability, auditability, or technology governance frameworks within a regulated industry or financial services environment.
Knowledge of Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Generative AI, and emerging AI technologies, including their business applications, capabilities, limitations, and risks.
Understanding of fraud prevention, risk management, payments, lending, or related operational environments.
Ability to identify, evaluate, prioritize, and manage a portfolio of AI opportunities based on business value, risk, feasibility, and organizational readiness.
Ability to translate business objectives into clear requirements, use cases, user stories, success metrics, and implementation plans for Data Science and Technology Delivery teams.
Strong program and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives, competing priorities, and complex stakeholder relationships.
Ability to communicate effectively with business stakeholders, technical teams, and third-party vendors.
Ability to develop business cases, roadmap updates, status reporting, and performance metrics.
Knowledge of data governance concepts including data quality, lineage, privacy, security, and lifecycle management.
Strong analytical, organizational, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
Proficiency with standard business productivity, reporting, visualization, and collaboration tools.

26WD101205, Technical Program Manager , AI/ML

Position Overview

The Platform Services and Emerging Technologies (PSET) team is seeking a Technical Program Manager (TPM) to drive successful delivery of Autodesk's Generative AI Accelerator (GAIA) outcomes.

In this role, you will drive complex, cross-functional programs that move emerging AI capabilities from research into production. You will partner closely with research, engineering, architecture, data, security, legal, and product leadership so that new AI capabilities are delivered responsibly, predictably, and at scale.

This role requires strong technical depth including AI fluency, excellent execution discipline, and the ability to operate effectively across organizations to align priorities, manage risk, and drive outcomes in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.

Responsibilities

Drive end-to-end delivery of GAIA program outcomes, from experimentation through production readiness and adoption
Drive the business outcomes realized through delivery of AI/ML capabilities, partnering with engineering teams and leadership across product integration, platform adoption, and operational scalability
Build and maintain integrated delivery plans across research and engineering teams, ensuring clear milestones, dependencies, and risk management
Drive delivery forecasting, execution tracking, and transparent reporting across program lifecycles
Orchestrate delivery across research, engineering, security, legal, product, and platform teams, following changes downstream to everything they touch
Partner with executive stakeholders, architects, and product leaders to shape strategy, sequencing, and execution plans
Provide clear, actionable status reporting at both executive and team levels, including risks, tradeoffs, and mitigation strategies
Anticipate dependencies and risks rather than discover them, across data, model readiness, and delivery timelines
Support teams with impediment removal, exception handling, and dependency resolution
Use approved AI tools and automation responsibly to create visibility, repeatability, and a single source of truth across delivery, while validating outputs and maintaining human judgment
Champion Agile and Lean delivery practices, supporting self-organizing teams operating in complex environments
Use evidence and validated learning to adapt plans, improving delivery effectiveness, collaboration, and program outcomes
Act as a change agent, helping teams navigate evolving requirements, research uncertainty, and platform priorities

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field

Experience delivering AI/ML, Generative AI, data platform, or research-to-production programs

Understanding of Responsible AI, data governance, privacy, and compliance concepts
Passion for operational excellence, process improvement, and scalable delivery practices

26WD101205 Responsable de programme technique, IA/ML

Aperçu du Poste

L'équipe « Platform Services and Emerging Technologies » (PSET) recherche un responsable de programme technique (TPM) chargé de piloter la mise en œuvre réussie des résultats du programme « Generative AI Accelerator » (GAIA) d'Autodesk.

À ce poste, vous piloterez des programmes complexes et transversaux visant à faire passer les capacités émergentes en IA de la recherche à la production. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les responsables de la recherche, de l’ingénierie, de l’architecture, des données, de la sécurité, des affaires juridiques et des produits afin de garantir que les nouvelles capacités d’IA soient mises en œuvre de manière responsable, prévisible et à grande échelle.

Ce poste exige de solides connaissances techniques, notamment une maîtrise approfondie de l’IA, une excellente discipline d’exécution et la capacité à intervenir efficacement au sein de différentes structures organisationnelles pour aligner les priorités, gérer les risques et obtenir des résultats dans des environnements ambigus et en constante évolution.

Responsabilités

Piloter la mise en œuvre de bout en bout des résultats du programme GAIA, de l’expérimentation à la mise en production et à l’adoption
Piloter les résultats commerciaux obtenus grâce à la mise en œuvre des capacités d’IA/ML, en partenariat avec les équipes d’ingénierie et les responsables dans les domaines de l’intégration des produits, de l’adoption de la plateforme et de l’évolutivité opérationnelle
Élaborer et maintenir des plans de mise en œuvre intégrés entre les équipes de recherche et d’ingénierie, en garantissant la clarté des jalons, des dépendances et de la gestion des risques
Piloter les prévisions de mise en œuvre, le suivi de l’exécution et le reporting transparent tout au long du cycle de vie des programmes
Orchestrer la mise en œuvre entre les équipes de recherche, d’ingénierie, de sécurité, juridiques, produit et de plateforme, en suivant les répercussions en aval sur tout ce qu’elles touchent
Collaborer avec les parties prenantes de la direction, les architectes et les responsables produit pour définir la stratégie, l’enchaînement des étapes et les plans d’exécution
Fournir des rapports d’état clairs et exploitables tant au niveau de la direction qu’au niveau des équipes, incluant les risques, les compromis et les stratégies d’atténuation
Anticiper les dépendances et les risques plutôt que de les découvrir a posteriori, qu’il s’agisse des données, de l’état de préparation des modèles ou des délais de mise en œuvre
Soutenir les équipes en éliminant les obstacles, en gérant les exceptions et en résolvant les dépendances
Utiliser de manière responsable les outils d’IA et d’automatisation approuvés pour garantir la visibilité, la reproductibilité et une source unique de vérité tout au long de la livraison, tout en validant les résultats et en préservant le jugement humain
Promouvoir les pratiques de livraison Agile et Lean, en soutenant les équipes auto-organisées évoluant dans des environnements complexes
S’appuyer sur des données factuelles et des enseignements validés pour adapter les plans, améliorant ainsi l’efficacité de la livraison, la collaboration et les résultats du programme
Agir en tant qu’agent du changement, en aidant les équipes à s’adapter à l’évolution des exigences, aux incertitudes liées à la recherche et aux priorités de la plateforme

Excellentes compétences en communication et en gestion des parties prenantes, avec la capacité d’influencer des publics tant techniques que non techniques
Solides compétences en résolution de problèmes, avec une orientation vers l’action et les résultats

Qualifications Souhaitées

Compréhension des concepts de responsabilité en matière d’IA, de gouvernance des données, de confidentialité et de conformité

jobs.title: Research Program Manager/Portfolio Specialist
jobs.description:
Job Description

The Hoover Institution
seeks a Research Program Manager/Portfolio Specialist
to support and operationally energize the policy and research agenda of the Technology and Manufacturing Leadership (TML) team, a new Hoover program operating within the Commons Initiative.

TML is focused on producing research and reality-based, actionable outputs dedicated to how the US and its allies and partners can maintain technology and manufacturing leadership. TML’s research agenda centers on identifying and exploring opportunities to advance innovation and production capability across several industrial sectors. TML will consider how to deploy strategic capitalism and a whole-of-nation approach to technological transformation, how to forge deeper cooperation with democratic nations to implement, and how to assess and activate the full stack of factors that contribute to the ability to make complex products. Several workstreams are being developed, including semiconductors, industrial biomanufacturing, and advanced manufacturing, as well as research tools that drive technological innovation.

The Research Program Manager/Portfolio Specialist role is to develop, implement, and administer the vision, strategy, and goals of the team’s portfolio. The program is in its ramp-up phase. Ideal candidates are self-directed, organized, and accountable in dynamic, highly collaborative environments. Positivity, resilience under pressure, and strong problem-solving skills are essential. The role requires someone who brings consistent energy and humility to the team. Program management experience, strong writing skills and budget oversight are preferred but not required. Competence in visual display tools and tech literacy is an asset. Expertise in adjacent domains—political science, economics, law, engineering—is equally welcome with demonstrated willingness to learn the technology landscape.

Studies have shown that people from certain backgrounds are less likely to apply for jobs unless they believe they can perform every job description task. We are most interested in finding the best candidate for the job, and that candidate may come from a less traditional background. We may consider an equivalent combination of knowledge, skills, education, and experience to meet minimum qualifications. If you are interested in applying, we encourage you to think broadly about your background and skill set for the role.

The position is not a research position, but an operational role.

A cover letter and resume are required for full consideration.

This position is a two-year fixed term contract.

WORK ARRANGEMENT:
This position will be based on the Stanford campus and may be considered for an option of one or two day/week telecommuting (hybrid of working on-site and off-site), subject to operational need.

CORE DUTIES*:

Develop and manage the program operations associated with scheduling, organizing, and operating.
Manage program activities, including outreach to varied stakeholders within the program, assigning resources and making program improvement recommendations that impact policies and programs.
Manage public programs from inception through completion, including speaker and participant coordination, logistics, budgeting, and related activities; oversee research efforts and evaluate programs; and collect and analyze data to assess effectiveness and support recommendations for improvement.
Write and/or edit complex content for newsletters, email communications, policy reports, peer-reviewed publications, proposals, research grants, fundraising and other program outputs.
Monitor program expenses, budgets, and finances, and make recommendations on funding based on program spending.
Source, collect and analyze data; review and explain trends; identify and recommend new collaboration opportunities; formulate and evaluate alternative solutions and/or recommendations to achieve the goals of the program or function.
Coach and mentor program staff, including student research assistants.

Preferred/Desired Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

Able to work comfortably with frontier technologies subject matter and industrial manufacturing themes.
Capable of managing, completing, and shipping complex and high-consequence projects and work products on time.
Able to support and prepare principles for meetings, briefings, hearings, or discussions .

Working Conditions

May work extended hours, evenings or weekends.
May be asked to travel locally, nationally, and internationally.
Occasional overnight travel.

Responsibilities

Core Duties
:

Oversee and administer research activities by evaluating academic programs, making recommendations that impact policies and programs, and coordinating and implementing changes.
Collect and analyze data, create reports, review and explain trends to determine program effectiveness; formulate and evaluate alternative solutions and/or recommendations to achieve the goals of the program.
Teach and/or assist in the teaching and administration of courses. Create and/or advise in the development of curriculum. Make recommendations for course improvements.

jobs.description:
Job Description:

Remitly is on a mission to transform the lives of immigrants and their families by providing the most trusted financial products and services on the planet. Since 2011, we have been tirelessly delivering on our promises to immigrants sending their hard-earned money home. Today, we are reimagining international payments at scale and building new products to create deeper relationships with our customers and their loved ones across the globe. Join over 2,700 employees across 10 offices who are growing their careers while having a positive impact on people globally.

As a Senior Program Manager, Technical for Multiproduct / New Initiatives at Remitly, you will contribute to the success of new products (Remitly Card and Recipients experiences), new customer segments, by leading a team of Program Managers and Program Specialists, effectively designing and landing a CS experience that allows product teams to reach PMF faster and that is built from day one to scale through automation and AI rather than through headcount.

You will work closely with senior stakeholders advising on CS and Operations best practices, documenting and communicating program performance, and maintaining policies and procedures in partnership with Compliance, Legal, Global CS Operations, and Product teams related to multiproduct domains.

You have experience leading teams with a program and operational background, and a successful history of building new programs from scratch with little to no documentation, by leveraging quantitative and qualitative insights that enable your teams to improve the product and the customer experience.

You Will:

Lead a team of Program Manager and Program Specialist that support New Initiatives across Remitly Business, Remitly Card, Receivers and Freelancers, and Stored Value.
Operationalize multiproduct consumer support policies, including process handling and monitoring of new product features. This includes developing case-handling tools and automation with Customer Success Technology and Product teams, and ensuring we are always compliant with handling and monitoring requirements.
Operationalize consumer policies by designing standard operating procedures (SOPs) and collaborating with Customer Success Technology teams to augment our case-handling capabilities for new products and markets on CS Platform.
Ensure operational compliance adherence and monitoring criteria that reduce new product risk exposure.
Design programs to be self-driving. Apply the principle that AI augments, humans judge: AI removes the repetitive work so that when a customer needs a real person, they get one, and you are explicit about where a human must stay in the loop.
Use AI tools habitually in your own program work, deep dives, contact-driver analysis, SOP and knowledge generation, readiness plans, reporting and raise the bar for how your team works, not just what it ships.
Maintain documentation for all Multiproduct initiatives, projects, and new send-market launches.
Oversee and define project scope, objectives, and deliverables in alignment with business goals.
Lead Product–CS insight-sharing sessions with clear findings and learnings highlighted by Program Specialists.
Provide feedback on deep dives and data analysis projects.
Develop project plans tailored to accelerated learnings that feed our product pipeline and create a differentiated customer experience.
Oversee all coordination between teams for project planning and launch.
Product (IDV / Compliance / Sanctions) > Expansion > CST > CS Platform > CS Operations
Develop customer success launch readiness plans to ensure adherence to launch timelines.
Create and maintain mechanisms for measuring impact and performance on a per-project basis.
Lead your team to become subject-matter experts across financial services domains including banking, cards, lending, and small business payments.
Develop a prioritization pipeline program framework for your team that maximizes ROI and customer impact.
Stakeholder and communication management.
Proactively partner with relevant stakeholders to accomplish the program roadmap.
Provide stakeholder updates through metric reviews and goal updates on an ad hoc basis depending on the scope of the project.
Serve as the escalation point for all internal stakeholders for all things related to Multiproduct.
Partner directly with Multiproduct Operations on upcoming initiatives and overall operational requirements.
In the future: Support for new products and features (Card lending expansion including EWA, Secured Card and Unsecured Card; Remitly Business liquidity, cash management and credit; Receiver and Freelancer partnerships), global expansion of the Remitly Global Card beyond the US, expansion to additional send markets, and support for additional projects and initiatives that need CS and Ops support including migration of New Initiatives programs onto new systems and platforms.

You Have:

A relevant Bachelor’s degree.
At least 1 year of experience as a manager of managers in Operations or CS in the banking or financial services industry.
Proven experience a Program/Project Manager, with expertise across cards, lending, banking, or small business payments.
Familiarity with regulatory requirements and compliance frameworks in the financial services industry — MSB, AML, KYC and adjacent operations.

SiriusXM and its brands (Pandora, SiriusXM Media, AdsWizz, Simplecast, and SiriusXM Connect) are leading a new era of audio entertainment and services by delivering the most compelling subscription and ad-supported audio entertainment experience for listeners -- in the car, at home, and anywhere on the go with connected devices. This is the place where a diverse group of emerging talent and legends alike come to share authentic and purposeful songs, stories, sounds and insights through some of the best programming and technology in the world. Our critically-acclaimed, industry-leading audio entertainment encompasses music, sports, comedy, news, talk, live events, and podcasting. No matter their individual role, each of our employees plays a vital part in bringing SiriusXM’s vision to life every day.

SiriusXM Media
is the gateway for marketers to the largest digital audio advertising ecosystem in North America, spanning owned and operated platforms, innovative ad tech solutions powered by AdsWizz, and an extended content network reaching more than 150 million listeners each month.

AdsWizz
, a subsidiary of SiriusXM, is the leading global provider of digital audio and podcast advertising solutions, operating in over 40 countries and connecting buyers and sellers through dynamic ad insertion, advanced programmatic platforms, and innovative audio formats.

How You’ll Make An Impact

As a strategic and adaptable Staff Technical Program Manager, Ad Technology, you will own the strategy and delivery of large-scale, cross-organizational initiatives across Ads Engineering. This role is critical to driving execution of high-impact programs spanning ad-serving systems, data platforms, monetization workflows, and cross-program integrations with Pandora and broader SiriusXM systems.

This is a senior individual contributor role requiring deep architectural literacy, systems thinking, and the ability to define program strategy — not simply execute against it. You will partner directly with engineering and product leadership to shape multi-year roadmaps, co-own program strategy, streamline org-wide governance, and deliver outcomes that materially impact platform scalability, monetization performance, and global platform capabilities to deliver outcomes that make an unmistakable enterprise-level impact across: scalability targets, RTB latency/SLA, fill rate, yield/monetization lift, reliability, and global rollout readiness. This includes leading multi-year, cross-functional programs such as global ad-serving modernization, real-time bidding (RTB) latency/scale programs, and technical consolidation across the Pandora and SiriusXM ad technology stacks.

What You’ll Do

Enterprise Program Strategy & Delivery

Establish and own the strategy and end-to-end delivery of large, cross-organizational Ads Engineering initiatives (eg: broadcast ads digitization and modernization, ad insertion, consolidation across SiriusXM and Pandora tech stacks), from intake through launch.
Function as Workstream lead for select cross-organizational initiatives spanning multiple engineering teams - from planning through launch.
Maintain roadmap and delivery commitments for multiple teams within the Ad Technology organization, aligning Product, Engineering and GTM on execution plans, ROIs and outcomes (e.g., latency/SLAs, yield/monetization lift, reliability, rollout readiness).

26WD101205, Technical Program Manager , AI/ML

Position Overview

The Platform Services and Emerging Technologies (PSET) team is seeking a Technical Program Manager (TPM) to drive successful delivery of Autodesk's Generative AI Accelerator (GAIA) outcomes.

In this role, you will drive complex, cross-functional programs that move emerging AI capabilities from research into production. You will partner closely with research, engineering, architecture, data, security, legal, and product leadership so that new AI capabilities are delivered responsibly, predictably, and at scale.

This role requires strong technical depth including AI fluency, excellent execution discipline, and the ability to operate effectively across organizations to align priorities, manage risk, and drive outcomes in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.

Responsibilities

Drive end-to-end delivery of GAIA program outcomes, from experimentation through production readiness and adoption
Drive the business outcomes realized through delivery of AI/ML capabilities, partnering with engineering teams and leadership across product integration, platform adoption, and operational scalability
Build and maintain integrated delivery plans across research and engineering teams, ensuring clear milestones, dependencies, and risk management
Drive delivery forecasting, execution tracking, and transparent reporting across program lifecycles
Orchestrate delivery across research, engineering, security, legal, product, and platform teams, following changes downstream to everything they touch
Partner with executive stakeholders, architects, and product leaders to shape strategy, sequencing, and execution plans
Provide clear, actionable status reporting at both executive and team levels, including risks, tradeoffs, and mitigation strategies
Anticipate dependencies and risks rather than discover them, across data, model readiness, and delivery timelines
Support teams with impediment removal, exception handling, and dependency resolution
Use approved AI tools and automation responsibly to create visibility, repeatability, and a single source of truth across delivery, while validating outputs and maintaining human judgment
Champion Agile and Lean delivery practices, supporting self-organizing teams operating in complex environments
Use evidence and validated learning to adapt plans, improving delivery effectiveness, collaboration, and program outcomes
Act as a change agent, helping teams navigate evolving requirements, research uncertainty, and platform priorities

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field
5+ years of experience delivering complex, cross-team initiatives in fast-paced technical environments
3+ years in a TPM, Product Manager, Software Architect, or similar role
Strong understanding of cloud platforms and distributed systems, including APIs and services on AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud
Working knowledge of AI/ML concepts and the software development lifecycle, including how AI-assisted tools are used in delivery
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence across technical and non-technical audiences
Strong problem-solving skills with a bias toward action and outcomes

Preferred Qualifications

Experience delivering AI/ML, Generative AI, data platform, or research-to-production programs
Familiarity with AI systems such as model training and evaluation, inference and serving, or retrieval and vector databases
Understanding of Responsible AI, data governance, privacy, and compliance concepts
Passion for operational excellence, process improvement, and scalable delivery practices

26WD101205 Responsable de programme technique, IA/ML

Aperçu du Poste

L'équipe « Platform Services and Emerging Technologies » (PSET) recherche un responsable de programme technique (TPM) chargé de piloter la mise en œuvre réussie des résultats du programme « Generative AI Accelerator » (GAIA) d'Autodesk.

À ce poste, vous piloterez des programmes complexes et transversaux visant à faire passer les capacités émergentes en IA de la recherche à la production. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les responsables de la recherche, de l’ingénierie, de l’architecture, des données, de la sécurité, des affaires juridiques et des produits afin de garantir que les nouvelles capacités d’IA soient mises en œuvre de manière responsable, prévisible et à grande échelle.

Ce poste exige de solides connaissances techniques, notamment une maîtrise approfondie de l’IA, une excellente discipline d’exécution et la capacité à intervenir efficacement au sein de différentes structures organisationnelles pour aligner les priorités, gérer les risques et obtenir des résultats dans des environnements ambigus et en constante évolution.

Responsabilités

Piloter la mise en œuvre de bout en bout des résultats du programme GAIA, de l’expérimentation à la mise en production et à l’adoption
Piloter les résultats commerciaux obtenus grâce à la mise en œuvre des capacités d’IA/ML, en partenariat avec les équipes d’ingénierie et les responsables dans les domaines de l’intégration des produits, de l’adoption de la plateforme et de l’évolutivité opérationnelle
Élaborer et maintenir des plans de mise en œuvre intégrés entre les équipes de recherche et d’ingénierie, en garantissant la clarté des jalons, des dépendances et de la gestion des risques
Piloter les prévisions de mise en œuvre, le suivi de l’exécution et le reporting transparent tout au long du cycle de vie des programmes
Orchestrer la mise en œuvre entre les équipes de recherche, d’ingénierie, de sécurité, juridiques, produit et de plateforme, en suivant les répercussions en aval sur tout ce qu’elles touchent
Collaborer avec les parties prenantes de la direction, les architectes et les responsables produit pour définir la stratégie, l’enchaînement des étapes et les plans d’exécution
Fournir des rapports d’état clairs et exploitables tant au niveau de la direction qu’au niveau des équipes, incluant les risques, les compromis et les stratégies d’atténuation
Anticiper les dépendances et les risques plutôt que de les découvrir a posteriori, qu’il s’agisse des données, de l’état de préparation des modèles ou des délais de mise en œuvre
Soutenir les équipes en éliminant les obstacles, en gérant les exceptions et en résolvant les dépendances
Utiliser de manière responsable les outils d’IA et d’automatisation approuvés pour garantir la visibilité, la reproductibilité et une source unique de vérité tout au long de la livraison, tout en validant les résultats et en préservant le jugement humain
Promouvoir les pratiques de livraison Agile et Lean, en soutenant les équipes auto-organisées évoluant dans des environnements complexes
S’appuyer sur des données factuelles et des enseignements validés pour adapter les plans, améliorant ainsi l’efficacité de la livraison, la collaboration et les résultats du programme
Agir en tant qu’agent du changement, en aidant les équipes à s’adapter à l’évolution des exigences, aux incertitudes liées à la recherche et aux priorités de la plateforme

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
Our client, a leader in the interactive gaming industry, is looking for an experienced Delivery Manager / Technical Program Manager to support teams focused on Technical Operations (TechOps) and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) for game infrastructure.

This is a highly cross-functional role combining elements of Technical Project Management, Scrum Master leadership, and Product Ownership. You will be responsible for helping two technical teams deliver against quarterly commitments, maintain effective Agile processes, manage priorities and dependencies, and translate stakeholder needs into actionable work.

The ideal candidate comes from an infrastructure, operations, SRE, or similar technical environment and is comfortable working closely with engineering, product, platform, networking, security, and other technical teams. Strong knowledge of Jira workflows and automations is especially important.

Key Responsibilities

Own delivery of multiple initiatives in alignment with product roadmaps and quarterly commitments.
Partner with Product and Engineering leaders to define, document, and communicate quarterly scope, schedules, priorities, and key milestones based on team capacity.
Track committed work through completion and ensure action items are assigned to the appropriate teams.
Identify delivery risks, develop mitigation plans, and proactively drive resolution of blockers and dependencies.
Manage scope changes during the quarter, including coordinating and documenting formal change requests when commitments shift.
Coordinate cross-project dependencies, milestones, releases, and launch activities with other Delivery Managers and technical teams.
Lead Agile ceremonies and ensure Scrum practices are consistently and effectively followed.
Coach teams on Agile and Scrum principles, self-management, planning, and continuous improvement.
Own and maintain Sprint Backlogs in Jira, ensuring priorities and commitments remain clear.
Gather and clarify requirements from studios, stakeholders, and technical teams, particularly for SRE and game infrastructure initiatives.
Prioritize backlog items based on business needs, technical dependencies, and available team capacity.
Help manage competing stakeholder requests and push back appropriately when demand exceeds team capacity.
Facilitate triage of incoming customer and operational tickets through ServiceNow.
Support incident-management processes, including tracking postmortem action items and ensuring follow-up work reaches the appropriate teams.
Establish and coordinate release and launch communications.
Provide program-level performance reporting, delivery visibility, and status updates to internal and external leadership.
Identify and lead process improvements that increase team productivity, predictability, and operational effectiveness.
Help maintain strong communication, collaboration, and team morale across geographically distributed teams.

Must-Have Requirements

8–10 years of relevant experience in technical program management, project management, delivery management, or related roles.
Strong experience managing quarterly commitments, delivery timelines, scope changes, risks, dependencies, and mitigation plans.
Hands-on experience functioning as a Scrum Master and Product Owner, including:

-Running Agile ceremonies.
-Managing and prioritizing backlogs.
-Gathering and refining requirements.
-Balancing stakeholder requests against team capacity.
Strong working knowledge of Jira, including an understanding of how Jira automations operate:

-Triggers, conditions, and actions.
-Automated ticket creation and routing.
-The operational impact of modifying automation logic.
-Understanding that changes to automation rules may affect newly created work differently from existing tickets.
Experience working in an IT infrastructure, Technical Operations, SRE, platform, or production operations environment.
Understanding of:

-Incident management and incident response.
-Postmortems and follow-up action items.
-On-call or operational support processes.
-Observability concepts, including metrics, logging, and alerting.
-Patch and operational change processes.
Experience coordinating work across multiple technical functions such as platform, infrastructure, networking, data, TechOps, and security.
Strong ability to interact with, influence, and align stakeholders at different organizational levels and drive consensus.
Demonstrated experience with strategic planning, facilitation, and presenting information to leadership.
Experience with Jira, Confluence, Google Workspace, and flowcharting/collaboration tools such as Miro, Visio, or Lucidchart.
Must be based in Mexico and able to work primarily during Eastern Time business hours.
Comfortable receiving occasional after-hours communications related to operational incidents.

Strongly Preferred

Experience leading process improvements, rather than solely maintaining established processes.
Familiarity with the setup or use of AI agents within workflow or collaboration platforms, such as Atlassian Rovo or comparable tools.
Experience supporting multiple products, platforms, or technical environments concurrently rather than working exclusively within a single application or team.
Understanding of release and launch management in environments with significant infrastructure and operational dependencies.

Nice to Have

Experience in the video game industry, game production, or technology supporting game development.
Familiarity with both single-player and multiplayer game infrastructure.
Experience supporting infrastructure or operational needs across multiple game titles or studios.
Knowledge of SDK-related development or delivery environments.
Familiarity with ITIL principles or practices.
Bachelor's degree (BA/BS) in a relevant field.
Relevant certifications such as:

-CSPO – Certified Scrum Product Owner
-CSM – Certified ScrumMaster
-PMP – Project Management Professional
-SAFe certification

What Makes Someone Successful in This Role

This role is best suited for someone who is comfortable wearing multiple hats. You should be able to move between program delivery, Agile leadership, product ownership, stakeholder management, and technical operations without losing sight of execution.
The strongest candidates will combine a solid understanding of infrastructure and operational environments with excellent organizational skills and practical knowledge of Jira workflows and automations. This is not a traditional software feature-development PM role—the focus is on keeping complex technical and operational programs organized, predictable, and moving forward.

The Technical Program Manager (TPM) will lead the end-to-end execution of complex technical program or supporting project/workstream within Tata Electronics, serving as the primary bridge between product development, manufacturing, supply chain, quality, and customer teams. This role is responsible for driving planning, execution, risk management, and operational readiness from concept through mass production, ensuring products are delivered on schedule, within budget, and at the highest quality standards.
The TPM will work cross-functionally with internal teams, customers, and ODM/OEM partners to align technical requirements with manufacturing capabilities, resolve program challenges, and drive continuous improvement. The ideal candidate possesses strong technical acumen, exceptional program management skills, and history of success in mechanics and FATP success enabling successful delivery of large-scale consumer electronics programs in a fast-paced environment.

Responsibilities

• Lead the end-to-end execution of technical programs related to high-performance electronics product, parts, components, and modules.

• Excellent program management skills with the ability to manage complex cross-functional projects.

• Proven track record of successfully delivering large-scale technical programs from concept to production.
• Experience working with OEM/ODM partners and driving manufacturing process improvements.

Coordinate functional discovery, solution design, testing, deployment, release planning, and operational readiness activities.
Work closely with Solution Architects and Functional Leads to ensure business requirements are effectively translated into ServiceNow solutions.
Monitor project health, identify risks early, and implement mitigation strategies to support successful delivery.

Coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT), deployment readiness assessments, and go-live planning activities.
Collaborate with functional teams to ensure training materials, communications, and user enablement activities are effectively executed.
Support service transition and early life support activities following production deployment.
Help clients realize value adoption through structured project governance and stakeholder engagement.

Establish and maintain project governance standards, delivery methodologies, and reporting practices.
Monitor key project performance indicators and provide regular project reporting to clients and leadership teams.
Identify opportunities to improve delivery processes, project controls, governance frameworks, and implementation methodologies.

You demonstrate BDO's core values through all aspects of your work: Integrity, Respect, and Collaboration.

Experience leading ServiceNow implementation, enhancement, upgrade, or transformation initiatives.

Experience managing project scope, budgets, resources, timelines, risks, and stakeholder expectations.

Strong understanding of ITIL principles and service management best practices.
Proven experience managing cross-functional teams across business and technical environments.
Experience supporting ServiceNow platform transitions from legacy service management solutions.
Strong facilitation, leadership, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
Experience working directly with executive, operational, and technical stakeholders.
Exposure to AI-enabled service management capabilities including workflow automation, intelligent routing, self-service, and digital service experiences.

Experience with enterprise service management, service operations, and large-scale technology transformation programs.
