jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description:
Together we are Trusted to Serve Scotland.

How’s this for job satisfaction?

At Scottish Water, we look after Scotland’s most precious natural resource. From source to tap, we’re safeguarding Scotland’s reputation for refreshingly pure water and caring for our environment at the same time. If making a positive difference to people, communities and the environment sounds like something you'd enjoy, we'd love to hear from you.

What You’ll Do

As part of the ICC Business Support Team, you'll play a key role in supporting Project Compass and Scottish Water's wider transformation programme, helping maximise the value of our Data Lakehouse, telemetry data, and operational information assets. The role will focus heavily on data analysis, business intelligence, automation, and performance insight generation to support operational excellence across the business.

Working closely with the ICC Management Team to support our stakeholders across Scottish Water, you'll collect, analyse, and interpret large and complex datasets from a variety of operational, customer, and asset management systems. Using advanced analytical techniques and modern data tools, you'll transform raw data into meaningful insights that support evidence-based decision-making and drive measurable business improvements.

A major part of the role will involve designing, developing, and maintaining dashboards, reports, and automated solutions using technologies such as Power BI, SQL, Python, and Power Automate to implement workflows. You'll identify trends, patterns, risks, and opportunities within operational data, providing actionable recommendations that improve performance, efficiency, resilience, and customer outcomes.

You'll use Lean and Agile principles to identify opportunities for process improvement, reduce inefficiencies, and enhance operational performance. By supporting continuous improvement initiatives and promoting flexible, iterative ways of working, you'll help ensure work is delivered efficiently, responds effectively to changing priorities, and consistently provides value for customers and stakeholders.

You'll lead analytical investigations into emerging operational issues, support root cause analysis activities, and develop innovative solutions that help the ICC move from reactive reporting towards proactive and predictive decision-making.

In addition, you'll support and deliver continuous improvement projects from concept through to implementation, ensuring benefits are clearly measured and realised. You'll work collaboratively with stakeholders across multiple business areas, helping develop data-driven cultures and promoting best practice in reporting, automation, and business intelligence.

The successful candidate will become a key contributor to Scottish Water's growing use of data, analytics, and digital technology, helping unlock the full potential of our Data Lakehouse and supporting the delivery of strategic business objectives

What You’ll Need

We're looking for a highly analytical individual who is passionate about data and enjoys solving complex business problems through technology and insight.

You should have experience working with large datasets and a strong understanding of data analysis, reporting, and business intelligence techniques. You'll be comfortable using data to identify trends, challenge assumptions, and provide evidence-based recommendations to stakeholders at all levels.

You'll have strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience using SQL to extract, manipulate and analyse data, and Python to develop analytical solutions that deliver actionable insights. You'll be confident creating reports and dashboards in Power BI, as well as building workflows and process automations using Power Automate. A strong understanding of data management, data quality and reporting principles is essential, alongside the ability to communicate complex technical information clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

You'll have experience gathering business requirements and translating them into effective reporting and automation solutions. Experience working with Data Lakehouse, data warehousing or cloud-based data platforms would be advantageous, as would knowledge of process mapping and business process improvement methodologies. Familiarity with SharePoint and the wider Microsoft Power Platform, ISO and other operational management frameworks, and experience supporting transformation, operational improvement or digital change programmes would also be beneficial. An understanding of Lean and Agile principles, with the ability to support continuous improvement and the efficient delivery of business value, is also desirable.

Most importantly, we're looking for someone who is curious, innovative, and driven by using data and technology to solve problems and improve business performance.

Looking out for you

While the work we do is important, we know it’s not the only thing that matters. That’s why we make sure you have everything you need to find a good work-life balance.

But you’ll get plenty of time to recharge with 38 days of holiday every year (including public holidays). And you can even buy five more if you need a little extra time. You can also take paid time off to volunteer in your community.

When it comes to major life events we have family-friendly policies around adoption, maternity, and parental leave. And for the everyday? We embrace flexible working.

For your future, there’s our pension (the ‘know-what-you’ll-get-when-you-retire’ kind), as well as life assurance.

As for some nice extras? You will participate in a company bonus scheme. Not to mention access to SW Splash – handy rewards that can save you money on holidays, bills, and shopping.  

The not-so-small print

This role will be a Grade 6. If you’re new to Scottish Water, you’ll join us on a starting salary of £37,815. Performance-driven pay progression would then allow you to move through the range to a maximum of £48,395.

If you’re interested in this role – or know someone else who might be - we’ll be accepting applications until midnight
on the 29th September 2026

Please note: the successful candidate will need to undertake enhanced security checks prior to starting.

Job offers at Scottish Water are conditional, and will be confirmed on completion of our pre-employment screening, e.g. referencing, criminal record checks, license checks, etc. Screening is conducted on our behalf by a third party, and must be completed before your start date. Don’t worry - we’ll only start these checks once you’ve accepted an offer. 

A few final things worth knowing…

Research shows that some people avoid applying for jobs unless they can meet every single criteria. If you’re interested in this job, but don’t tick all the boxes, apply anyway! We hardly ever hire people who can do every part of a job from Day One. Everyone has a learning curve. So don’t rule yourself out!

Let us know if there are any changes we can make to our recruitment process to help you perform at your best. Lots of our people have disabilities or neurodiverse conditions (including some of our recruiters!). We're also aware that some people might be experiencing temporary challenges because of life events, like menopause. We’re very used to making adjustments, so please don’t be afraid to ask.

As part of our commitment to developing a flourishing Scotland, it’s important that all our employees are Scottish taxpayers. If you join us, your home address will need to be in Scotland. If you don’t already live here, you'll need to commit to moving here within your first three months.

Candidates should be aware that a valid UK driving licence is required for driving on Scottish Water business and claiming business mileage expenses.

Please note, Scottish Water takes the safety, health and wellbeing of our employees, colleagues and customers very seriously and as such you may be subject to Drug & Alcohol testing in line with our policy.

Finally (finally!), candidates who haven’t submitted an application in the last 12 months will have their records removed from our recruitment database. You won’t need to do anything. Your data will be automatically deleted.

We’re here to help. Ask us anything at SWRecruitment@ScottishWater.co.uk

Before we get to the role, here is a look at who we are and what we are building. Understanding the platform matters for this position, so we have included a short briefing below.

𝐖𝐇𝐘 𝐖𝐄'𝐑𝐄 𝐇𝐈𝐑𝐈𝐍𝐆
Job-Hopper is growing. After launching in 2026, the platform has been gaining steady traction and helping a growing number of job seekers get where they want to go. To keep that momentum, we are expanding our team and looking for a Data Analyst to help us turn a growing pool of data into sharper insight and a stronger product.

𝐖𝐇𝐀𝐓 𝐒𝐄𝐓𝐒 𝐉𝐎𝐁-𝐇𝐎𝐏𝐏𝐄𝐑 𝐀𝐏𝐀𝐑𝐓
Job-Hopper is not another job board. It is a candidate-centric platform built for one purpose: to give job seekers a real strategic advantage in their search.

To understand what makes it different, it helps to understand how the rest of the industry works. Legacy job boards are funded by employers. Their revenue comes from companies paying to post openings, so their platforms are built to serve those companies - cutting clutter and saving hiring teams time, while pushing the hard work and frustration onto the job seeker. They are free to apply on, but that is precisely the problem. Reaching the interview stage has become daunting. These boards are crowded with ghost jobs, stale postings, and outright fake listings designed to harvest applicant data.

We hear it every day. Job seekers are spending more time and energy than ever with less to show for it: hours of scrolling and applying, hundreds of submissions, and often not even a call back.

The established recruiting professionals behind Job-Hopper heard this same story from candidate after candidate. Many were strong applicants the traditional recruiting model simply could not place. That gap is what led to Job-Hopper. Development began in early 2025, the platform came to life late that year with the help of many stakeholders, and after an initial launch in 2026 it has been gaining traction and helping job seekers ever since.

𝐇𝐎𝐖 𝐉𝐎𝐁-𝐇𝐎𝐏𝐏𝐄𝐑 𝐖𝐎𝐑𝐊𝐒
Job-Hopper starts with the candidate, not the employer. When a user builds their profile, our proprietary AI engine goes to work around the clock. It scans the internet for job postings from every source and vets each one for recency, legitimacy, and quality. When a posting looks off, the engine throws it out.

Once a listing clears that filter, Job-Hopper matches the best opportunities to each user's profile in real time. Instead of scrolling through endless postings, users are notified the moment a strong match becomes available. The searching and vetting happen in the background, so the candidate can focus only on the opportunities that actually fit.

𝐓𝐇𝐄 𝐓𝐎𝐎𝐋𝐒 𝐓𝐇𝐀𝐓 𝐆𝐈𝐕𝐄 𝐂𝐀𝐍𝐃𝐈𝐃𝐀𝐓𝐄𝐒 𝐀𝐍 𝐄𝐃𝐆𝐄
Once a match is found, a user can apply in a single click, or reach for the enterprise-grade tools that set Job-Hopper apart:

- 𝐑𝐞𝐬𝐮𝐦𝐞 𝐞𝐧𝐡𝐚𝐧𝐜𝐞𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭 that tailors a candidate's resume to the specifications of each role, helping them stand out.
- 𝐀 𝐬𝐩𝐨𝐧𝐬𝐨𝐫𝐬𝐡𝐢𝐩 𝐟𝐢𝐥𝐭𝐞𝐫 that shows only roles offering H1B visa sponsorship, saving sponsorship seekers countless hours applying to jobs they were never eligible for.
- 𝐈𝐧𝐭𝐞𝐫𝐯𝐢𝐞𝐰 𝐩𝐫𝐞𝐩𝐚𝐫𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧, including mock interview questions and coaching that help candidates walk in ready.
- 𝐇𝐢𝐫𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐜𝐨𝐧𝐭𝐚𝐜𝐭 𝐢𝐧𝐬𝐢𝐠𝐡𝐭𝐬, one of our most valued features. Our AI engine identifies the actual hiring manager behind a posting and surfaces their contact details, including name, title, phone, and email. It can even draft a professional outreach email to introduce the candidate directly, skipping the pile of 200 resumes and going straight to the source.

Match quality is shown through clear percentage-based match scores, so candidates always know how well an opportunity fits before they invest their time. Job-Hopper supports job seekers across technology, manufacturing, analytics, engineering, and beyond, whether they are landing a first role, changing jobs, or advancing an established career. This is the platform we have built, and which you would help us build upon and improve to help more job seekers.

About The Team

Dow Jones Energy delivers trusted price transparency, benchmarks, analytics, news, and insights across the global energy, chemicals, metals, and fuel supply value chains. Our offerings support institutional investors, analysts, and traders navigating spot, wholesale, and retail markets, as well as emerging segments tied to the global energy transition.

Through authoritative data, real-time intelligence, and deep market expertise, Dow Jones Energy enables financial professionals to mitigate risk and make high-stakes commercial decisions in volatile, fast-evolving global markets.

About The Role

This is an exciting time to join our small but growing Commercial Product Management team where you will be supporting a number of key sectors including: Energy & Feedstocks, Coal, Metals and Mining, Renewables & Clean Energy and Chemicals.

We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Senior Data Analyst to support business performance, revenue management, customer analytics, sales operations, product strategy, and executive decision-making. The position requires a combination of advanced Excel, SQL, Python, business intelligence, financial analysis, data visualization, and strong business judgment.

You will work across large and complex datasets to develop reporting, dashboards, analytical models, and actionable insights for product and leadership teams. You are comfortable working independently on ambiguous analytical problems, reconciling data from multiple sources, automating recurring processes, and communicating findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You will also serve as a key analytical partner to the Product, Sales, Finance, Customer Care, Consulting, and leadership teams. You will report to the Vice President - Product Management.

You Will

Commercial & Revenue Optimization: Own end-to-end reporting for the Book of Business (ACV, renewals, new business, win/loss), building bottoms-up financial models, scenario analyses, and churn diagnostics to drive pricing, budgeting, and revenue retention strategies
Advanced Data Engineering & SQL: Query, transform, and aggregate complex datasets across multiple source systems using optimized SQL to resolve data discrepancies and ensure unified, cross-system reporting integrity
Data Quality & Governance: Establish rigorous validation processes, data cleansing protocols, and repeatable quality assurance checks to maintain accuracy and reliability across all core business metrics
Business Intelligence & Dashboards: Design and maintain scalable, user-friendly Power BI/Looker Studio dashboards that deliver actionable visibility into product performance, sales activity, customer health, and financial KPIs for non-technical stakeholders
Process Automation & AI Integration: Streamline recurring workflows using SQL, Python, Excel/VBA, and Power Query, while exploring AI/BigQuery solutions to scale self-service analytics and reduce manual reporting dependencies
Customer & Usage Behavioral Analytics: Synthesize product adoption, API/web activity, and usage data into customer health scores and engagement metrics that empower Sales and Account Management teams to mitigate churn Risk
Product Portfolio Strategy: Conduct product performance and entitlement analyses to evaluate pricing packages, support new product launches, and inform portfolio optimization or sunsetting initiatives
Cross-Functional Stakeholder Partnership: Serve as a strategic analytics partner across Sales, Finance, Product, and executive leadership, effectively communicating complex methodologies and managing ad-hoc analytical priorities to guide business decisions

jobs.title: Operations Analyst (Power Generation) - Memphis
jobs.description:
SpaceXAI’s mission is to create AI systems that can accurately understand the universe and aid humanity in its pursuit of knowledge.  Our team is small, highly motivated, and focused on engineering excellence. This organization is for individuals who appreciate challenging themselves and thrive on curiosity. We operate with a flat organizational structure. All employees are expected to be hands-on and to contribute directly to the company’s mission. Leadership is given to those who show initiative and consistently deliver excellence. Work ethic and strong prioritization skills are important. All employees are expected to have strong communication skills. They should be able to concisely and accurately share knowledge with their teammates.
ABOUT THE ROLE:

As a member of the power generation operations team, you will apply your knowledge, experience, and creativity to turn plant data into decisions. This role supports the site director with insights that improve how the power plant runs, including generation performance, fuel use, downstream demand, maintenance planning, and environmental compliance. If you like strategic planning, juggling many different priorities, improving processes, and spending your time in a dynamic work environment, then this team may be for you. This role will report directly to the site director and serve as a resource across plant operations.  
RESPONSIBILITIES:

Create and integrate AI tools to support analytics and execution planning. Create AI agents that can aid in oversight and quickly flag the onset of an issue or outage  

Develop visual standards for work boards, JIRA queuing, Power BI dashboards, and plant operations workflow  

Define and develop plant-level metrics and dashboards that quantify operational health and influence change, including gas vs MW, hall demand vs generation, maintenance forecast, and air permit hours  

Support the site director with data insights for plant operations, outage planning, and continuous improvement  

Conduct in-depth analyses through SQL queries and other data analysis methods to dive into problems and identify trends for decision making, following the rules of clear visual indicators and linear flow  

Create reports, tools, and standardized metrics for operational measurements and improvements  

Integrate with operations, maintenance, engineering, and environmental teams to understand current workflows and identify systematic gaps  

Support department continuous improvement projects such as new process rollouts and standardization  

Develop automation that mitigates operational risk or creates efficiencies within the power plant  

Conduct operations audits that streamline plant operations, maintenance, and reliability work  

Maintenance program enhancement – increase attention on poor-health equipment and descope unnecessary work  

Implement operations or maintenance tools (software or hardware) to reduce wasted effort by engineers, operators, and technicians  

Analyze site services and plant support contracts such as utilities, waste, and related services, and roadmap improvements to ensure smart spending  

Build communication tools and reports targeted at the site director and plant leadership to improve decision-making and customer service to downstream loads  

Standardize material, spare parts, and procurement processes to reduce outage and project lead times  

Drive alignment with power generation and operations teams at other SpaceX sites to reduce duplicated work  

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

Bachelor's degree in engineering, business, supply chain, management information systems, computer science, or economics  

2+ years of experience in an operations, data analytics, consulting, production coordination, scheduling, or planning role  

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

4+ years of professional experience  

Process focused experience including project management, capacity modeling, process mapping, and layouts  

Experience with operations, maintenance, and capacity planning (including CMMS, MRP, or ERP systems)  

Experience in using Excel, VBA, SQL, or Python/R for analysis or modeling dynamic systems  

Experience with creating and managing dashboards using data visualization tools using Power BI  

Familiarity with power plant or industrial operations metrics such as heat rate / gas vs MW, generation vs demand, maintenance forecasting, and environmental or air-permit tracking  

Experience with lean, six sigma, and related operations principles  

Ability to work well across teams and skill sets to find the simplest and best solution  

Experience as a contributor to multi-disciplinary and cross-functional teams

jobs.description:
Overview

The Senior Business Intelligence Analyst works with all levels of the organization to turn data into clear, compelling stories that drive business decisions. This position primarily builds Power BI reports and Power Platform Power Apps using data from MFA Oil's data lakehouse, with a strong emphasis on understanding the business behind the numbers and communicating insights in a way that resonates with leadership and end users. This role also contributes to the design and building of data marts in the gold layer and partners with the business to guide the adoption of data agents and Copilot capabilities, focusing on business context and validation rather than the underlying data engineering.

MFA Oil Company is an Equal Opportunity/Drug-Free Employer.

Responsibilities

Design, build, and maintain Power BI reports and dashboards that translate complex data into clear, actionable stories for leaders and business users
Design, build, and maintain Power Apps solutions on the Power Platform, using the data lakehouse as the underlying source
Partner with business users to deeply understand their processes, priorities, and pain points, and translate that understanding into effective reporting and app solutions
Mentor and provide guidance to less experienced analysts on report design, storytelling technique, and business context
Contribute to the design and build of data marts in the gold layer, working closely with data engineering to ensure structures support reporting and storytelling needs
Test and verify the accuracy of reports, apps, and underlying data independently before delivery, using SQL and Excel as needed to validate results
Serve as a business and data domain expert in the training and implementation of data agents and Copilot capabilities, ensuring outputs are accurate and grounded in real business context
Independently evaluate AI-assisted or AI-generated outputs for accuracy, and verify results rather than relying on them at face value
Identify opportunities to improve or automate reporting processes and drive adoption of best practices across the BI function
All MFA Oil employees are expected to know and adhere to company and position specific policies and procedures. While this job description contains the primary duties of the position, employees may be expected to perform other duties as assigned.

Job Requirements

Bachelor's degree in business, information technology, statistics, or other related field; or an associate’s degree plus related experience
Five or more years of experience building reports and dashboards in Power BI, with a strong track record of data storytelling for business audiences
Demonstrated ability to develop deep business knowledge and translate it into insights that influence decisions
Strong SQL skills for querying and validating data
Experience using Excel to test, cross-check, and validate report and data accuracy
Excellent written and oral communication and presentation skills, with the ability to both solicit information from and explain data clearly to non-technical audiences
Critical thinking and problem-solving skills
Self-motivated, with the ability to manage multiple deadlines and drive work forward with minimal oversight
Ability to thrive in a fast paced, growing organization and rapidly changing environment.
Detail-oriented with the ability to consistently provide accurate, high-quality work
Ability to work both independently and in a team environment
Ability to maintain the confidentiality of sensitive information
Ability to speak, read, write, and understand the English language to communicate accurately and effectively with customers, coworkers, and supervisors.
Ability to meet Company requirements, including successful pre-employment background and check and drug test.
Legal authorization to work in the United States

Preferred Skills

Experience with Power Platform tools, including Power Apps and Power Automate
Experience working with data warehouses or Lakehouse environments (Microsoft Fabric preferred)
Familiarity with Python for light data manipulation or validation
Experience with AI tools such as Copilot or data agents, including the ability to critically evaluate and verify AI-generated output rather than relying on it to understand the business or tell the story
Experience as a functional business analyst
Ability to think outside the box and research solutions to difficult problems
Ability to set priorities and goals and develop plans for achieving them

MFA Oil Company, formed in 1929, is a farmer-owned cooperative and a leading propane retailer in the United States. The company supplies fuels, lubricants, and propane to customers in Missouri, Arkansas, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Kentucky, Oklahoma, and Tennessee. Through a subsidiary, MFA Oil operates Break Time convenience stores in Missouri; a Big O Tires franchise in Missouri, Arkansas, and Kansas; a solar panel installation company, BluSphere Energy; and APM, a wholesale fuel distributor.

jobs.title: Research Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Job Description

JOB SUMMARY

The Research Data Analyst (RDA) will support the Principal Investigator in a broad scope of research-related activities taking place in the United States The RDA will plan, coordinate, and oversee data systems for research studies i.e. database set-up, data management, developing and pilot-testing questionnaires, conducting quality assurance, preparing recruitment reports, overseeing system for data queries, and monitoring study retention. The RDA will function as a liaison between site data managers/programmers for the purposes of database creation and management, and will plan and coordinate weekly or semi-weekly meetings among data staff to regulatory track progress and troubleshoot issues. This position involves working with a variety of UCSF and non-UCSF faculty and staff to complete data entry and securely transfer data to approved academic partners. Study databases will be created and maintained in the UCSF secure research environment using RED-CAP. The RDA will oversee data entry, data management and storage, develop programming to generate weekly progress and monitoring reports, conduct data management and quality assurance, and provide technical assistance to research staff related to data entry and processing. The RDA will be responsible for using standard privacy and compliance procedures for the safe handling and use of electronic medical record and public health surveillance data for research purposes. The RDA may at times be required to conduct medical record chart reviews for completion of data elements and/or to assure data integrity.

The incumbent will also develop tables, graphs, and contribute to analyses for reports and publications under the direction of the study PIs and study statistician; and perform other data management/department tasks as assigned to meet the overall data and technical needs of the program.

This position requires the RDA work in the office a minimum of 4 days/week.

ABOUT THE DIVISION OF HIV, INFECTIOUS DISEASES AND GLOBAL MEDICINE

The Division of HIV, Infectious Diseases and Global Medicine at the University of California San Francisco (UCSF) is an internationally recognized global leader in clinical care, research, and education. With its home-base located at Zuckerberg San Francisco General Hospital and Trauma Center (ZSFG), the Division has been ranked as the top facility in the country for AIDS care since 1983. The Division’s work is featured frequently in the media, and it is often visited by numerous international, national, state, and local dignitaries and delegations. The Division consists of approximately 36 faculty members, 11 fellows/postdoctoral scholars and 170 academic and staff employees. It is the largest Division of the Department of Medicine (DOM) at ZSFG, with a total expenditure budget of approximately $52 million dollars.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in related area and / or equivalent experience / training
Working knowledge of research function
Working skills in system programming, database design and data security measures
Working skills in analysis and consultation
Skills to communicate complex information in a clear and concise manner both verbally and written
Organizational skills to manage complex information
Proficient in Microsoft Excel, REDCap
Demonstrated ability to prepare tables, charts and graphs for use in publications and presentations
Demonstrated ability to interact effectively with a wide range of team members, including faculty investigators, programmers, community partners, and other data managers from diverse cultural backgrounds
Ability to communicate clearly and succinctly in spoken and written English

Preferred Qualifications

Proficient in Qualtrics and other survey and database platforms

About Us

About UCSF

The University of California, San Francisco (UCSF) is a leading university dedicated to promoting health worldwide through advanced biomedical research, graduate-level education in the life sciences and health professions, and excellence in patient care. It is the only campus in the 10-campus UC system dedicated exclusively to the health sciences. We bring together the world’s leading experts in nearly every area of health. We are home to five Nobel laureates who have advanced the understanding of cancer, neurodegenerative diseases, aging and stem cells.

UCSF is a diverse community made of people with many skills and talents. We seek candidates whose work experience or community service has prepared them to contribute to our commitment to professionalism, respect, integrity, diversity and excellence – also known as our PRIDE values .

In addition to our PRIDE values, UCSF is committed to equity – both in how we deliver care as well as our workforce. We are committed to building a broadly diverse community, nurturing a culture that is welcoming and supportive, and engaging diverse ideas for the provision of culturally competent education, discovery, and patient care. Join us to find a rewarding career contributing to improving healthcare worldwide.

Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

Hoe maak jij mee het verschil?

Als Innovation Project Manager is het jouw missie om innovatieve projecten te ontwikkelen en te leiden binnen de hele NMBS. Het kan daarbij gaan om zowel digitale als niet-digitale initiatieven. Je speelt een sleutelrol in het verbeteren van de ervaring van onze reizigers en van onze collega’s.

Enkele voorbeelden van gerealiseerde projecten zijn onder andere: opleidingen met virtual reality, de invoering van stiltezones op de trein, ondersteunende tools voor onze techniekers en smart AI-assistants.

Meer info op deze pagina: Het Innovation Program | NMBS.

Wat is jouw rol bij NMBS?

Als Innnovation Project Manager Heb Je Volgende Verantwoordelijkheden

Je stuurt innovatieve projecten aan op een agile en pragmatische manier, van idee-generatie tot Proof of Concept, de testfases en de eind­evaluatie. Je ondersteunt ook de overgang van POC naar de pre-industrialisatie, samen met collega’s uit de directies en IT-partners.
Je bent verantwoordelijk voor alle sleutelelementen van projectbeheer: het bepalen van de scope, de planning, risicobeheer, communicatie, testen, budget en evaluatie.
Je stemt de verschillende interne stakeholders op elkaar af en werkt samen met technische experts, externe partners en/of interne teams om end-to-end oplossingen te ontwerpen, te testen en te integreren.
Je verkent actief opkomende technologieën, trends en innovatiemethodologieën, met een sterke focus op artificiële intelligentie en datagedreven oplossingen.
Je identificeert kansen om de klantervaring te verbeteren of de interne efficiëntie te verhogen en vertaalt deze naar concrete, haalbare initiatieven.
Je neemt deel aan de organisatie van evenementen, waaronder het faciliteren van workshops, idee-sessies en presentaties.

Waarom is deze job iets voor jou?

Je beschikt over een masterdiploma (of gelijkwaardig door ervaring) EN hebt minstens 5 jaar ervaring in project management, bij voorkeur binnen innovatie of digitale transformatie.

EN Je Beschikt Over De Volgende Vaardigheden

Je hebt een sterke beheersing van de principes en tools van projectmanagement.
Je beschikt over een uitgesproken can-do-mentaliteit, die je actief uitdraagt. Daardoor neem je spontaan initiatief en weet je obstakels weg te nemen om de voortgang van projecten te garanderen.
Je hebt een functioneel en strategisch inzicht in digitale technologieën en artificiële intelligentie.
Je communiceert vlot, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk, in het Nederlands, en je hebt een goede kennis van het Frans en het Engels. Dankzij je communicatiestijl kan je stakeholders overtuigen, aligneren en inspireren.
Je bent creatief en denkt graag out of the box.
Je hebt een uitgesproken interesse voor innovatie en voor de uitdagingen die verbonden zijn aan openbaar vervoer.

Indien je jouw diploma in het buitenland hebt behaald, dien je in het bezit te zijn van een gelijkwaardigheidsattest afgeleverd door de Vlaamse Overheid (NARIC-Vlaanderen) om deel te kunnen nemen aan de selectie.

We vinden het dan ook belangrijk dat je jezelf kan zijn. Want dat maakt NMBS sterker. Daarom hechten we veel belang aan diversiteit en inclusie.

Wat mag je van ons verwachten?

Kiezen Voor NMBS Is Kiezen Voor Een Omgeving Waarin Je Kan Bijleren En Groeien. Je Wordt Gesteund En Omringd Door Fijne Collega's. Als Innovation Project Manager Krijg Je Een Loonpakket Dat Bestaat Uit

Je werkt in de buurt van het station Brussel-Zuid, in de gebouwen Atrium en Innovation lab.

new_jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
Senior Project Manager | Utility-Scale Solar

We're looking for a Senior Project Manager who knows how to run a project like a business.
Not someone who just attends meetings, updates a schedule, and tells us everything is tracking.
We want someone who knows their numbers. Someone who understands self-perform construction and can look at labor, production, cost, schedule, and contract exposure and tell us where a project is going before it gets there.
At Enervia, our Senior PMs own the commercial and financial performance of utility-scale solar projects from turnover through closeout.
You'll have experienced Construction Managers and field leadership running the work in the field. Your job is to make sure the entire project performs.

What you'll own

Budget, forecasting, Cost-to-Complete, WIP, billing, and cash flow
Self-perform labor, production, productivity, and installed quantities
Contracts, change orders, RFIs, and commercial correspondence
Procurement, subcontractors, and major material coordination
Project schedules, risks, and recovery plans
Owner relationships and progress meetings
Change-order pricing, negotiation, and recovery
Ultimately: the financial and contractual success of your projects

Who we're looking for

You have experience managing utility-scale solar, heavy electrical, substation, or similar construction projects, and you've had real exposure to a self-performing contractor.
That part matters.
We don't simply subcontract the work and manage it from a spreadsheet. We put our own people and equipment in the field, which means our PMs need to understand production, labor productivity, quantities, equipment utilization, and how today's field performance affects tomorrow's forecast.
You should be comfortable with Excel, forecasting, production tracking, scheduling, contracts, and difficult conversations.
A degree isn't what will get our attention. Knowing how to build, lead, think ahead, and own the outcome will.

Where you'll work

We're flexible.
This position can be remote, provided you're willing to travel when the job requires it. That could mean our office, project sites, client meetings, or wherever you need to be to lead effectively.
We care a lot more about results than where your laptop happens to be sitting.

Job Title: Senior Project Manager (Construction)
Location: Full-Time Remote (LATAM)
Working Hours: Full-Time, Monday to Friday, 7:30 AM to 4:30 PM EST
Compensation: $2,000 - 2,500 USD per month (based on experience)

About The Company

Our client is a premier, New York-based exterior construction and restoration firm specializing in façade restoration, roofing, waterproofing, masonry, concrete, sidewalk replacement, and Local Law 11/FISP compliance projects. Having successfully completed 600+ exterior restoration projects across New York, including commercial, residential, historic, landmark, and New York State public works, they work closely with property owners, managers, architects, engineers, and municipal stakeholders.

About The Opportunity

With a growing team of nearly 60 internal office staff, field crews, and remote specialists,our client is expanding its operations. We are seeking an experienced Senior Project Manager to serve as a key operational leader, taking ownership of execution, building efficient processes, and helping drive scalable growth.

As Senior Project Manager, you will work directly alongside the Principal to oversee and streamline exterior construction and restoration projects from initial planning to final delivery.
You will act as a force multiplier; bringing strong operational organization, robust PM systems/tools, and refined delegation strategies to manage high-volume workloads.

This position is ideal for an experienced, proactive project manager who thrives in US-based construction environments, excels at managing complex cross-functional teams, and knows how to set up structure and project workflows that others can easily follow.

Key Responsibilities

Project Execution & Operational Leadership

Project Ownership: Manage multiple concurrent exterior construction and restoration projects (façade restoration, roofing, waterproofing, masonry, Local Law 11/FISP) from initiation through closeout.
Systems & Process Creation: Introduce, build out, and refine internal project management systems, tracking tools, workflows, and communication standards to optimize operational efficiency.
Team Delegation & Leadership: Delegate tasks effectively to remote team members and field crews to ensure accountability and balanced workloads.
Cross-Functional Coordination: Coordinate seamlessly between subcontractors, field site crews, superintendents, remote staff, vendors, clients, architects, and engineers.

Schedules, Budgets & Resource Management

Schedule & Timeline Management: Maintain detailed project schedules, track critical milestones, manage delays, and proactively clear operational bottlenecks.
Financial & Cost Tracking:Track budgets, change orders, procurement, and material deliveries to maintain project profitability and schedules.
Procurement & Logistics: Coordinate material shipments and field resources to ensure job sites have necessary equipment and supplies without interruption.

Compliance, Documentation & Stakeholder Management

Project Documentation: Oversee RFIs, submittals, permits, field reports, progress updates, change orders, and general project records.
Regulatory Compliance: Ensure projects meet NYC/NYS building codes, safety regulations, and public project standards.
Stakeholder Communication: Maintain clear, regular communication with property managers, NYC/NYS agency contacts, engineers, and internal leadership.

Must Have

Required Qualifications & Attributes

Experience: 5+ years of experience in construction project management, specifically managing US-based projects.
Industry Focus: Experience in exterior construction, façade restoration, roofing, waterproofing, masonry, concrete, or related specialty trades.
Leadership & Delegation: Proven ability to delegate effectively, establish PM processes/KPIs, and manage multi-disciplinary teams .
Systems Implementation: Openness to implementing or utilizing modern PM tools and platforms to create clear visibility across active projects.
Operational Process Improvement: Proven track record of taking unorganized project operations and establishing scalable systems, workflows, and transparent KPIs.
Communication: Exceptional written and spoken English communication skills; comfortable interacting with executive leadership, clients, engineers, and sub-contractors.
Work Ethic & Autonomy: Proactive, organized, and capable of operating independently without heavy supervision.

Nice to have: Standout Signals & Preferred Experience!

NYC / NYS Experience (Highly Desirable): Familiarity with NYC/NYS building codes, Local Law 11 / FISP, landmark guidelines, public works projects, and sidewalk shed/scaffolding setups.
Complex Exterior Scopes: Hands-on experience coordinating restoration projects involving scaffolding, sidewalk sheds, material hoisting, waterproofing, masonry, roofing, and structural repairs on landmark or high-rise buildings.
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Civil Engineering, Architecture, or equivalent practical industry experience preferred.
NYC Stakeholder Network: Established working relationships or previous experience collaborating with NYC architects, engineers, property managers, DOB inspectors, and contractors. (plus!)

new_jobs.title: Healthcare IT Workstream Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
As required by our governmental client, this position requires being a US Citizen AND must be able to obtain a Public Trust clearance ***

The Healthcare IT Workstream Project Manager manages an assigned workstream within the Indian Health Service (IHS) modernization program. This part of the program is migrating current patient data to a new Four Directions Warehouse environment to strengthen IHS access to accurate, timely, and usable patient information.

The Project Manager is responsible for planning, coordinating, executing, and reporting on their assigned workstream. This includes managing scope, schedule, risks, dependencies, resources, stakeholders, subcontractors, and delivery readiness. The role works closely with IHS stakeholders, technical teams, clinical and functional leads, data owners, vendors, and program leadership to ensure the workstream delivers aligned, high-quality outcomes that support the broader warehouse migration.

Compensation & Benefits

Estimated Starting Salary Range for Healthcare IT Workstream Project Manager
: $90,000 – $100,000

Pay commensurate with experience.

Full time benefits include Medical, Dental, Vision, 401K and other possible benefits as provided. Benefits are subject to change with or without notice.

Healthcare IT Workstream Project Manager Responsibilities Include

Manage an assigned workstream supporting migration of current patient data to the new Four Directions Warehouse for the IHS client.
Develop and maintain the workstream plan, schedule, milestones, dependencies, assumptions, risks, issues, decisions, and change-control documentation.
Coordinate workstream activities with program leadership and other technical, clinical, functional, data, integration, analytics, and site-deployment workstreams.
Support data-migration activities within the assigned workstream, including requirements definition, source-data assessment, mapping, transformation, validation, reconciliation, testing, cutover, and post-deployment stabilization, as applicable.
Coordinate with IHS stakeholders, clinical subject-matter experts, data owners, technical teams, subcontractors, and vendors to define priorities, resolve issues, and maintain delivery alignment.
Track workstream readiness and manage cross-workstream dependencies that affect the migration, integration, availability, quality, or use of current patient data in the new Four Directions Warehouse.
Establish and/or maintain workstream governance, including status reporting, RAID logs, decision logs, action-item tracking, and executive briefings.
Support data-quality and acceptance activities to verify that current patient data is complete, accurate, secure, available, and fit for intended clinical and operational use.
Facilitate workstream meetings, working sessions, readiness reviews, and stakeholder communications to drive timely decisions and accountability.
Support user acceptance testing, operational readiness, deployment planning, and post-implementation issue resolution for the assigned workstream.
Maintain program scope, schedule, and delivery commitments through disciplined risk, dependency, and change management.
Perform other duties as assigned.

Healthcare IT Workstream Project Manager Experience, Education, Skills, Abilities requested:

Required Qualifications

Active PMI Project Management Professional (PMP) certification is required and familiarity with both waterfall and agile delivery.
Experience managing a workstream or major functional area within a large, complex healthcare IT implementation, data modernization, or data-migration program.
Experience supporting patient-data, clinical-data, EHR, clinical data repository, data warehouse, data integration, or healthcare analytics initiatives.
Demonstrated experience managing workstream schedules, milestones, RAID logs, dependencies, change control, stakeholder communications, and executive status reporting.
Experience coordinating technical teams, clinical or functional stakeholders, data owners, vendors, and subcontractors in a multi-workstream environment.
Strong ability to communicate technical delivery status, risks, dependencies, and decisions to business and executive stakeholders.
U.S. citizenship, pass pre-employment qualifications of Cherokee Federal and must be able to obtain a Public Trust clearance through the Government.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience supporting IHS, tribal health, federal healthcare, or other government health programs.
Experience supporting patient-data migration, healthcare data warehouse implementation, clinical data repositories, data conversion, or data integration.
Knowledge of healthcare data standards and technologies relevant to the assigned workstream, such as HL7, FHIR, DICOM, ETL/ELT processes, APIs, clinical data models, or data-quality tools.
Experience with data validation, reconciliation, clinical/business acceptance, testing, deployment readiness, or cutover planning.
Experience supporting imaging, radiology, CT/X-ray, DICOM, clinical analytics, or other specialized healthcare data domains.
Experience supporting large EHR implementation, modernization, interoperability, or clinical systems integration programs.

new_jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, Architecture & Automation Deployment
new_jobs.description:
Job Description

Agilent is looking for a Senior Program Manager to lead the deployment of engineering tools, automation, and AI capabilities across our R&D organization. This role owns the full cycle from understanding what engineers actually need, to rolling out the tools and systems that meet that need, to making adoption stick. You will run internal voice-of-customer efforts with engineering teams across divisions, translate what you learn into deployment programs, and drive the systematization and execution that turns a new tool or capability into something engineers actually use day to day.

This role also runs the program management behind Agilent's cross-divisional automation initiatives, including coordination with our China Innovation Center on accelerated engineering projects. You will build and manage the program plans, governance, and reporting that keep divisional teams, the innovation hub, and the CTO office aligned as these initiatives scale.

This is a program leadership role built for someone who can move fluidly between listening to engineers, structuring a rollout plan, and running the execution discipline to deliver it. A systems engineering background is highly valued: understanding how engineering tools plug into the product development lifecycle and being able to speak credibly with engineering leads about technical workflows, will make you far more effective than program management experience alone.

Key Responsibilities

Voice of Customer and Tool Strategy

Run structured voice-of-customer efforts with engineering teams across divisions to understand where new tools, automation, or AI capabilities would have the most impact.
Synthesize findings into clear deployment priorities and business cases, partnering with engineering leadership to validate direction.
Stay current on emerging engineering tools and AI capabilities relevant to hardware and systems engineering workflows.

Architecture and AI Deployment

Own end-to-end deployment programs for architecture implementation and AI capabilities across the enterprise, from pilot through full rollout.
Drive systematization: turning a promising tool or pilot into a repeatable, well-governed capability that scales across divisions.
Partner with IT, engineering operations, and divisional leads to manage rollout logistics, training, and change management.
Track adoption and usage post-deployment, and course-correct programs that aren't landing.

Automation Program Execution

Lead program management for cross-divisional automation initiatives, including coordination with the China Innovation Center on accelerated engineering projects.
Build and run program plans, governance cadences, and status reporting that keep divisional teams, strategic marketing, and the hub aligned on scope and timing.
Manage cross-time zone program cadence with the China Innovation Center, keeping risks and dependencies visible to stakeholders.

Cross-Functional Governance and Reporting

Maintain a portfolio view across architecture and automation programs, including status, risks, resourcing, and timelines.
Partner with divisional program managers and engineering leads to resolve cross-program dependencies.
Report program health and key decisions to the CTO office and other senior stakeholders on a regular cadence.

Qualifications

10+ years of program or project management experience in a hardware/instrument R&D environment, including experience deploying tools, processes, or capabilities across engineering teams.
Systems engineering background or hands-on experience working within a systems engineering process strongly preferred.
Experience running voice-of-customer or internal stakeholder research efforts and translating findings into action.
Experience with engineering tool rollouts, digital transformation, or AI/automation adoption initiatives strongly preferred.
Experience running cross-divisional or multi-site programs, ideally including work with an offshore or globally distributed engineering team.

Required Skills And Competencies

Strong program and portfolio management fundamentals: scope, schedule, risk, and stakeholder management.
Comfort operating in a technical environment, able to hold credible conversations with engineering leads about systems-level and architecture workflows.
Skilled at running voice-of-customer processes and turning qualitative input into a structured plan.
Ability to build structure and process without slowing teams down, tuned to an engineering audience.
Strong cross-functional influence and communication, able to align divisional and hub stakeholders without direct authority.

Additional Details

This job has a full time weekly schedule. It includes the option to work remotely. Applications for this job will be accepted until at least September 22, 2026 or until the job is no longer posted.

The full-time equivalent pay range for this position is $179,931.00 - $315,300.00/yr plus eligibility for bonus, stock and benefits. Our pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. During the hiring process, a recruiter can share more about the specific pay range for a preferred location. Pay and benefit information by country are available at: https://careers.agilent.com/locations

Agilent Technologies, Inc. is an Equal Employment Opportunity and merit-based employer that values individuals of all backgrounds at all levels. All individuals, regardless of personal characteristics, are encouraged to apply. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, pregnancy, race, religion or religious creed, color, gender, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, registered domestic partner status, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, protected veteran status, or any other basis protected by federal, state, local law, ordinance, or regulation and will not be discriminated against on these bases. Agilent Technologies, Inc., is committed to creating and maintaining an inclusive in the workplace where everyone is welcome, and strives to support candidates with disabilities. If you have a disability and need assistance with any part of the application or interview process or have questions about workplace accessibility, please email job_posting@agilent.com or contact +1-262-754-5030. For more information about equal employment opportunity protections, please visit www.agilent.com/en/accessibility.

new_jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, Architecture & Automation Deployment
new_jobs.description:
Job Description

Agilent is looking for a Senior Program Manager to lead the deployment of engineering tools, automation, and AI capabilities across our R&D organization. This role owns the full cycle from understanding what engineers actually need, to rolling out the tools and systems that meet that need, to making adoption stick. You will run internal voice-of-customer efforts with engineering teams across divisions, translate what you learn into deployment programs, and drive the systematization and execution that turns a new tool or capability into something engineers actually use day to day.

This role also runs the program management behind Agilent's cross-divisional automation initiatives, including coordination with our China Innovation Center on accelerated engineering projects. You will build and manage the program plans, governance, and reporting that keep divisional teams, the innovation hub, and the CTO office aligned as these initiatives scale.

This is a program leadership role built for someone who can move fluidly between listening to engineers, structuring a rollout plan, and running the execution discipline to deliver it. A systems engineering background is highly valued: understanding how engineering tools plug into the product development lifecycle and being able to speak credibly with engineering leads about technical workflows, will make you far more effective than program management experience alone.

Key Responsibilities

Voice of Customer and Tool Strategy

Run structured voice-of-customer efforts with engineering teams across divisions to understand where new tools, automation, or AI capabilities would have the most impact.
Synthesize findings into clear deployment priorities and business cases, partnering with engineering leadership to validate direction.
Stay current on emerging engineering tools and AI capabilities relevant to hardware and systems engineering workflows.

Architecture and AI Deployment

Own end-to-end deployment programs for architecture implementation and AI capabilities across the enterprise, from pilot through full rollout.
Drive systematization: turning a promising tool or pilot into a repeatable, well-governed capability that scales across divisions.
Partner with IT, engineering operations, and divisional leads to manage rollout logistics, training, and change management.
Track adoption and usage post-deployment, and course-correct programs that aren't landing.

Automation Program Execution

Lead program management for cross-divisional automation initiatives, including coordination with the China Innovation Center on accelerated engineering projects.
Build and run program plans, governance cadences, and status reporting that keep divisional teams, strategic marketing, and the hub aligned on scope and timing.
Manage cross-time zone program cadence with the China Innovation Center, keeping risks and dependencies visible to stakeholders.

Cross-Functional Governance and Reporting

Maintain a portfolio view across architecture and automation programs, including status, risks, resourcing, and timelines.
Partner with divisional program managers and engineering leads to resolve cross-program dependencies.
Report program health and key decisions to the CTO office and other senior stakeholders on a regular cadence.

Qualifications

10+ years of program or project management experience in a hardware/instrument R&D environment, including experience deploying tools, processes, or capabilities across engineering teams.
Systems engineering background or hands-on experience working within a systems engineering process strongly preferred.
Experience running voice-of-customer or internal stakeholder research efforts and translating findings into action.
Experience with engineering tool rollouts, digital transformation, or AI/automation adoption initiatives strongly preferred.
Experience running cross-divisional or multi-site programs, ideally including work with an offshore or globally distributed engineering team.

Required Skills And Competencies

Strong program and portfolio management fundamentals: scope, schedule, risk, and stakeholder management.
Comfort operating in a technical environment, able to hold credible conversations with engineering leads about systems-level and architecture workflows.
Skilled at running voice-of-customer processes and turning qualitative input into a structured plan.
Ability to build structure and process without slowing teams down, tuned to an engineering audience.
Strong cross-functional influence and communication, able to align divisional and hub stakeholders without direct authority.

Additional Details

This job has a full time weekly schedule. It includes the option to work remotely. Applications for this job will be accepted until at least September 22, 2026 or until the job is no longer posted.

new_jobs.title: Lead Partner Services Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
Your role at Dynatrace

Dynatrace partners deliver a growing share of the implementations that determine whether our customers realize value. The Partner Services Program gives us the frameworks to make that delivery consistent: the Partner Delivery Maturity Model, the Partner Delivery Enablement Framework, the Partner Delivery Toolkit, and the Services Endorsement Program.

This role owns operating them as a single governed system. You will own how Dynatrace assesses, certifies, and holds partners accountable for delivery quality worldwide. You decide what qualified looks like, you run the reviews that determine whether a partner has reached it, and you own the quality bar that protects our customers when we are not the ones in the room.

This is a build role inside an existing program. The frameworks are documented. Turning them into a repeatable, auditable, globally consistent operating system is the work.

Responsibilities

Certification and tiering:

Own the Partner Delivery Maturity Model as the single system of record for partner delivery capability, including the Entry, Growing, Proficient, and Advanced tier definitions
Run partner tier assessments and establish a re-certification cadence, so that a tier reflects current capability rather than a past achievement
Maintain the capacity and competency standards for each tier, including dedicated resource counts and role-based training and hands-on experience requirements
Serve as the decision authority on tier advancement, and communicate declines with a clear remediation path

Quality Governance

Operate the Services Endorsement Program: application intake, verification of customer-validated engagements in the trailing 18 months, and the Dynatrace-led delivery review
Own the pre-engagement and post-engagement quality review process and the partner quality audit cycle
Own the partner delivery health and quality gates currently in development, and take them to production
Hold partners to the 90% customer satisfaction commitment, and run the improvement plan process when they fall below it
Govern the Co-Delivery Rules of Engagement, adjudicating where a partner delivers independently, where ACE leads, and where ACE backfills competency gaps.

Program Architecture And Reporting

Maintain the Partner Delivery Enablement Framework and the Partner Delivery Toolkit as living assets, versioned and current with the platform
Define the post-sales RACI for engagements where partners are involved, resolving the handoff ambiguity that exists today across ACE, Enterprise Support Services, and Customer Success
Translate tier competency requirements into content specifications for Dynatrace University and Product Education, and for ACE where hands-on enablement is required. You define what a certified partner must be able to do. You do not build the curriculum.
Report partner delivery quality, tier distribution, and endorsement pipeline to Customer organization leadership on a standing cadence

Team

Lead a small team as the program scales, with initial focus on individual ownership and program build

Minimum Requirements

What will help you succeed

Six or more years in professional services, partner programs, or delivery quality, including two or more years owning a program with external accountability
Demonstrated ownership of a certification, accreditation, or partner competency framework, including the authority to grant and withhold status
Experience running quality assurance or audit processes against external delivery organizations
Track record of building program operating cadence from documented frameworks, not only executing an established one
Ability to hold a standard with a commercial partner while preserving the relationship

Preferred Requirements

Experience in observability, application performance monitoring, cloud infrastructure, or a comparable technical platform where implementation quality directly affects customer outcomes
Familiarity with global systems integrator and managed service provider delivery models
Background spanning both a vendor services organization and a partner or systems integrator delivery practice
Experience with learning management platforms and certification tooling
Comfort with delivery telemetry and building reporting that leadership can act on

Why you will love being a Dynatracer

Dynatrace is a leader in unified observability and security.
We provide a culture of excellence with competitive compensation packages designed to recognize and reward performance.
Our employees work with the largest cloud providers, including AWS, Microsoft, and Google Cloud, and other leading partners worldwide to create strategic alliances.
You'll get to work at the forefront of innovation with Dynatrace Intelligence—the industry's first agentic operations system. Bringing together deterministic and agentic AI, it helps teams understand what's happening, why it matters, and what to do next— automatically
Over 50% of the Fortune 100 companies are current customers of Dynatrace.

Compensation And Rewards

The base salary range for this role is $140K-$160K. When determining your salary, we consider your experience, skills, education, and work location.
Our total compensation package includes unlimited personal time off, an employee stock purchase plan, and a reward system.
We also offer medical/dental benefits and a company-matched 401(k) plan for retirement.

Equal Employment Opportunity

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

About Arketa

Arketa is building the operating system for modern fitness and wellness. Our mission is to make wellness more accessible by empowering studios and wellness entrepreneurs to grow beyond in-person classes. We provide a powerful, all-in-one platform to manage and scale hybrid wellness businesses, whether online, in-person, or both.

With Arketa, studios can manage schedules, accept bookings and payments, build on-demand video libraries, host retreats, run automated marketing, and launch fully branded apps and websites. We make it simple for founders to deliver a seamless, professional experience across every customer touchpoint. We've raised $15M in Series A funding and are growing quickly. It's a unique moment to join us. We're building a category-defining company in a fast-moving space, and we're looking for a leader who is excited to help shape what world-class partner support looks like in the wellness category.

About The Role

We're looking for an Embedded Payroll Program Manager to own the strategy, process design, and success metrics behind Arketa's new embedded payroll offering — and to be a direct point of support for our partners. Day-to-day onboarding and support execution belongs to the Implementation Account Manager and Payroll Specialist, but you'll stay personally connected to partners, especially on the more complex or highest-touch relationships, while designing the playbooks the rest of the team executes against, owning the relationship with our payroll infrastructure partner and managing the two roles below.

What You'll Do:

Program Strategy & Process Design

Design the onboarding playbook, support triage process, and escalation paths, in partnership with the Implementation Account Manager and Payroll Specialist
Define the handoff criteria between onboarding and ongoing support, and refine it as volume and the team grow
Build the documentation and Help Center foundations the rest of the team executes against
Own the roadmap and priorities for the payroll offering's customer-facing operations

Metrics & Reporting

Define and track key metrics: time-to-launch, onboarding capacity, support resolution time, support volume per customer, CSAT, and documentation coverage
Own the reporting cadence to leadership on how the payroll offering is performing operationally

Partner Support

Serve as a senior point of contact for Arketa's payroll partners, especially on complex, escalated, or strategic relationships
Step in directly on partner issues that need program-level context or cross-functional pull
Build direct partner relationships that inform how onboarding and support processes should evolve

Team & Stakeholder Management

Manage and coach the Implementation Account Manager and Payroll Specialist, and unblock escalations they can't resolve on their own
Manage the relationship with our payroll provider, and coordinate with engineering, compliance, and customer success to keep implementations and support on track
Translate recurring customer pain points into feedback for Product and Engineering

What success looks like:

New customers launch on time with minimal friction, and support questions get resolved quickly and accurately
Clear documentation exists for both onboarding and support workflows
Partners feel a direct, senior point of contact is available for their more complex or high-stakes needs
The Implementation Account Manager and Payroll Specialist have what they need to execute independently day to day, with you focused on strategy, metrics, partner relationships, and escalations
A well-reasoned, evolving plan for how the onboarding/support handoff should work as volume grows

3-5+ years in program/project management, implementation, or customer-facing operations leadership, ideally at a fintech, HR tech, or payroll company
Experience designing processes and playbooks for a customer-facing function, ideally from scratch
People management experience, or strong readiness to manage a small team, preferred
Strong communication skills — you'll be explaining payroll mechanics to non-experts and translating customer pain points to internal teams
Ability to operate with ambiguity; this role and its scope will evolve
Experience with payroll, benefits, or embedded financial products is a strong plus

Competitive Salary and Stock Options
Unlimited PTO: our policy is designed to give you the flexibility to rest, recharge, and take care of personal needs — while staying aligned with your team and responsibilities.
Medical, dental and vision health insurance
Fitness Class Reimbursement: we’re committed to supporting both employee wellness and our industry relationships. As an Arketa employee we see movement as opportunity.
Parental Leave Policy

For this role, the estimated annual base salary is up to $100,000- $140,000, depending on experience and qualifications. In addition to base pay, we offer equity. We believe in compensating fairly and transparently, and we’re happy to provide more detail during the interview process.

The position will work closely with Risk, Product, Operations, Technology, and Data Science resources to develop and maintain an AI opportunity roadmap spanning both Machine Learning and Generative AI capabilities. The role is focused on business outcomes, use-case management, and solution delivery rather than hands-on model development.

Day In The Life

AI Strategy & Roadmap Management

Develop and maintain an opportunity backlog and roadmap for Risk Services through the lens of AI
Partner with business leaders within and outside of Risk to identify opportunities where AI can improve operational efficiency, reduce risk, enhance decision-making, or generate new business value for Risk Services.
Evaluate and prioritize AI initiatives based on business impact, feasibility, data availability, regulatory considerations, resource capacity, and probability of approval.

Aperçu du Poste

L'équipe « Platform Services and Emerging Technologies » (PSET) recherche un responsable de programme technique (TPM) chargé de piloter la mise en œuvre réussie des résultats du programme « Generative AI Accelerator » (GAIA) d'Autodesk.

À ce poste, vous piloterez des programmes complexes et transversaux visant à faire passer les capacités émergentes en IA de la recherche à la production. Ce poste exige de solides connaissances techniques, notamment une maîtrise approfondie de l’IA, une excellente discipline d’exécution et la capacité à intervenir efficacement au sein de différentes structures organisationnelles pour aligner les priorités, gérer les risques et obtenir des résultats dans des environnements ambigus et en constante évolution.

Piloter les prévisions de mise en œuvre, le suivi de l’exécution et le reporting transparent tout au long du cycle de vie des programmes
Orchestrer la mise en œuvre entre les équipes de recherche, d’ingénierie, de sécurité, juridiques, produit et de plateforme, en suivant les répercussions en aval sur tout ce qu’elles touchent
Collaborer avec les parties prenantes de la direction, les architectes et les responsables produit pour définir la stratégie, l’enchaînement des étapes et les plans d’exécution
Fournir des rapports d’état clairs et exploitables tant au niveau de la direction qu’au niveau des équipes, incluant les risques, les compromis et les stratégies d’atténuation
Anticiper les dépendances et les risques plutôt que de les découvrir a posteriori, qu’il s’agisse des données, de l’état de préparation des modèles ou des délais de mise en œuvre
Soutenir les équipes en éliminant les obstacles, en gérant les exceptions et en résolvant les dépendances
Utiliser de manière responsable les outils d’IA et d’automatisation approuvés pour garantir la visibilité, la reproductibilité et une source unique de vérité tout au long de la livraison, tout en validant les résultats et en préservant le jugement humain
Promouvoir les pratiques de livraison Agile et Lean, en soutenant les équipes auto-organisées évoluant dans des environnements complexes
S’appuyer sur des données factuelles et des enseignements validés pour adapter les plans, améliorant ainsi l’efficacité de la livraison, la collaboration et les résultats du programme
Agir en tant qu’agent du changement, en aidant les équipes à s’adapter à l’évolution des exigences, aux incertitudes liées à la recherche et aux priorités de la plateforme

Excellentes compétences en communication et en gestion des parties prenantes, avec la capacité d’influencer des publics tant techniques que non techniques

new_jobs.description:
Job Description

The Hoover Institution
seeks a Research Program Manager/Portfolio Specialist
to support and operationally energize the policy and research agenda of the Technology and Manufacturing Leadership (TML) team, a new Hoover program operating within the Commons Initiative.

TML is focused on producing research and reality-based, actionable outputs dedicated to how the US and its allies and partners can maintain technology and manufacturing leadership. TML’s research agenda centers on identifying and exploring opportunities to advance innovation and production capability across several industrial sectors. TML will consider how to deploy strategic capitalism and a whole-of-nation approach to technological transformation, how to forge deeper cooperation with democratic nations to implement, and how to assess and activate the full stack of factors that contribute to the ability to make complex products. Several workstreams are being developed, including semiconductors, industrial biomanufacturing, and advanced manufacturing, as well as research tools that drive technological innovation.

The Research Program Manager/Portfolio Specialist role is to develop, implement, and administer the vision, strategy, and goals of the team’s portfolio. The program is in its ramp-up phase. Ideal candidates are self-directed, organized, and accountable in dynamic, highly collaborative environments. Positivity, resilience under pressure, and strong problem-solving skills are essential. The role requires someone who brings consistent energy and humility to the team. Program management experience, strong writing skills and budget oversight are preferred but not required. Competence in visual display tools and tech literacy is an asset. Expertise in adjacent domains—political science, economics, law, engineering—is equally welcome with demonstrated willingness to learn the technology landscape.

Studies have shown that people from certain backgrounds are less likely to apply for jobs unless they believe they can perform every job description task. We are most interested in finding the best candidate for the job, and that candidate may come from a less traditional background. We may consider an equivalent combination of knowledge, skills, education, and experience to meet minimum qualifications. If you are interested in applying, we encourage you to think broadly about your background and skill set for the role.

The position is not a research position, but an operational role.

A cover letter and resume are required for full consideration.

This position is a two-year fixed term contract.

WORK ARRANGEMENT:
This position will be based on the Stanford campus and may be considered for an option of one or two day/week telecommuting (hybrid of working on-site and off-site), subject to operational need.

CORE DUTIES*:

Develop and manage the program operations associated with scheduling, organizing, and operating.
Manage program activities, including outreach to varied stakeholders within the program, assigning resources and making program improvement recommendations that impact policies and programs.
Manage public programs from inception through completion, including speaker and participant coordination, logistics, budgeting, and related activities; oversee research efforts and evaluate programs; and collect and analyze data to assess effectiveness and support recommendations for improvement.
Write and/or edit complex content for newsletters, email communications, policy reports, peer-reviewed publications, proposals, research grants, fundraising and other program outputs.
Monitor program expenses, budgets, and finances, and make recommendations on funding based on program spending.
Source, collect and analyze data; review and explain trends; identify and recommend new collaboration opportunities; formulate and evaluate alternative solutions and/or recommendations to achieve the goals of the program or function.
Coach and mentor program staff, including student research assistants.

Preferred/Desired Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

Able to work comfortably with frontier technologies subject matter and industrial manufacturing themes.
Capable of managing, completing, and shipping complex and high-consequence projects and work products on time.
Able to support and prepare principles for meetings, briefings, hearings, or discussions .

Working Conditions

May work extended hours, evenings or weekends.
May be asked to travel locally, nationally, and internationally.
Occasional overnight travel.

Responsibilities

Core Duties
:

Oversee and administer research activities by evaluating academic programs, making recommendations that impact policies and programs, and coordinating and implementing changes.
Collect and analyze data, create reports, review and explain trends to determine program effectiveness; formulate and evaluate alternative solutions and/or recommendations to achieve the goals of the program.
Teach and/or assist in the teaching and administration of courses. Create and/or advise in the development of curriculum. Make recommendations for course improvements.

Remitly is on a mission to transform the lives of immigrants and their families by providing the most trusted financial products and services on the planet. Today, we are reimagining international payments at scale and building new products to create deeper relationships with our customers and their loved ones across the globe. Lead a team of Program Manager and Program Specialist that support New Initiatives across Remitly Business, Remitly Card, Receivers and Freelancers, and Stored Value.

SiriusXM and its brands (Pandora, SiriusXM Media, AdsWizz, Simplecast, and SiriusXM Connect) are leading a new era of audio entertainment and services by delivering the most compelling subscription and ad-supported audio entertainment experience for listeners -- in the car, at home, and anywhere on the go with connected devices.
