Our critically-acclaimed, industry-leading audio entertainment encompasses music, sports, comedy, news, talk, live events, and podcasting. No matter their individual role, each of our employees plays a vital part in bringing SiriusXM’s vision to life every day.

SiriusXM Media
is the gateway for marketers to the largest digital audio advertising ecosystem in North America, spanning owned and operated platforms, innovative ad tech solutions powered by AdsWizz, and an extended content network reaching more than 150 million listeners each month.

AdsWizz
, a subsidiary of SiriusXM, is the leading global provider of digital audio and podcast advertising solutions, operating in over 40 countries and connecting buyers and sellers through dynamic ad insertion, advanced programmatic platforms, and innovative audio formats.

How You’ll Make An Impact

As a strategic and adaptable Staff Technical Program Manager, Ad Technology, you will own the strategy and delivery of large-scale, cross-organizational initiatives across Ads Engineering. This role is critical to driving execution of high-impact programs spanning ad-serving systems, data platforms, monetization workflows, and cross-program integrations with Pandora and broader SiriusXM systems.

This is a senior individual contributor role requiring deep architectural literacy, systems thinking, and the ability to define program strategy — not simply execute against it. You will partner directly with engineering and product leadership to shape multi-year roadmaps, co-own program strategy, streamline org-wide governance, and deliver outcomes that materially impact platform scalability, monetization performance, and global platform capabilities to deliver outcomes that make an unmistakable enterprise-level impact across: scalability targets, RTB latency/SLA, fill rate, yield/monetization lift, reliability, and global rollout readiness. This includes leading multi-year, cross-functional programs such as global ad-serving modernization, real-time bidding (RTB) latency/scale programs, and technical consolidation across the Pandora and SiriusXM ad technology stacks.

What You’ll Do

Enterprise Program Strategy & Delivery

Establish and own the strategy and end-to-end delivery of large, cross-organizational Ads Engineering initiatives (eg: broadcast ads digitization and modernization, ad insertion, consolidation across SiriusXM and Pandora tech stacks), from intake through launch.
Function as Workstream lead for select cross-organizational initiatives spanning multiple engineering teams - from planning through launch.
Maintain roadmap and delivery commitments for multiple teams within the Ad Technology organization, aligning Product, Engineering and GTM on execution plans, ROIs and outcomes (e.g., latency/SLAs, yield/monetization lift, reliability, rollout readiness).
Coordinate program structure, milestones, sequencing, interdependencies, and success metrics in close partnership with engineering and product leadership.
Proactively identify, forecast, and mitigate delivery risks and issues, communicating mitigation plans and status clearly to stakeholders.
Use data to drive sustainable planning and transparent tradeoff discussions for new work or conflicting priorities.
Provide portfolio-level visibility and structured analysis to advise on prioritization and resource allocation decisions.
Drive high-stakes tradeoff decisions (scope, sequencing, resourcing, risk) with Director/VP level engineering and product leadership and be directly accountable for program-level outcomes and delivery across multiple teams.

Technical Leadership & Systems Thinking

Apply proficient architectural literacy across ad-serving, real-time bidding, data pipelines, monetization platforms, and distributed infrastructure.
Guide teams toward scalable, aligned technical solutions by deeply understanding platform constraints and cross-program tradeoffs.
Review system designs, challenge assumptions, and proactively solve downstream impacts across tightly coupled Ads and platform integrations.
Manage capacity, risks, technical debt, velocity, and operational readiness.
Anticipate long-term platform risks and scalability constraints, including across globally distributed systems.
Serve as the go-to Technical Program Manager and subject matter expert for complex cross-program integrations, major platform constraints, and critical cross-domain dependency resolution.

Roadmap Alignment & Program Strategy

Influence roadmap alignment across Ads, Pandora, and related programs.
Own program-level strategy across multiple teams, including dependency mapping, sequencing, and integration planning for complex, ambiguous initiatives where outcomes and constraints evolve.
Co-own Ads Technology program strategy, shaping roadmap prioritization based on business impact, technical feasibility, and cross-program dependencies.

26WD101205, Technical Program Manager , AI/ML

Position Overview

The Platform Services and Emerging Technologies (PSET) team is seeking a Technical Program Manager (TPM) to drive successful delivery of Autodesk's Generative AI Accelerator (GAIA) outcomes.

In this role, you will drive complex, cross-functional programs that move emerging AI capabilities from research into production. You will partner closely with research, engineering, architecture, data, security, legal, and product leadership so that new AI capabilities are delivered responsibly, predictably, and at scale.

This role requires strong technical depth including AI fluency, excellent execution discipline, and the ability to operate effectively across organizations to align priorities, manage risk, and drive outcomes in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.

Responsibilities

Drive end-to-end delivery of GAIA program outcomes, from experimentation through production readiness and adoption
Drive the business outcomes realized through delivery of AI/ML capabilities, partnering with engineering teams and leadership across product integration, platform adoption, and operational scalability
Build and maintain integrated delivery plans across research and engineering teams, ensuring clear milestones, dependencies, and risk management
Drive delivery forecasting, execution tracking, and transparent reporting across program lifecycles
Orchestrate delivery across research, engineering, security, legal, product, and platform teams, following changes downstream to everything they touch
Partner with executive stakeholders, architects, and product leaders to shape strategy, sequencing, and execution plans
Provide clear, actionable status reporting at both executive and team levels, including risks, tradeoffs, and mitigation strategies
Anticipate dependencies and risks rather than discover them, across data, model readiness, and delivery timelines
Support teams with impediment removal, exception handling, and dependency resolution
Use approved AI tools and automation responsibly to create visibility, repeatability, and a single source of truth across delivery, while validating outputs and maintaining human judgment
Champion Agile and Lean delivery practices, supporting self-organizing teams operating in complex environments
Use evidence and validated learning to adapt plans, improving delivery effectiveness, collaboration, and program outcomes
Act as a change agent, helping teams navigate evolving requirements, research uncertainty, and platform priorities

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field
5+ years of experience delivering complex, cross-team initiatives in fast-paced technical environments
3+ years in a TPM, Product Manager, Software Architect, or similar role
Strong understanding of cloud platforms and distributed systems, including APIs and services on AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud
Working knowledge of AI/ML concepts and the software development lifecycle, including how AI-assisted tools are used in delivery
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence across technical and non-technical audiences
Strong problem-solving skills with a bias toward action and outcomes

Preferred Qualifications

Experience delivering AI/ML, Generative AI, data platform, or research-to-production programs
Familiarity with AI systems such as model training and evaluation, inference and serving, or retrieval and vector databases
Understanding of Responsible AI, data governance, privacy, and compliance concepts
Passion for operational excellence, process improvement, and scalable delivery practices

26WD101205 Responsable de programme technique, IA/ML

Aperçu du Poste

L'équipe « Platform Services and Emerging Technologies » (PSET) recherche un responsable de programme technique (TPM) chargé de piloter la mise en œuvre réussie des résultats du programme « Generative AI Accelerator » (GAIA) d'Autodesk.

À ce poste, vous piloterez des programmes complexes et transversaux visant à faire passer les capacités émergentes en IA de la recherche à la production. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les responsables de la recherche, de l’ingénierie, de l’architecture, des données, de la sécurité, des affaires juridiques et des produits afin de garantir que les nouvelles capacités d’IA soient mises en œuvre de manière responsable, prévisible et à grande échelle.

Ce poste exige de solides connaissances techniques, notamment une maîtrise approfondie de l’IA, une excellente discipline d’exécution et la capacité à intervenir efficacement au sein de différentes structures organisationnelles pour aligner les priorités, gérer les risques et obtenir des résultats dans des environnements ambigus et en constante évolution.

Responsabilités

Piloter la mise en œuvre de bout en bout des résultats du programme GAIA, de l’expérimentation à la mise en production et à l’adoption
Piloter les résultats commerciaux obtenus grâce à la mise en œuvre des capacités d’IA/ML, en partenariat avec les équipes d’ingénierie et les responsables dans les domaines de l’intégration des produits, de l’adoption de la plateforme et de l’évolutivité opérationnelle
Élaborer et maintenir des plans de mise en œuvre intégrés entre les équipes de recherche et d’ingénierie, en garantissant la clarté des jalons, des dépendances et de la gestion des risques
Piloter les prévisions de mise en œuvre, le suivi de l’exécution et le reporting transparent tout au long du cycle de vie des programmes
Orchestrer la mise en œuvre entre les équipes de recherche, d’ingénierie, de sécurité, juridiques, produit et de plateforme, en suivant les répercussions en aval sur tout ce qu’elles touchent
Collaborer avec les parties prenantes de la direction, les architectes et les responsables produit pour définir la stratégie, l’enchaînement des étapes et les plans d’exécution
Fournir des rapports d’état clairs et exploitables tant au niveau de la direction qu’au niveau des équipes, incluant les risques, les compromis et les stratégies d’atténuation
Anticiper les dépendances et les risques plutôt que de les découvrir a posteriori, qu’il s’agisse des données, de l’état de préparation des modèles ou des délais de mise en œuvre
Soutenir les équipes en éliminant les obstacles, en gérant les exceptions et en résolvant les dépendances
Utiliser de manière responsable les outils d’IA et d’automatisation approuvés pour garantir la visibilité, la reproductibilité et une source unique de vérité tout au long de la livraison, tout en validant les résultats et en préservant le jugement humain
Promouvoir les pratiques de livraison Agile et Lean, en soutenant les équipes auto-organisées évoluant dans des environnements complexes
S’appuyer sur des données factuelles et des enseignements validés pour adapter les plans, améliorant ainsi l’efficacité de la livraison, la collaboration et les résultats du programme
Agir en tant qu’agent du changement, en aidant les équipes à s’adapter à l’évolution des exigences, aux incertitudes liées à la recherche et aux priorités de la plateforme

Qualifications Minimales

Licence en ingénierie, en informatique, en gestion d’entreprise ou dans un domaine connexe
Au moins 5 ans d’expérience dans la mise en œuvre d’initiatives complexes impliquant plusieurs équipes, au sein d’environnements techniques en constante évolution
Au moins 3 ans d’expérience dans un poste de TPM, de chef de produit, d’architecte logiciel ou dans un rôle similaire
Solide compréhension des plateformes cloud et des systèmes distribués, y compris les API et les services sur AWS, Azure ou Google Cloud
Connaissance pratique des concepts d’IA/ML et du cycle de vie du développement logiciel, notamment de l’utilisation des outils assistés par l’IA dans la mise en œuvre
Excellentes compétences en communication et en gestion des parties prenantes, avec la capacité d’influencer des publics tant techniques que non techniques
Solides compétences en résolution de problèmes, avec une orientation vers l’action et les résultats

Qualifications Souhaitées

Expérience dans la mise en œuvre de programmes d’IA/ML, d’IA générative, de plateformes de données ou de programmes allant de la recherche à la production

new_jobs.title: Technical Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
Our client, a leader in the interactive gaming industry, is looking for an experienced Delivery Manager / Technical Program Manager to support teams focused on Technical Operations (TechOps) and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) for game infrastructure.

This is a highly cross-functional role combining elements of Technical Project Management, Scrum Master leadership, and Product Ownership. You will be responsible for helping two technical teams deliver against quarterly commitments, maintain effective Agile processes, manage priorities and dependencies, and translate stakeholder needs into actionable work.

The ideal candidate comes from an infrastructure, operations, SRE, or similar technical environment and is comfortable working closely with engineering, product, platform, networking, security, and other technical teams. Strong knowledge of Jira workflows and automations is especially important.

Key Responsibilities

Own delivery of multiple initiatives in alignment with product roadmaps and quarterly commitments.
Partner with Product and Engineering leaders to define, document, and communicate quarterly scope, schedules, priorities, and key milestones based on team capacity.
Track committed work through completion and ensure action items are assigned to the appropriate teams.
Identify delivery risks, develop mitigation plans, and proactively drive resolution of blockers and dependencies.
Manage scope changes during the quarter, including coordinating and documenting formal change requests when commitments shift.
Coordinate cross-project dependencies, milestones, releases, and launch activities with other Delivery Managers and technical teams.
Lead Agile ceremonies and ensure Scrum practices are consistently and effectively followed.
Coach teams on Agile and Scrum principles, self-management, planning, and continuous improvement.
Own and maintain Sprint Backlogs in Jira, ensuring priorities and commitments remain clear.
Gather and clarify requirements from studios, stakeholders, and technical teams, particularly for SRE and game infrastructure initiatives.
Prioritize backlog items based on business needs, technical dependencies, and available team capacity.
Help manage competing stakeholder requests and push back appropriately when demand exceeds team capacity.
Facilitate triage of incoming customer and operational tickets through ServiceNow.
Support incident-management processes, including tracking postmortem action items and ensuring follow-up work reaches the appropriate teams.
Establish and coordinate release and launch communications.
Provide program-level performance reporting, delivery visibility, and status updates to internal and external leadership.
Identify and lead process improvements that increase team productivity, predictability, and operational effectiveness.
Help maintain strong communication, collaboration, and team morale across geographically distributed teams.

Must-Have Requirements

8–10 years of relevant experience in technical program management, project management, delivery management, or related roles.
Strong experience managing quarterly commitments, delivery timelines, scope changes, risks, dependencies, and mitigation plans.
Hands-on experience functioning as a Scrum Master and Product Owner, including:

-Running Agile ceremonies.
-Managing and prioritizing backlogs.
-Gathering and refining requirements.
-Balancing stakeholder requests against team capacity.
Strong working knowledge of Jira, including an understanding of how Jira automations operate:

-Triggers, conditions, and actions.
-Automated ticket creation and routing.
-The operational impact of modifying automation logic.
-Understanding that changes to automation rules may affect newly created work differently from existing tickets.
Experience working in an IT infrastructure, Technical Operations, SRE, platform, or production operations environment.
Understanding of:

-Incident management and incident response.
-Postmortems and follow-up action items.
-On-call or operational support processes.
-Observability concepts, including metrics, logging, and alerting.
-Patch and operational change processes.
Experience coordinating work across multiple technical functions such as platform, infrastructure, networking, data, TechOps, and security.
Strong ability to interact with, influence, and align stakeholders at different organizational levels and drive consensus.
Demonstrated experience with strategic planning, facilitation, and presenting information to leadership.
Experience with Jira, Confluence, Google Workspace, and flowcharting/collaboration tools such as Miro, Visio, or Lucidchart.
Must be based in Mexico and able to work primarily during Eastern Time business hours.
Comfortable receiving occasional after-hours communications related to operational incidents.

Strongly Preferred

Experience leading process improvements, rather than solely maintaining established processes.
Familiarity with the setup or use of AI agents within workflow or collaboration platforms, such as Atlassian Rovo or comparable tools.
Experience supporting multiple products, platforms, or technical environments concurrently rather than working exclusively within a single application or team.
Understanding of release and launch management in environments with significant infrastructure and operational dependencies.

Nice to Have

Experience in the video game industry, game production, or technology supporting game development.
Familiarity with both single-player and multiplayer game infrastructure.
Experience supporting infrastructure or operational needs across multiple game titles or studios.
Knowledge of SDK-related development or delivery environments.
Familiarity with ITIL principles or practices.
Bachelor's degree (BA/BS) in a relevant field.
Relevant certifications such as:

-CSPO – Certified Scrum Product Owner
-CSM – Certified ScrumMaster
-PMP – Project Management Professional
-SAFe certification

What Makes Someone Successful in This Role

This role is best suited for someone who is comfortable wearing multiple hats. You should be able to move between program delivery, Agile leadership, product ownership, stakeholder management, and technical operations without losing sight of execution.
The strongest candidates will combine a solid understanding of infrastructure and operational environments with excellent organizational skills and practical knowledge of Jira workflows and automations. This is not a traditional software feature-development PM role—the focus is on keeping complex technical and operational programs organized, predictable, and moving forward.

Coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT), deployment readiness assessments, and go-live planning activities.

Help clients realize value adoption through structured project governance and stakeholder engagement.

new_jobs.title: Principal Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
The Role

Most operations and program management postings read the same: own the roadmap, run the standups, track the Jira tickets, keep the trains on time. That's not this.
We're looking for someone who is energized by the parts of the job that don't have a template yet — a dispute nobody's built the case for, a launch with three unresolved dependencies and no clear owner, a reporting structure that's quietly not working and needs to be redesigned rather than patched. This person will spend as much time deciding what the process should be as executing one that already exists.
You'll sit at the intersection of engineering, product, finance, and the executive team — translating ambiguity into a plan, and a plan into the two paragraphs an executive will actually read.

What You'll Actually Do

Build from zero.
Take on problems that don't come with an owner, a framework, or a clean data set — and build the structure they need as you go, rather than waiting for someone to hand you a process.
Root-cause first.
Diagnose before you propose. Segment the data, isolate the actual root cause, and only then bring a recommendation forward — not the other way around.
Communicate like it matters.
Write and speak in verdicts. Executive updates lead with the conclusion, backed by evidence, with the internal noise filtered out.
Create the source of truth.
Build the artifact that outlives the conversation — the tracker, the scorecard, the playbook — that becomes the thing the rest of the org points to.
Fix root causes, not symptoms.
When something breaks the same way twice, propose the structural fix instead of quietly absorbing the workaround a third time.
Run in parallel.
Hold several unrelated, high-stakes threads at once — a dispute, a launch, an org-design question — without letting any of them drop.
Chase the actual blocker.
Push work forward by naming the specific blocker and the specific owner, not by reporting a general status.

What Makes You Right for This

You're comfortable without a map.
You'd rather be handed a messy, undefined problem than a well-documented one. Ambiguity reads to you as room to design, not as a gap someone forgot to fill in.
You're rigorous about what's actually true.
You won't put a number in front of a decision-maker unless you've checked it. You know the difference between a confirmed figure and a good guess, and you say which one you're giving someone.
You read the room.
You know the version of an update that goes to leadership is not the same as the version that goes to the team working the problem — and you don't default to one for both.
You've created structure before.
You've built something — a system, a process, a proposal — that didn't exist before you built it, and you didn't wait for permission to start.
You lead, with or without the title.
You can direct other people's work through clarity and follow-through, whether or not they report to you. If this role grows into leading a small team, that's a natural extension of how you already operate — not a new skill you'll need to learn.
You self-correct in public.
You're as comfortable being wrong in front of the group as being right — you check your own drafts against the source material and fix them without ego when they've drifted.

What This Role Is Not

To be direct about fit: this isn't a role for someone who wants a fully scoped process to execute against, a fixed set of KPIs to report on, or a job where the ambiguity gets resolved by someone else before it reaches you. If what draws you to operations work is the order and predictability of a mature, well-oiled process, this will feel like the wrong job. If what draws you in is the chance to build the process, and to be trusted with the parts of the business that don't have one yet, this is built for you.

Nice to Have

Experience across more than one functional area — payments, product, finance, or program operations — rather than deep specialization in just one.
A track record of managing disputes, negotiations, or high-stakes external relationships where the strength of your evidence mattered as much as the strength of your argument.
Prior experience directing the work of others, formally or informally — this role may grow into leading a small team.

About RealDefense – Join a Team That’s Making an Impact

Headquartered in Los Angeles, CA, RealDefense LLC is an award-winning software development company known for its flagship product brands, including iolo System Mechanic® and SUPERAntiSpyware®. With a commitment to innovation, RealDefense has consistently earned top ratings from PC Magazine™ and protects over 3 million customers. The RealDefense portfolio also features renowned privacy and security software brands, including MyCleanID, MyCleanPC, USTechSupport, ioloVPN, GetMyDrivers, WarrantyStar, and Support.com.

RealDefense partners with leading consumer brands in the cybersecurity and PC manufacturing sectors to deliver telemetry-enabled monetization solutions. For more information, please visit www.realdefen.se.

new_jobs.description:
Job Description:

At Remitly, we believe everyone deserves the freedom to access, move, and manage their money wherever life takes them. Since 2011, we’ve tirelessly delivered on our promise to customers sending money globally, providing secure, simple, and reliable ways to manage their money, ensuring true peace of mind. Whether it’s supporting loved ones back home, growing a business across continents, or pursuing new opportunities abroad, we’re not just here to move money— we’re here to move our global customers forward.

We’re looking for builders, reimaginers, and global thinkers who want to work at the intersection of technology, trust, and transformation. If that’s you and you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career—we invite you to join over 2,800 passionate Remitlians worldwide who are united by our vision to transform lives with trusted financial services that transcend borders.

The Financial Crimes Compliance team at Remitly is seeking a Program Manager to serve as a strategic, execution-driven partner to the Financial Crimes Lead. This role is a driver of program transformation, control maturity, and governance discipline across Remitly’s AML, Sanctions, and KYC programs. The ideal candidate brings a structured mindset, compliance knowledge, and the ability to lead complex, cross-functional workstreams that span regulatory change management, control design, audit execution, and executive reporting.

The right candidate is a proactive problem-solver who anticipates program needs, identifies gaps before they become issues, and helps translate regulatory and operational complexity into clear, actionable program improvements. They bring credibility with senior stakeholders, thrive in ambiguous environments, and are committed to building best-in-class financial crimes compliance infrastructure at a global fintech operating in high-risk remittance corridors.

What You’ll Do

Strategic Transformation & Change Management

Partner with the Financial Crimes Lead to define, prioritize, and execute strategic program initiatives, translating high-level compliance objectives into structured project plans with clear milestones, owners, and accountability mechanisms.
Lead change management processes for program-level transformations, including policy, procedure, and process overhauls, ensuring stakeholder alignment, effective communication, and sustainable adoption.
Develop and maintain a Financial Crimes program roadmap that integrates regulatory developments, audit findings, control gaps, and I&T dependencies into a unified view of program priorities.
Drive cross-functional alignment on Financial Crimes initiatives, facilitating working groups and steering sessions that bring together Compliance, Legal, Risk, Operations, and Technology stakeholders.
Build and maintain program health metrics that provide the Financial Crimes Lead and senior leadership with a real-time view of program maturity, initiative progress, and risk posture.

Control Management

Serve as the primary liaison between the Financial Crimes program and Controls Testing, leading the end-to-end lifecycle of control creation and amendment — from identifying control gaps through to ratification and implementation.
Work with program subject matter experts to draft new control language and amend existing controls across Sanctions, KYC, and AML program areas, ensuring that control statements are precise, testable, and aligned with regulatory expectations and internal risk appetite.
Map controls to applicable regulatory requirements (e.g., BSA, OFAC regulations, FinCEN guidance, FATF recommendations), maintaining a living regulatory-to-control traceability matrix that demonstrates program coverage and identifies gaps.
Author technical control specifications that define control objectives, key attributes, testing procedures, evidence requirements, and failure thresholds — in a format suitable for both internal validation and external examiner review.
Engage 1LoD operational teams (including Customer Operations, Onboarding, and Payments) to validate control feasibility, confirm operational alignment, and document business acceptance prior to formal control ratification.
Track the status of in-flight control changes through governance forums and ensure that approved control amendments are reflected in policy, procedure, and system configuration documentation.

Issue & Audit Management

Own the Financial Crimes issues register end-to-end, ensuring that management action plans (MAPs) are documented with clear owners, due dates, and measurable completion criteria, and driving accountability across program leads to keep remediation on track.
Lead project management for Financial Crimes audits and GCIT testing cycles (Sanctions, KYC, AML), including building audit response workplans, coordinating evidence collection, managing submission deadlines, and escalating risks to the Financial Crimes Lead.
Proactively monitor MAP aging and escalate overdue items to senior leadership, providing data-driven reporting on issue remediation velocity and program exposure.
Coordinate with Internal Audit, Compliance Testing, and external examiners to ensure audit readiness, and serve as a primary point of contact for document requests and examiner inquiries during active reviews.

Reporting & Management Information

Produce and manage recurring management information reporting, including GOO reporting, Monthly Business Reviews (MBR), quarterly board reporting packages, and ad hoc deliverables — ensuring outputs are analytically rigorous, narratively coherent, and executive-ready.
Aggregate inputs from program leads across Sanctions, KYC, and Transaction Monitoring and synthesize them into structured reporting that clearly communicates program status, risk trends, and remediation progress.
Design and evolve reporting templates, dashboards, and governance calendars to improve the consistency, efficiency, and impact of Financial Crimes management information.

Policy & Procedure Governance

Lead the drafting and periodic review of Financial Crimes policies and procedures, ensuring that documents accurately reflect current regulatory requirements, operational practices, and internal control standards.
Manage the policy governance calendar, proactively identifying documents approaching their review cycle and coordinating the end-to-end review, challenge, and approval workflow across relevant stakeholders.
Maintain version-controlled documentation repositories and ensure that policy changes are effectively communicated to impacted teams as part of a structured change management process.

Regulatory Research & Intelligence

Monitor the regulatory horizon across key Financial Crimes domains (FinCEN, OFAC, FATF, FinTRAC, FCA, and others relevant to Remitly’s corridors) and produce timely, actionable intelligence briefs for program leads and senior leadership.
Analyze newly issued guidance, enforcement actions, and emerging typologies and assess their implications for Remitly’s program controls, policies, and risk appetite, flagging items that require proactive remediation.
Support the development of internal regulatory change management processes that ensure emerging requirements are tracked, assigned, and incorporated into program updates on a structured timeline.

Technology & Initiative Tracking

Own the Financial Crimes technology initiative tracker, maintaining a consolidated view of all in-flight I&T dependencies, milestone progress, escalation needs, and delivery risks.
Act as the primary bridge between Financial Crimes program leads and I&T partners, translating compliance requirements into business requirements and ensuring that technology deliverables remain aligned with program objectives.
Drive accountability on technology-enabled compliance initiatives, facilitating regular cadences with I&T stakeholders and surfacing blockers to the Financial Crimes Lead with recommended resolutions.

What We’re Looking For

Required

3–5 years of experience in compliance program management, financial crimes compliance, regulatory governance, or a related field, ideally within a financial institution, fintech, or MSB environment.
Demonstrated ability to independently lead complex, cross-functional workstreams from inception to completion, with strong project management discipline and a track record of on-time delivery.
Working knowledge of financial crimes compliance frameworks, including BSA/AML, OFAC sanctions regulations, and KYC/CDD requirements.
Strong analytical and written communication skills, including the ability to draft control language, policies, regulatory summaries, and executive-facing materials with precision and clarity.
Experience with control design, control documentation, or regulatory-to-control mapping in a compliance or risk management context.
Proficiency with project tracking tools (e.g., Jira, Asana, or equivalent) and productivity software (Google Workspace or Microsoft 365).

Preferred

Direct experience supporting internal audit responses, regulatory examinations, or compliance testing programs at an MSB, bank, or fintech.
Familiarity with GCIT, second-line testing frameworks, or formal control lifecycle governance processes.
Exposure to sanctions compliance (OFAC, UN, EU, UK) and the technical operational requirements of a global remittance business.
CAMS certification or active progress toward CAMS, CGSS, or equivalent financial crimes credentials.
Experience operating in a high-growth, ambiguous environment where program infrastructure is actively being built and matured.

new_jobs.description:
Join TRG Screen: Building World-Class Teams. One Expert at a Time.

Are you ready to be part of a dynamic team at the forefront of subscription spend management innovation?

At TRG Screen, we're not just redefining how organizations manage their subscription expenses – we're shaping the future of the industry. With cutting-edge solutions and a commitment to excellence, we empower businesses around the globe to optimize their subscription investments and drive sustainable growth.

Join us in our mission to revolutionize subscription management and make a meaningful impact on the way businesses access and utilize critical information. At TRG Screen, your talent and ambition will find a home, where opportunities for growth and advancement abound.

About TRG Screen

TRG Screen is the leading provider of market data and subscription management technology and automation solutions, tailored to the unique needs of financial institutions and legal firms. Our integrated suite of solutions includes market data and subscription spend management, usage management, compliance reporting, and comprehensive managed services, which hundreds of clients worldwide use to remove cumbersome and inaccurate manual processes and gain control over market data and subscription costs at scale. For more than 25 years, TRG Screen has enabled businesses who rely on market data to monitor and strategically manage spending and usage of data and information services, including market data, research, software licenses, consulting and other necessary corporate expenses. TRG Screen solutions give decisionmakers full transparency into subscription spend and usage, enabling them to proactively manage subscription costs at scale, conduct more informed vendor negotiations, improve governance, and avoid unnecessary spending on these mission-critical business services. TRG Screen is headquartered in New York City, with offices in Europe and Asia, as well as a 24x7 client support center in Bangalore, India.

TRG Screen is a portfolio company of Vista Equity Partners, one of the world’s largest and most respected private equity firms.

Project Manager

Job Description

TRG Screen is seeking an experienced Project Manager to join our Insights & Data Caching team, with a primary focus on delivering Submarine implementations for our growing client base. Submarine is TRG Screen's on-premise Bloomberg data caching and intelligent routing proxy solution, helping financial institutions reduce Bloomberg Data License costs through intelligent caching, request routing, and ETL capabilities.

This is a high-impact role working directly with major financial institutions globally. You will own the end-to-end delivery of Submarine implementations, coordinating across client technical teams, TRG Screen's development and solutions engineering functions, and senior stakeholders to ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and to the highest quality standards.

We are looking for someone with a strong sense of ownership and initiative, who can create control and visibility for their customer-facing projects in alignment with programme management and governance best practices. The successful candidate will have the opportunity to make their mark by maturing the onboarding process for the Submarine product.

Responsibilities

Project Delivery

Lead end-to-end delivery of Submarine implementation projects, from initial scoping through to go-live and post-implementation review
Develop and maintain detailed project plans, timelines, and resource schedules
Manage project scope, risks, issues, and dependencies, escalating where appropriate
Coordinate parallel workstreams including technical discovery, infrastructure setup, testing, and client training
Ensure all implementation milestones are met in line with agreed timelines and client expectations
Conduct post-implementation reviews to capture lessons learned and drive continuous improvement

Client Relationship Management

Serve as the primary point of contact for clients throughout the implementation lifecycle
Build strong, trusted relationships with client project sponsors, technical leads, and market data teams
Facilitate regular project status meetings, steering committees, providing clear and concise updates to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Manage client expectations proactively, ensuring transparency around timelines, risks, and deliverables
Support clients in navigating internal approval processes, including IT security, infrastructure, and compliance reviews

Cross-Functional Coordination

Work closely with TRG Screen's Solutions Engineering, Development, and Managed Services teams to coordinate delivery activities
Liaise with the Insights & Data Caching product team to communicate client feedback and implementation learnings
Collaborate with the Sales and Customer Success teams to ensure smooth handover from pre-sales to implementation
Contribute to the development and refinement of Submarine implementation methodology and documentation

Reporting & Governance

Maintain accurate project status reporting using TRG Screen's project management tools
Track and report on key project metrics including delivery timelines, client satisfaction, and issue resolution rates
Contribute to internal governance processes, ensuring all implementations adhere to TRG Screen's quality and security standards

Skills And Qualifications Required

4+ years of project management experience, ideally within a SaaS, fintech, or financial services environment
Proven track record of delivering complex technical implementations on time and within scope
Strong client-facing skills with the ability to manage relationships at both technical and executive levels
Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and competing priorities
Clear and confident communicator, both written and verbal, with experience presenting to senior stakeholders
Familiarity with Bloomberg Data License, reference data, or market data infrastructure is highly advantageous
Experience working with on-premise or hybrid deployment models is a plus
Proficiency in project management tools (e.g., Asana, Jira, Smartsheet, MS Project, or equivalent)
PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent project management certification is desirable
A collaborative, solutions-oriented mindset with a strong attention to detail
Ability to work independently and take ownership of outcomes in a fast-paced environment

Salary Range

$125,000 - $135,000 USD

Join TRG Screen and unlock your potential in an environment where innovation thrives, opportunities abound, and your contributions make a difference. We are an equal opportunities employer. We recognise and value the power of diversity in our workplace and are committed to being an employer of choice for everyone. We welcome and encourage applicants from all backgrounds. All applications for employment are considered strictly on the basis of merit.

We recognize that embracing diverse perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences fosters innovation, enhances problem-solving capabilities, and drives better business outcomes. new_jobs.description:
Job Description:

Company Overview

At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.

Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits.

We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths - whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.

Bank of America is committed to an in-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role-specific responsibilities and business needs.

At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!

London Location Overview

Our London office is based just a stone’s throw from the magnificent St. Paul’s Cathedral on bustling King Edward Street. Here you’ll find modern workspaces and a state-of-the-art auditorium space. In addition, we’re proud to host an onsite restaurant that shares our commitment to sustainability by providing delicious seasonal menus which have been created with the planet in mind. Make sure to take time for yourself and head up to our rooftop terrace and take in the spectacular views across London. Finally, your physical wellness is well-catered for with our onsite gym facilities and medical centre.

Role Description

An exciting opportunity has arisen to join Bank of America’s Digital Asset Transformation capability within the International and Global Enterprise Strategy & Platform groups.

Digital assets are reshaping financial markets, payments, custody, settlement, collateral and client solutions. As the ecosystem develops beyond cryptocurrency into broader financial market infrastructure, the firm is strengthening its capability to identify commercial opportunities, respond to regulatory developments and deliver scalable business outcomes.

We are seeking a commercially minded Digital Asset Transformation Director to shape and drive strategic digital asset initiatives within a global regulated banking environment. The role will assess opportunities across tokenisation, digital securities, stablecoins, digital collateral, custody, settlement and market infrastructure, translating them into clear investment recommendations, business cases, governance proposals, operating models and implementation plans.

This is a senior transformation role extending beyond traditional project management. The successful candidate will bring deep digital asset expertise, strong commercial and strategic judgement, a practical understanding of distributed ledger technology and the ability to navigate complex regulatory and organisational requirements.

Working closely with senior stakeholders across the Digital Asset Platform group and the wider organisation, the Director will lead initiatives from initial assessment through governance, approval and execution. They will partner across business, product, technology, operations, legal, compliance, risk and finance to evaluate where the firm should invest, establish scalable approaches and deliver measurable business outcomes.

The role would suit an experienced strategy, COO, regulatory change, product structuring or transformation leader with significant digital asset experience and a strong track record of turning complex or emerging opportunities into practical, commercially sound solutions.

The Team

The Digital Asset Transformation team sits within the International and Global Enterprise Strategy & Platform groups and leads high-priority digital asset initiatives across the firm.

The team operates at the intersection of:

Digital asset strategy and commercial opportunity assessment
Regulatory engagement and market development
Product, platform and capability structuring
Governance and implementation

Initial priorities span institutional digital assets and emerging financial market infrastructure. The team’s remit will continue to evolve in line with market developments and the firm’s strategic priorities.

The team connects strategy, commercial opportunity, regulatory requirements and enterprise execution to support informed investment decisions and scalable delivery. The team brings together stakeholders across the organisation to deliver practical, scalable and commercially grounded outcomes within a regulated banking environment.

Key Responsibilities

As Director, Digital Asset Transformation, responsibilities may include:

Lead priority digital asset initiatives from initial assessment through approval, implementation and launch.
Evaluate opportunities across tokenisation, digital securities, stablecoins, digital collateral, custody, settlement and emerging market infrastructure.
Develop investment recommendations, business cases and materials for senior management decision-making.
Translate market, regulatory and technology developments into business priorities and executable plans.
Define client value, commercial rationale, delivery requirements and success measures with business leaders.
Build alignment and drive decisions across business, product, technology, operations and corporate functions.
Lead regulatory, governance and control processes, maintaining robust documentation and clear audit trails.
Manage delivery through effective oversight of milestones, dependencies, risks, issues and key decisions.
Shape scalable operating models, including processes, controls, accountabilities and implementation readiness.
Direct cross-functional workstreams and ensure initiatives are commercially viable, operationally practical and aligned across regions.

What We Are Looking For

The successful candidate will bring deep digital asset knowledge, strong commercial judgement and a proven ability to lead complex transformation within a regulated financial services environment.

Key experience and capabilities include:

Significant financial services experience gained within strategy, business management, a COO, regulatory change, transformation, product structuring or enterprise programme leadership.
Meaningful experience delivering initiatives across digital assets, tokenisation, digital securities, distributed ledger technology, digital custody or related financial market infrastructure.
Strong commercial acumen, with the ability to evaluate opportunities, develop business cases and connect strategy to measurable business outcomes.
Strong understanding of regulated banking environments, including governance, risk, controls and operational requirements.
Proven ability to lead complex, cross-functional initiatives involving business, product, technology, operations, legal, compliance and risk.
Experience interpreting regulatory developments and translating them into business impacts, strategic options and executable plans.
Strong senior stakeholder management and influencing skills, including the ability to constructively challenge and build alignment across business and control functions.
Experience developing target operating models, implementation roadmaps, control frameworks, governance proposals and senior management materials.
Strategic thinking and sound judgement, with the ability to connect priorities across businesses and regions and find practical solutions in evolving or ambiguous areas.
Clear communication, presentation and delivery leadership skills, including the ability to simplify complex topics, direct analysis and manage multiple workstreams and priorities.

Skills That Will Help

Knowledge of Global Markets, Global Payments, Securities Services, Transaction Banking, Treasury or wider institutional banking products.
Understanding of institutional digital asset use cases and supporting financial market infrastructure.
Familiarity with digital asset regulation, digital securities frameworks, distributed ledger technology pilot regimes and wider regulatory expectations.
Experience with product approvals, new business initiatives, legal entities, booking models or other governance processes.
Experience engaging external partners, fintechs, custodians, exchanges, infrastructure providers or industry bodies.
Advanced PowerPoint, Word and Excel capability.

Benefits Of Working At Bank Of America

UK

At Bank of America, we strive to prioritise employees’ health and wellbeing – it’s what makes us a Great Place to Work.
Private healthcare for you and your family plus an annual health screen to help you manage your physical wellness with the option to purchase a screen for your partner.
Competitive pension plan, life assurance and group income protection cover if you become unable to work as a result of a disability or health reasons.
We offer 26-weeks paid maternity leave, 16-weeks paid paternity leave and inclusive family leave arrangements for working parents and carers including 20 days of back-up childcare including access to school holiday clubs and 20 days of back-up adult care per annum.
20 days of back-up childcare including access to school holiday clubs and 20 days of back-up adult care per annum.
The ability to change your core benefits as well as the option of selecting a variety of flexible benefits to suit your personal circumstances including access to a wellbeing account, travel insurance, critical illness, cycle to work etc.
Access to free counselling through the Employee Assistance Program and virtual GP services through our private health care plan.
Access to an Employee Assistance Program for confidential support and help for everyday matters.
Ability to donate to charities of your choice directly through payroll and the bank will match your contribution.
Opportunity to access our Arts & Culture corporate membership program and receive discounted entry to some of the UK’s most iconic cultural institutions and exhibitions.
Opportunity to give back to your community, develop new skills and work with new groups of people by volunteering in your local community.

Bank of America

Good conduct and sound judgment is crucial to our long term success. It’s important that all employees in the organisation understand the expected standards of conduct and how we manage conduct risk. Individual accountability and an ownership mind-set are the cornerstones of our Code of Conduct and are at the heart of managing risk well.

We are an equal opportunities employer and ensure that no applicant is subject to less favourable treatment on the grounds of sex, gender identity or gender reassignment, marital or civil partner status, race, religion or belief, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origins, age, sexual orientation, pregnancy or maternity, socio-economic background, responsibility for dependants or physical or mental disability. Each day, our professionals provide exceptional service, helping clients with advice and insight they can trust. Your Opportunity

BDO is seeking a Project Manager, ServiceNow
to join our growing Solution Operations Advisory practice. As part of our expanding ServiceNow team, you will lead the successful delivery of client transformation initiatives focused on ServiceNow IT Service Management (ITSM), Customer Service Management (CSM), platform modernization programs, legacy service management migrations, security and risk implementations and AI-enabled projects.

This new role is critical to helping organizations transform from traditional ticket-centric operations into modern, service-oriented, and experience-driven organizations. You will be responsible for leading project delivery from initiation through deployment and transition to operations, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within scope, and aligned to client business objectives.

The successful candidate will work closely with ServiceNow Solution Architects, Consultants, Developers, and client stakeholders to establish project governance, manage delivery risks, coordinate resources, and drive successful outcomes across complex ServiceNow implementations.

This is a highly collaborative, client-facing role that combines project leadership, stakeholder management, service management expertise, and ServiceNow delivery experience.

Project Leadership & Delivery Management

Lead ServiceNow implementation and transformation projects through all phases of the project lifecycle, including initiation, planning, execution, deployment, and transition to operations.
Develop and manage project plans, schedules, budgets, resource allocations, governance documentation, and delivery roadmaps.
Manage project scope, timelines, risks, dependencies, issues, and change requests while maintaining alignment to business objectives.
Establish project governance frameworks and reporting mechanisms to ensure transparency and accountability across stakeholders.
Facilitate project status meetings, steering committees, executive updates, workshops, and stakeholder forums.
Coordinate activities across client teams, ServiceNow architects, consultants, developers, QA teams, and operational stakeholders.
Ensure project deliverables meet quality expectations and align with client requirements and ServiceNow leading practices.

Stakeholder Management & Client Advisory

Build trusted relationships with client sponsors, business leaders, Product Owners, and technical stakeholders.
Serve as the primary point of contact for project communications, escalations, governance, and issue resolution.
Partner with clients to define project goals, success criteria, implementation strategies, and operating model considerations.
Facilitate alignment between business and technical teams during planning, design, development, testing, and deployment activities.
Provide guidance and recommendations on project approaches, service management transformation initiatives, and implementation best practices.

ServiceNow Transformation Delivery

Lead projects involving ServiceNow ITSM, Customer Service Management (CSM), workflow automation, platform modernization, and service transformation initiatives.
Manage platform transition programs involving legacy service management platforms such as security and risk implementations, and AI-enabled projects.
Coordinate functional discovery, solution design, testing, deployment, release planning, and operational readiness activities.
Work closely with Solution Architects and Functional Leads to ensure business requirements are effectively translated into ServiceNow solutions.
Monitor project health, identify risks early, and implement mitigation strategies to support successful delivery.

Change Management & Adoption

Support organizational change and adoption initiatives throughout project delivery.
Coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT), deployment readiness assessments, and go-live planning activities.
Collaborate with functional teams to ensure training materials, communications, and user enablement activities are effectively executed.
Support service transition and early life support activities following production deployment.
Help clients realize value adoption through structured project governance and stakeholder engagement.

Governance & Continuous Improvement

Establish and maintain project governance standards, delivery methodologies, and reporting practices.
Monitor key project performance indicators and provide regular project reporting to clients and leadership teams.
Identify opportunities to improve delivery processes, project controls, governance frameworks, and implementation methodologies.
Contribute to reusable project assets, accelerators, templates, and best practices within BDO's growing ServiceNow Advisory practice.
Support internal knowledge-sharing and practice development initiatives related to ServiceNow delivery and service management transformation.

You demonstrate BDO's core values through all aspects of your work: Integrity, Respect, and Collaboration.
You understand your clients' industries, challenges, and opportunities; clients describe you as positive, professional, and delivering high-quality work.
You identify, recommend, and are focused on effective service delivery to your clients.
You foster an inclusive and engaging work environment that develops, retains, and attracts talent.
You actively participate in the adoption of digital tools and innovative strategies that drive client and team success.
You continuously grow your expertise through learning and professional development.
You successfully deliver ServiceNow projects while maintaining strong stakeholder relationships and project governance.
You proactively identify and mitigate project risks, helping clients achieve desired business outcomes.
You contribute to the growth and maturity of BDO's ServiceNow and Solution Operations practices.

Your Experience And Education

5+ years of experience managing technology, enterprise application, digital transformation, or service management projects.
Experience leading ServiceNow implementation, enhancement, upgrade, or transformation initiatives.
Strong understanding of ServiceNow ITSM and/or Customer Service Management (CSM).
Experience managing project scope, budgets, resources, timelines, risks, and stakeholder expectations.
Knowledge of Agile, Waterfall, and hybrid project delivery methodologies.
Strong understanding of ITIL principles and service management best practices.
Proven experience managing cross-functional teams across business and technical environments.
Experience supporting ServiceNow platform transitions from legacy service management solutions.
Strong facilitation, leadership, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
Experience working directly with executive, operational, and technical stakeholders.
Exposure to AI-enabled service management capabilities including workflow automation, intelligent routing, self-service, and digital service experiences.
Bachelor's degree or diploma in Information Technology, Business Administration, Project Management, or a related discipline.

Preferred Qualifications

Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
Certified Scrum Master (CSM) or equivalent Agile certification.
ITIL Foundation or higher certification.
ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) (nice to have)
ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist (ITSM or CSM) (nice to have)
Experience within consulting, advisory, managed services, or professional services environments.
Experience with enterprise service management, service operations, and large-scale technology transformation programs.

The expected range of compensation for this role is $84,000 - $128,000 annually.

Why BDO?

Our people-first approach to talent has earned us a spot among Canada’s Top 100 Employers for 2026. This recognition is a milestone we’re thrilled to add to our collection of awards for both experienced and student talent experiences.

At BDO, our people experience is guided by three core pillars— Do work with genuine care, Do what matters with purpose, and Do what’s next
- shaping how we support our people, serve our clients, and grow together.

The Online Threat Intelligence Analyst supports Corporate Security by identifying, capturing, and processing threat-related information sourced from open-source and online environments that may impact the company, executives, employees, facilities, or critical assets.

Operating under established procedures and escalation guidelines, the analyst monitors and reviews online OSINT sources-including social media platforms, forums, messaging applications, and traditional media-to detect potential threats, concerning narratives, or indicators of targeting. Information is collected, documented, and processed to enable further analysis by senior intelligence analysts and threat management personnel.

Primary Responsibilities

Monitor and review open-source and online environments for potential threats, concerning behaviors, or indicators of targeting directed at the company, its executives, employees, facilities, or operations
Identify and capture threat-related content from social media, online forums, blogs, messaging platforms, and other publicly available digital sources
Triage online threat information to determine relevance, credibility, and potential risk indicators based on established criteria and guidance
Accurately document and log online threat information, source details, timestamps, and contextual observations in approved tracking systems, case management tools, or intelligence repositories
Conduct initial processing of collected information, organizing content to support downstream analysis by senior analysts and Threat Management or Executive Protection teams
Draft concise factual summaries of identified online threats or concerning content for review, escalation, or incorporation into intelligence products
Escalate time-sensitive or credible threat indicators in accordance with defined protocols and supervisory guidance
Support senior analysts with information collection, basic research, and content verification related to online threat cases or investigative efforts
Maintain operational discipline by adhering to documentation standards, privacy considerations, and handling requirements for sensitive information
Collaborate with Corporate Security partners and intelligence team members to ensure consistent threat intake and information-sharing practices
Support rotational operational coverage, as required, to ensure continuity of online threat monitoring and intake functions
Comply with the terms and conditions of the employment contract, company policies and procedures, and any and all directives (such as, but not limited to, transfer and/or re-assignment to different work locations, change in teams and/or work shifts, policies in regards to flexibility of work benefits and/or work environment, alternative work arrangements, and other decisions that may arise due to the changing business environment). The Company may adopt, vary or rescind these policies and directives in its absolute discretion and without any limitation (implied or otherwise) on its ability to do so

Required Qualifications

3+ years of experience in intelligence, investigations, security operations, online research, or a related analytical field; relevant academic experience or internships may be considered
Familiarity with open-source intelligence (OSINT) concepts, social media platforms, and online research techniques
Proficiency with standard office productivity tools (e.g., Microsoft Office applications)
Demonstrated ability to review and process online content efficiently while identifying relevant threat-related details
Proven solid written communication skills, with the ability to document information clearly, accurately, and objectively
Proven high attention to detail and ability to follow defined intake, documentation, and escalation procedures
Proven ability to work effectively in a structured, process-driven environment handling sensitive or high-interest information
Proven solid organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple information streams and competing priorities
Proven attention to detail and information accuracy
Proven structured analytic thinking within defined guidelines
Proven operational discipline and adherence to procedures
Proven clear and objective written communication
Proven information organization and documentation
Proven sound judgment and escalation awareness
Proven collaboration and teamwork
Proven professional discretion when handling sensitive information

Working Conditions

In-person role based within the Regional Security Operations Center in Gurgaon, India
Fast-paced, detail-oriented operational environment supporting threat awareness and protective intelligence functions
Shift‑based schedule supporting 24/7/365 operational coverage, including nights and weekends

The Intelligence Operations Analyst provides real-time monitoring and situational awareness within the Global Intelligence Operations (GIO) - Intelligence Operations Center (IOC), focusing on emerging incidents and security developments that could impact company personnel, assets, operations, or major activities.

Operating under established procedures and escalation protocols, the analyst tracks a range of hazards, including crime, civil unrest, terrorism, environmental threats, and public safety events, to deliver timely situational awareness, initial assessments, and reporting that support operational decision-making during routine and crisis situations.

This role supports senior intelligence professionals by ensuring accurate, current information is available for effective incident management and organizational continuity.

Primary Responsibilities

Conduct continuous, real-time, all-source monitoring of global security events using open-source intelligence (OSINT), traditional media, and social media platforms to identify incidents and emerging risks with potential company impact
Triage incoming information and alerts, identifying relevant and actionable details affecting employees, facilities, operations, executive travel, or major corporate activities
Provide initial situational awareness and preliminary operational context for security incidents, including natural disasters, civil unrest, terrorism, criminal activity, active assailant events, and other disruptive threats
Draft and disseminate timely incident notifications, flash alerts, and situational updates in accordance with established ESOC, CSOC, and Corporate Security procedures
Maintain heightened monitoring during elevated threat periods, ensuring consistent information escalation on events impacting employee safety, assets, or operational continuity
Assist senior analysts with information collection, research, and data aggregation in support of incident response, trend tracking, special projects, or deeper analytical products
Accurately capture and maintain incident logs, alerts, and actions taken during shifts in accordance with established documentation standards to support continuity and after action review
Collaborate with ESOC personnel, Corporate Security partners, and cross-functional stakeholders to ensure consistent situational awareness and information sharing
Support rotational shift coverage, including nights, weekends, and holidays, to ensure uninterrupted 24/7/365 global monitoring coverage
Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

Required Qualifications

1+ years of experience in a security operations center, intelligence, emergency management, international relations, or a related field; relevant academic experience or internships may be considered
Basic familiarity with OSINT sources, social media monitoring, and situational awareness tools
Proficiency with standard office productivity tools (e.g., Microsoft Office applications)
Demonstrated ability to rapidly review large volumes of information and identify relevant, time-sensitive, and actionable details
Demonstrated solid written communication skills with the ability to summarize complex, fast-moving situations clearly and concisely
Demonstrated ability to remain calm, focused, and detail-oriented in high-tempo or high-stress operational environments
Demonstrated solid organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and competing priorities simultaneously
Ability to work effectively within a rotational, shift-based schedule supporting 24/7 operations

Preferred Qualifications

Demonstrated situational awareness and attention to detail
Demonstrated operational discipline and adherence to defined procedures
Demonstrated analytical thinking within established guidelines
Demonstrated clear and concise written communication
Demonstrated professional adaptability in a fast-paced operational environment

new_jobs.title: Program Analyst
new_jobs.description:
Don't just watch the future unfold—build it. The Air Force Civilian Service is at the forefront of innovation, from developing next-generation aircraft to creating revolutionary cyber defense systems. We are seeking the brightest minds to join our team.

The Air Force Civilian Service (AFCS) is looking for a Full-Time Program Analyst-NH-0343-03 at Offutt AFB, Nebraska.

The purpose of this job is to deter strategic attack through a safe, secure, effective, and credible, global combat capability and, when directed, ready to prevail in conflict. The incumbent analyzes and evaluate issues, develop recommendations, and determine necessary policies, regulations, directives, programs, doctrine, resources and procedures for the establishment and maintenance of assigned major command program(s) and to resolve substantive problems and issues.

The ideal candidate will have experience monitoring and evaluating space, intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance programs. The candidate should possess a strong understanding of the defense acquisition process, Planning, Programming, Budgeting, and Execution (PPBE), and the Joint Capabilities Integration and Development System (JCIDS). The ideal candidate will also have experience supporting special operations requirements, conducting program reviews, assessing program performance, and providing recommendations to senior leaders to support informed resource and acquisition decisions.

SALARY RANGE: $76,463 - $118,204 per year without locality.

Value of Position (VOP):
If your current basic salary is within the band, but above the stated VOP, your basic salary will not be reduced if you are selected for the position.

AcqDemo positions are exempt from the 180 day restriction in 5 USC 3326, Appointments of retired members of the armed forces to positions in the Department of Defense, when filled using AcqDemo-specific direct hire authorities. This clarification will materially accelerate hiring actions involving recently retired active-duty service members.

Afcs Benefits

Paid Time Off: 11 Federal Holidays each year 13 sick leave days earned per year (accumulative)
Paid Vacation Time: 13-26 days per year based on length of employment
Health Insurance: No waiting period to qualify for you and your family
Retirement: Immediate coverage by the Federal Employees Retirement System (FERS) Basic Benefits Plan
Social Security: Thrift Savings Plan (TSP), such as; 401(k) (Automatically receive 1% agency contributions and up to 5% matching)

This position can be closed at any time. Apply Now! All federal resumes must be no more than two (2) pages.

Duties And Responsibilities

Provides expertise and advocacy for programs related to assigned mission areas of strategic deterrence, global strike, nuclear operations and electromagnetic spectrum operations (EMSO), and enabling capabilities in space; nuclear command, control, and communications (NC3); data and analytics; cyberspace operations; and intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR).
Identifies nonstandard or emerging operational requirements, assesses impact on assigned programs, and develops recommendations. Prepares briefings, correspondence, reports, and other documents for cross-directorate coordination and executive approval.
Prepares detailed plans, budgets, and schedules for strategic deterrence, Combined Joint All Domain Command and Control (CJADC2), NC3, EMSO, space, cyberspace operations, data analytics and ISR programs and/or participates with management in fiscal planning, programming, and advocating.
Secures cooperation, resolves controversial matters, and conveys information relative to proposed changes in the assigned strategic deterrence, CJADC2, NC3, EMSO, space, data analytics, cyberspace operations, and ISR programs.

KNOWLEDGE SKILLS AND ABILITIES:

Knowledge of program goals and objectives; the sequence and timing of key operational events and milestones; methods of evaluating the effectiveness of planning actions related to actual events; and the relationship of the various command entities involved in overall program planning and execution of military operations and evaluations.
Knowledge of a wide range of qualitative and/or quantitative methods to participate in the assessment and improvement of command level plans and programs for conducting major operations such as: advocating future concepts; mission capability needs; PPBE; JCIDS; acquisition; special operations, Program review, and System Requirements Review.
Knowledge of the application of program expertise to expertly plan, analyze, and evaluate the effectiveness of assigned mission areas sufficient to determine the impact on program operations.
Skill in designing and conducting comprehensive studies to evaluate an assigned program’s effectiveness and efficiency, preparing solutions to resolve substantive problems, and the ability to communicate findings to senior leaders.
Ability to plan, organize, and negotiate effectively with senior analysts and management for the identification, consideration, resolution, acceptance, and implementation of recommendations for issues that involve substantial resources and require extensive changes in established concepts and procedures.
Ability to communicate clearly, concisely, and effectively, both orally and in writing; negotiate complex issues; and maintain good working relationships. Knowledge or experience with one or more of the assigned mission areas of strategic deterrence, combined joint all-domain command and control (CJADC2), nuclear command, control, and communications (NC3), electromagnetic spectrum operations (EMSO), space, cyberspace operations, and/or intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR) sufficient to apply program expertise to the assessment of mission capability needs.

Additional Position Requirements

Position is designated special-sensitive and requires a TOP SECRET (TS) security clearance with eligibility for access to Sensitive Compartmented Information (SCI), other intelligence-related Special Sensitive information, or involvement in Top Secret Special Access Programs (SAP) to fully perform the duties and responsibilities of the position. A non-disclosure agreement must be signed. Employee must be able to obtain and maintain a Top-Secret w/SCI clearance.
This position is designated as a Testing Designated Position (TDP) under the Air Force Civilian Drug Testing Program.
May be required to travel by military or commercial aircraft in the performance of TDY assignments.
Required to handle and safeguard sensitive and/or classified information in accordance with regulations to reduce potential compromise.
May be required to work overtime on an unscheduled or emergency basis.
Employee may need to obtain and maintain approval to access the portfolio of Special Access Programs required to perform daily duties.
Nuclear, IAMD, and protection experience is preferred but not essential.

You will be evaluated for this job based on how well you meet the qualifications above.

Your application package (resume, supporting documents) will be used to determine your eligibility, and qualifications.

Click the apply button to complete an application and upload your two-page resume to comply with the Merit Hiring Plan (PDF or Word Doc) and/or additional documents (Transcripts, certifications, Vet Docs (DD214), SF-50).

As of 27 September 2025, Federal agencies will only accept resumes up to two pages in length.
