Employee Applicant Privacy Notice

Who we are:

Shape a brighter financial future with us.

Together with our members, we’re changing the way people think about and interact with personal finance.

We’re a next-generation financial services company and national bank using innovative, mobile-first technology to help our millions of members reach their goals. The industry is going through an unprecedented transformation, and we’re at the forefront. We’re proud to come to work every day knowing that what we do has a direct impact on people’s lives, with our core values guiding us every step of the way. Join us to invest in yourself, your career, and the financial world.

About The Role

SoFi is seeking a Senior Staff, Fraud Strategy Analyst to assess, quantify, and mitigate fraud and operational risk associated with debit card authorization activity across SoFi's card ecosystem. This individual contributor will be responsible for conducting quantitative and qualitative risk assessments, evaluating the effectiveness of risk controls, identifying areas of potential loss or exposure, developing risk mitigation strategies, and partnering across Fraud Strategy, Fraud Operations, Product, Engineering, Data, Disputes, Compliance, Risk, and vendor teams.

You will focus on debit card authorization risk across account takeover, wallet and tokenized transactions, 3DS, card-not-present, card-present, ATM activity, high-risk merchants, and override treatments. You will work closely with Fraud Strategy, Fraud Operations, Product, Engineering, Data, Disputes, Compliance, Risk, and vendor partners to move from insight to controlled execution.

What you’ll do

Own fraud strategy analysis and recommendations for debit card authorization controls.
Analyze transaction, alert, dispute, chargeback, rule, device, profile-change, wallet, 3DS, merchant, and loss data.
Develop and optimize fraud rules, thresholds, treatments, exclusions, and monitoring plans.
Evaluate rule effectiveness, false positives, customer friction, operational impact, and residual risk.
Partner with platform and vendor teams to implement, validate, and monitor strategy changes.
Document strategy decisions, rule logic, test results, governance approvals, and post-implementation outcomes.
Build executive-ready recommendations that balance fraud loss reduction, member experience, operational feasibility, and governance requirements.
Support durable reporting and control observability so leaders can understand fraud trends, rule health, and customer impact.

What you’ll need

12+ years of experience in fraud strategy, fraud analytics, card fraud, payments risk, financial crimes, or related risk analytics.
Strong SQL skills and experience working with large transaction-level datasets.
Experience analyzing rule, alert, transaction, dispute, fraud loss, or authorization data.
Ability to evaluate fraud controls using quantitative performance metrics and qualitative risk judgment.
Strong communication skills and ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders.
Strong ownership mindset and ability to drive strategy work from analysis through implementation and monitoring.

Nice to have

Debit card, credit card, payment authorization, or issuing processor experience.
Experience with PRP, DataVisor, Snowflake, Tableau, or similar platforms.
Experience with ATO, wallet/tokenized fraud, 3DS, CNP, CP, ATM, merchant/MCC risk, scams, or dispute abuse.
Experience in regulated financial services, including fraud governance, audit, SLOD, or compliance-facing documentation.

We are Starling. We started by building a new kind of bank because we knew technology had the power to transform how people save, spend, and manage their money. Today, our ambition and our footprint have grown.
Our ecosystem encompasses our pioneering, fully licensed UK bank (Starling), our global Software-as-a-Service technology platform (Engine by Starling), alongside a growing portfolio of specialist financial and software businesses.
While our roots are in the UK, our operations are expanding globally. Though you may be based in one of our international offices (such as Sydney or Toronto), this role is critical to the entire Starling Group. The work you do will support, empower, and protect our businesses worldwide.
Our technologists are at the very heart of Starling and enjoy working in a fast-paced environment that is all about building things, creating new stuff, and leveraging disruptive technology that keeps us on the cutting edge of fintech. Responsibilities

Collect, aggregate, and analyze data from multiple internal and external sources, including structured and unstructured data sets, to drive insights into digital performance, member behavior, employee experience, and business outcomes.

Evaluate new digital enhancements before and after release by defining success measures, establishing baselines, monitoring adoption and performance, and identifying usability, journey, or experience opportunities.
Identify, analyze, and interpret trends or patterns across digital journeys and prepare ongoing reports and data visualizations, including charts, dashboards, heat maps, funnels, and scorecards, to support business decisions.
Produce actionable reports that show key performance indicators, identify areas of improvement in current operations, and display root cause analysis of digital performance or experience issues.
Use analytics and metrics to improve processes and provide data-driven forecasts of potential costs, risks, member impacts, employee impacts, and benefits of new business or digital initiatives.
Understand data gaps and connect data components across systems to support reliable reporting, visualization, and digital product performance measurement.
Provide reporting solutions and respond to ad-hoc report requests across Digital and partner business areas, including Product, Marketing, Contact Center Operations, IT, Member Service Operations, and Risk partners as appropriate.
Create specifications for reports, analysis, dashboards, and measurement plans based on business needs, product objectives, digital release plans, and required or available data elements.
Assist with the development and enhancement of practices, procedures, data definitions, measurement standards, and documentation that improve consistency across Digital reporting.
Develop and maintain strong working relationships with team members, subject matter experts, product owners, journey owners, and leaders; work with senior management on complex issues as needed.
Lead small to medium projects and support larger initiatives that improve Digital BI capabilities, strengthen performance management, or advance digital experience measurement.
Provide guidance to lower level staff on analytic methods, dashboard design, stakeholder communication, and root cause analysis.
Manage a portfolio of dashboards and analytic products, monitor usage and performance, and make recommendations to management for enhancements, retirements, or governance changes.

Qualifications

7+ years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, reporting, or digital analytics.
Advanced skill using business intelligence applications and/or cloud services to develop reporting, dashboards, and analytic solutions.
Advanced knowledge of reporting capabilities from enterprise data platforms, ERP, CRM, digital analytics, product analytics, or database software vendors.
Advanced skill using statistical methods, mathematical techniques, forecasting, cost-benefit analysis, experiment measurement, and root cause analysis.
Advanced skill with data analysis tools and programming languages such as Python, R, SQL, or comparable analytic tools.
Advanced knowledge of reporting and dashboarding best practices, data storytelling, data visualization, data research, and root cause analysis techniques.
Strong stakeholder management skills, with demonstrated ability to influence business partners and translate complex analysis into clear recommendations.
Advanced knowledge of data integration, data quality, cleaning, validation, metadata, and measurement governance techniques.
Advanced research skills, including the ability to complete data research, business research, reporting and dashboarding best practices research, needs assessments, and digital performance analysis.
Strong interpersonal, facilitation, and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across technical and non-technical audiences.

DESIRED

Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Statistics, Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field, or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience.
Experience supporting mobile, online banking, digital product, digital experience, or employee-facing technology analytics.
Experience developing dashboards, scorecards, release measurement plans, funnel analysis, journey analytics, or feature adoption reporting.
Experience with Power BI, SQL-based data environments, digital analytics platforms, product telemetry, survey/voice-of-member data, or contact center/digital interaction data.

Establishing key metrics that drive business impact - what are the right things that we should measure to understand the change. Measuring impact - establishing event date, measuring pre-period and post-period to determine lift/change, and reducing noise by accounting for factors that may impact the trend but are not related to the event being measured. Stakeholder management - keeping various teams updated on progress and obstacles

Nice to haves: Databricks Agile framework familiarity LLM / AI adobe analytics

new_jobs.description:
Defend the systems that hold hundreds of thousands of people's employment data.

Vensure Employer Solutions is one of North America's largest privately held employer-services organizations. Strong analytical and critical-thinking ability, including risk assessment

Genuine team-player instincts across cross-functional groups

A good fit if~ you are early in a security career and want real incident work rather than dashboard watching. This is a defensive security operations role with a clear path to deepen in incident response, vulnerability management, or compliance. new_jobs.description:
Employee Applicant Privacy Notice

Who we are:

Shape a brighter financial future with us.

Together with our members, we’re changing the way people think about and interact with personal finance.

We’re a next-generation financial services company and national bank using innovative, mobile-first technology to help our millions of members reach their goals. The industry is going through an unprecedented transformation, and we’re at the forefront. We’re proud to come to work every day knowing that what we do has a direct impact on people’s lives, with our core values guiding us every step of the way. Join us to invest in yourself, your career, and the financial world.

About The Role

SoFi is seeking a Senior Staff, Fraud Strategy Analyst to assess, quantify, and mitigate fraud and operational risk associated with debit card authorization activity across SoFi's card ecosystem. This individual contributor will be responsible for conducting quantitative and qualitative risk assessments, evaluating the effectiveness of risk controls, identifying areas of potential loss or exposure, developing risk mitigation strategies, and partnering across Fraud Strategy, Fraud Operations, Product, Engineering, Data, Disputes, Compliance, Risk, and vendor teams.

You will focus on debit card authorization risk across account takeover, wallet and tokenized transactions, 3DS, card-not-present, card-present, ATM activity, high-risk merchants, and override treatments. You will work closely with Fraud Strategy, Fraud Operations, Product, Engineering, Data, Disputes, Compliance, Risk, and vendor partners to move from insight to controlled execution.

What you’ll do

Own fraud strategy analysis and recommendations for debit card authorization controls.
Analyze transaction, alert, dispute, chargeback, rule, device, profile-change, wallet, 3DS, merchant, and loss data.
Develop and optimize fraud rules, thresholds, treatments, exclusions, and monitoring plans.
Evaluate rule effectiveness, false positives, customer friction, operational impact, and residual risk.
Partner with platform and vendor teams to implement, validate, and monitor strategy changes.
Document strategy decisions, rule logic, test results, governance approvals, and post-implementation outcomes.
Build executive-ready recommendations that balance fraud loss reduction, member experience, operational feasibility, and governance requirements.
Support durable reporting and control observability so leaders can understand fraud trends, rule health, and customer impact.

What you’ll need

12+ years of experience in fraud strategy, fraud analytics, card fraud, payments risk, financial crimes, or related risk analytics.
Strong SQL skills and experience working with large transaction-level datasets.
Experience analyzing rule, alert, transaction, dispute, fraud loss, or authorization data.
Ability to evaluate fraud controls using quantitative performance metrics and qualitative risk judgment.
Strong communication skills and ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders.
Strong ownership mindset and ability to drive strategy work from analysis through implementation and monitoring.

Nice to have

Debit card, credit card, payment authorization, or issuing processor experience.
Experience with PRP, DataVisor, Snowflake, Tableau, or similar platforms.
Experience with ATO, wallet/tokenized fraud, 3DS, CNP, CP, ATM, merchant/MCC risk, scams, or dispute abuse.
Experience in regulated financial services, including fraud governance, audit, SLOD, or compliance-facing documentation.

page!

About The Role

The Security Manager is the tactical owner of day-to-day security operations at XTIUM. This role coordinates internal teams and external partners to manage alerts, incidents, vulnerability remediation, testing follow-up, and control execution. The Manager ensures security work is translated into clear tickets, owners, deadlines, and evidence, while maintaining strong operating discipline and communication. Manage daily security operations workflows across ESD, Ascent, and internal stakeholders, including triage, escalation, and follow-through.
Coordinate incident response activities, maintain playbooks, and ensure evidence, timelines, and decisions are documented.
Track vulnerability findings, penetration test results, and CTEM actions through remediation, retesting, and closure.
Monitor security metrics and prepare recurring reporting on cases, remediation status, exceptions, and control performance.
Drive operational handoffs between Tier 1 intake, SOC escalation, engineering remediation, and business owners.
Support audits and customer assurance requests by collecting evidence, validating control execution, and maintaining documentation.
Identify process gaps and execute improvements to strengthen security operations, service quality, and response readiness.

Job Qualifications

5+ years of experience in security operations, incident response, vulnerability management, or related operational security roles.
Experience working with MSSP, MDR, SOC, SIEM, or managed detection partners in a co-managed operating model.
Familiarity with security case management, playbooks, ticketing workflows, and escalation processes in a fast-paced IT services environment.
Working knowledge of Microsoft Sentinel, endpoint telemetry platforms such as CrowdStrike, and common logging or alert triage practices.
Strong communication and coordination skills, with the ability to keep technical and non-technical stakeholders aligned on actions and status.
Ability to manage competing priorities, push remediation to closure, and maintain disciplined documentation and follow-up.
Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience required; Security+, GCIH, GCIA, CISSP, or similar certification preferred.

The salary range for this position is $100,000 - $130,000/annually. Ensure accuracy and consistency in trade data, documentation, and system configurations supporting export and customs compliance.

Drive continuous improvement initiatives leveraging digital tools and automation to enhance compliance monitoring and reporting.

Support internal investigations and voluntary disclosures, when applicable.

Promote a culture of compliance through proactive communication and cross-functional collaboration.

Partner with IT, Supply Chain, and Finance to ensure trade compliance considerations are embedded in business processes.

Provide input in communications with government authorities and external consultants regarding trade compliance projects and inquiries.

10+ years of progressive experience in global trade compliance, covering export controls, customs, sanctions, and trade agreements.

Deep understanding of U.S., EU, and Canadian export control and sanctions laws, with additional experience in UK, Swiss, Chinese, and other jurisdictions considered an asset.

Proven track record in managing large-scale trade compliance or ERP integration projects within a multinational organization.

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, International Business, Law, Supply Chain, or related discipline; PMP or other project management certification preferred.

new_jobs.title: Business Analyst
new_jobs.description:
Together we are Trusted to Serve Scotland.

How’s this for job satisfaction?

At Scottish Water, we look after Scotland’s most precious natural resource. From source to tap, we’re safeguarding Scotland’s reputation for refreshingly pure water and caring for our environment at the same time. If making a positive difference to people, communities and the environment sounds like something you'd enjoy, we'd love to hear from you.

What You’ll Do

As part of the ICC Business Support Team, you'll play a key role in supporting Project Compass and Scottish Water's wider transformation programme, helping maximise the value of our Data Lakehouse, telemetry data, and operational information assets. The role will focus heavily on data analysis, business intelligence, automation, and performance insight generation to support operational excellence across the business.

Working closely with the ICC Management Team to support our stakeholders across Scottish Water, you'll collect, analyse, and interpret large and complex datasets from a variety of operational, customer, and asset management systems. Using advanced analytical techniques and modern data tools, you'll transform raw data into meaningful insights that support evidence-based decision-making and drive measurable business improvements.

A major part of the role will involve designing, developing, and maintaining dashboards, reports, and automated solutions using technologies such as Power BI, SQL, Python, and Power Automate to implement workflows. You'll identify trends, patterns, risks, and opportunities within operational data, providing actionable recommendations that improve performance, efficiency, resilience, and customer outcomes.

You'll use Lean and Agile principles to identify opportunities for process improvement, reduce inefficiencies, and enhance operational performance. By supporting continuous improvement initiatives and promoting flexible, iterative ways of working, you'll help ensure work is delivered efficiently, responds effectively to changing priorities, and consistently provides value for customers and stakeholders.

You'll lead analytical investigations into emerging operational issues, support root cause analysis activities, and develop innovative solutions that help the ICC move from reactive reporting towards proactive and predictive decision-making.

In addition, you'll support and deliver continuous improvement projects from concept through to implementation, ensuring benefits are clearly measured and realised. You'll work collaboratively with stakeholders across multiple business areas, helping develop data-driven cultures and promoting best practice in reporting, automation, and business intelligence.

The successful candidate will become a key contributor to Scottish Water's growing use of data, analytics, and digital technology, helping unlock the full potential of our Data Lakehouse and supporting the delivery of strategic business objectives

What You’ll Need

We're looking for a highly analytical individual who is passionate about data and enjoys solving complex business problems through technology and insight.

You should have experience working with large datasets and a strong understanding of data analysis, reporting, and business intelligence techniques. You'll be comfortable using data to identify trends, challenge assumptions, and provide evidence-based recommendations to stakeholders at all levels.

You'll have strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience using SQL to extract, manipulate and analyse data, and Python to develop analytical solutions that deliver actionable insights. You'll be confident creating reports and dashboards in Power BI, as well as building workflows and process automations using Power Automate. A strong understanding of data management, data quality and reporting principles is essential, alongside the ability to communicate complex technical information clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

You'll have experience gathering business requirements and translating them into effective reporting and automation solutions. Experience working with Data Lakehouse, data warehousing or cloud-based data platforms would be advantageous, as would knowledge of process mapping and business process improvement methodologies. Familiarity with SharePoint and the wider Microsoft Power Platform, ISO and other operational management frameworks, and experience supporting transformation, operational improvement or digital change programmes would also be beneficial. An understanding of Lean and Agile principles, with the ability to support continuous improvement and the efficient delivery of business value, is also desirable.

Most importantly, we're looking for someone who is curious, innovative, and driven by using data and technology to solve problems and improve business performance.

Looking out for you

While the work we do is important, we know it’s not the only thing that matters. That’s why we make sure you have everything you need to find a good work-life balance.

But you’ll get plenty of time to recharge with 38 days of holiday every year (including public holidays). And you can even buy five more if you need a little extra time. You can also take paid time off to volunteer in your community.

When it comes to major life events we have family-friendly policies around adoption, maternity, and parental leave. And for the everyday? We embrace flexible working.

For your future, there’s our pension (the ‘know-what-you’ll-get-when-you-retire’ kind), as well as life assurance.

As for some nice extras? You will participate in a company bonus scheme. Not to mention access to SW Splash – handy rewards that can save you money on holidays, bills, and shopping.  

The not-so-small print

This role will be a Grade 6. If you’re new to Scottish Water, you’ll join us on a starting salary of £37,815. Performance-driven pay progression would then allow you to move through the range to a maximum of £48,395.

If you’re interested in this role – or know someone else who might be - we’ll be accepting applications until midnight
on the 29th September 2026

Please note: the successful candidate will need to undertake enhanced security checks prior to starting.

Job offers at Scottish Water are conditional, and will be confirmed on completion of our pre-employment screening, e.g. referencing, criminal record checks, license checks, etc. Screening is conducted on our behalf by a third party, and must be completed before your start date. Don’t worry - we’ll only start these checks once you’ve accepted an offer. 

A few final things worth knowing…

Research shows that some people avoid applying for jobs unless they can meet every single criteria. If you’re interested in this job, but don’t tick all the boxes, apply anyway! We hardly ever hire people who can do every part of a job from Day One. Everyone has a learning curve. So don’t rule yourself out!

Let us know if there are any changes we can make to our recruitment process to help you perform at your best. Lots of our people have disabilities or neurodiverse conditions (including some of our recruiters!). We're also aware that some people might be experiencing temporary challenges because of life events, like menopause. We’re very used to making adjustments, so please don’t be afraid to ask.

As part of our commitment to developing a flourishing Scotland, it’s important that all our employees are Scottish taxpayers. If you join us, your home address will need to be in Scotland. If you don’t already live here, you'll need to commit to moving here within your first three months.

Candidates should be aware that a valid UK driving licence is required for driving on Scottish Water business and claiming business mileage expenses.

Please note, Scottish Water takes the safety, health and wellbeing of our employees, colleagues and customers very seriously and as such you may be subject to Drug & Alcohol testing in line with our policy.

Finally (finally!), candidates who haven’t submitted an application in the last 12 months will have their records removed from our recruitment database. You won’t need to do anything. Your data will be automatically deleted.

We’re here to help. Ask us anything at SWRecruitment@ScottishWater.co.uk

Before we get to the role, here is a look at who we are and what we are building. Understanding the platform matters for this position, so we have included a short briefing below.

𝐖𝐇𝐘 𝐖𝐄'𝐑𝐄 𝐇𝐈𝐑𝐈𝐍𝐆
Job-Hopper is growing. After launching in 2026, the platform has been gaining steady traction and helping a growing number of job seekers get where they want to go. To keep that momentum, we are expanding our team and looking for a Data Analyst to help us turn a growing pool of data into sharper insight and a stronger product.

𝐖𝐇𝐀𝐓 𝐒𝐄𝐓𝐒 𝐉𝐎𝐁-𝐇𝐎𝐏𝐏𝐄𝐑 𝐀𝐏𝐀𝐑𝐓
Job-Hopper is not another job board. It is a candidate-centric platform built for one purpose: to give job seekers a real strategic advantage in their search.

To understand what makes it different, it helps to understand how the rest of the industry works. Legacy job boards are funded by employers. Their revenue comes from companies paying to post openings, so their platforms are built to serve those companies - cutting clutter and saving hiring teams time, while pushing the hard work and frustration onto the job seeker. They are free to apply on, but that is precisely the problem. Reaching the interview stage has become daunting. These boards are crowded with ghost jobs, stale postings, and outright fake listings designed to harvest applicant data.

We hear it every day. Job seekers are spending more time and energy than ever with less to show for it: hours of scrolling and applying, hundreds of submissions, and often not even a call back.

The established recruiting professionals behind Job-Hopper heard this same story from candidate after candidate. Many were strong applicants the traditional recruiting model simply could not place. That gap is what led to Job-Hopper. Development began in early 2025, the platform came to life late that year with the help of many stakeholders, and after an initial launch in 2026 it has been gaining traction and helping job seekers ever since.

𝐇𝐎𝐖 𝐉𝐎𝐁-𝐇𝐎𝐏𝐏𝐄𝐑 𝐖𝐎𝐑𝐊𝐒
Job-Hopper starts with the candidate, not the employer. When a user builds their profile, our proprietary AI engine goes to work around the clock. It scans the internet for job postings from every source and vets each one for recency, legitimacy, and quality. When a posting looks off, the engine throws it out.

Once a listing clears that filter, Job-Hopper matches the best opportunities to each user's profile in real time. Instead of scrolling through endless postings, users are notified the moment a strong match becomes available. The searching and vetting happen in the background, so the candidate can focus only on the opportunities that actually fit.

𝐓𝐇𝐄 𝐓𝐎𝐎𝐋𝐒 𝐓𝐇𝐀𝐓 𝐆𝐈𝐕𝐄 𝐂𝐀𝐍𝐃𝐈𝐃𝐀𝐓𝐄𝐒 𝐀𝐍 𝐄𝐃𝐆𝐄
Once a match is found, a user can apply in a single click, or reach for the enterprise-grade tools that set Job-Hopper apart:

- 𝐑𝐞𝐬𝐮𝐦𝐞 𝐞𝐧𝐡𝐚𝐧𝐜𝐞𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭 that tailors a candidate's resume to the specifications of each role, helping them stand out.
- 𝐀 𝐬𝐩𝐨𝐧𝐬𝐨𝐫𝐬𝐡𝐢𝐩 𝐟𝐢𝐥𝐭𝐞𝐫 that shows only roles offering H1B visa sponsorship, saving sponsorship seekers countless hours applying to jobs they were never eligible for.
- 𝐈𝐧𝐭𝐞𝐫𝐯𝐢𝐞𝐰 𝐩𝐫𝐞𝐩𝐚𝐫𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧, including mock interview questions and coaching that help candidates walk in ready.
- 𝐇𝐢𝐫𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐜𝐨𝐧𝐭𝐚𝐜𝐭 𝐢𝐧𝐬𝐢𝐠𝐡𝐭𝐬, one of our most valued features. Our AI engine identifies the actual hiring manager behind a posting and surfaces their contact details, including name, title, phone, and email. It can even draft a professional outreach email to introduce the candidate directly, skipping the pile of 200 resumes and going straight to the source.

Match quality is shown through clear percentage-based match scores, so candidates always know how well an opportunity fits before they invest their time. Job-Hopper supports job seekers across technology, manufacturing, analytics, engineering, and beyond, whether they are landing a first role, changing jobs, or advancing an established career. This is the platform we have built, and which you would help us build upon and improve to help more job seekers.

We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Senior Data Analyst to support business performance, revenue management, customer analytics, sales operations, product strategy, and executive decision-making. The position requires a combination of advanced Excel, SQL, Python, business intelligence, financial analysis, data visualization, and strong business judgment.

You will work across large and complex datasets to develop reporting, dashboards, analytical models, and actionable insights for product and leadership teams. You are comfortable working independently on ambiguous analytical problems, reconciling data from multiple sources, automating recurring processes, and communicating findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Business Intelligence & Dashboards: Design and maintain scalable, user-friendly Power BI/Looker Studio dashboards that deliver actionable visibility into product performance, sales activity, customer health, and financial KPIs for non-technical stakeholders
Process Automation & AI Integration: Streamline recurring workflows using SQL, Python, Excel/VBA, and Power Query, while exploring AI/BigQuery solutions to scale self-service analytics and reduce manual reporting dependencies

new_jobs.description:
SpaceXAI’s mission is to create AI systems that can accurately understand the universe and aid humanity in its pursuit of knowledge.  Our team is small, highly motivated, and focused on engineering excellence. This organization is for individuals who appreciate challenging themselves and thrive on curiosity. We operate with a flat organizational structure. All employees are expected to be hands-on and to contribute directly to the company’s mission. Leadership is given to those who show initiative and consistently deliver excellence. Work ethic and strong prioritization skills are important. All employees are expected to have strong communication skills. They should be able to concisely and accurately share knowledge with their teammates.
ABOUT THE ROLE:

As a member of the power generation operations team, you will apply your knowledge, experience, and creativity to turn plant data into decisions. This role supports the site director with insights that improve how the power plant runs, including generation performance, fuel use, downstream demand, maintenance planning, and environmental compliance. If you like strategic planning, juggling many different priorities, improving processes, and spending your time in a dynamic work environment, then this team may be for you. This role will report directly to the site director and serve as a resource across plant operations.  
RESPONSIBILITIES:

Create and integrate AI tools to support analytics and execution planning. Create AI agents that can aid in oversight and quickly flag the onset of an issue or outage  

Develop visual standards for work boards, JIRA queuing, Power BI dashboards, and plant operations workflow  

Define and develop plant-level metrics and dashboards that quantify operational health and influence change, including gas vs MW, hall demand vs generation, maintenance forecast, and air permit hours  

Support the site director with data insights for plant operations, outage planning, and continuous improvement  

Conduct in-depth analyses through SQL queries and other data analysis methods to dive into problems and identify trends for decision making, following the rules of clear visual indicators and linear flow  

Create reports, tools, and standardized metrics for operational measurements and improvements  

Integrate with operations, maintenance, engineering, and environmental teams to understand current workflows and identify systematic gaps  

Support department continuous improvement projects such as new process rollouts and standardization  

Develop automation that mitigates operational risk or creates efficiencies within the power plant  

Conduct operations audits that streamline plant operations, maintenance, and reliability work  

Maintenance program enhancement – increase attention on poor-health equipment and descope unnecessary work  

Implement operations or maintenance tools (software or hardware) to reduce wasted effort by engineers, operators, and technicians  

Analyze site services and plant support contracts such as utilities, waste, and related services, and roadmap improvements to ensure smart spending  

Build communication tools and reports targeted at the site director and plant leadership to improve decision-making and customer service to downstream loads  

Standardize material, spare parts, and procurement processes to reduce outage and project lead times  

Drive alignment with power generation and operations teams at other SpaceX sites to reduce duplicated work  

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

Bachelor's degree in engineering, business, supply chain, management information systems, computer science, or economics  

2+ years of experience in an operations, data analytics, consulting, production coordination, scheduling, or planning role  

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

4+ years of professional experience  

Process focused experience including project management, capacity modeling, process mapping, and layouts  

Experience with operations, maintenance, and capacity planning (including CMMS, MRP, or ERP systems)  

Experience in using Excel, VBA, SQL, or Python/R for analysis or modeling dynamic systems  

Experience with creating and managing dashboards using data visualization tools using Power BI  

Familiarity with power plant or industrial operations metrics such as heat rate / gas vs MW, generation vs demand, maintenance forecasting, and environmental or air-permit tracking  

Experience with lean, six sigma, and related operations principles  

Ability to work well across teams and skill sets to find the simplest and best solution  

Experience as a contributor to multi-disciplinary and cross-functional teams

new_jobs.description:
Overview

The Senior Business Intelligence Analyst works with all levels of the organization to turn data into clear, compelling stories that drive business decisions. This position primarily builds Power BI reports and Power Platform Power Apps using data from MFA Oil's data lakehouse, with a strong emphasis on understanding the business behind the numbers and communicating insights in a way that resonates with leadership and end users. This role also contributes to the design and building of data marts in the gold layer and partners with the business to guide the adoption of data agents and Copilot capabilities, focusing on business context and validation rather than the underlying data engineering.

MFA Oil Company is an Equal Opportunity/Drug-Free Employer.

Responsibilities

Design, build, and maintain Power BI reports and dashboards that translate complex data into clear, actionable stories for leaders and business users
Design, build, and maintain Power Apps solutions on the Power Platform, using the data lakehouse as the underlying source
Partner with business users to deeply understand their processes, priorities, and pain points, and translate that understanding into effective reporting and app solutions
Mentor and provide guidance to less experienced analysts on report design, storytelling technique, and business context
Contribute to the design and build of data marts in the gold layer, working closely with data engineering to ensure structures support reporting and storytelling needs
Test and verify the accuracy of reports, apps, and underlying data independently before delivery, using SQL and Excel as needed to validate results
Serve as a business and data domain expert in the training and implementation of data agents and Copilot capabilities, ensuring outputs are accurate and grounded in real business context
Independently evaluate AI-assisted or AI-generated outputs for accuracy, and verify results rather than relying on them at face value
Identify opportunities to improve or automate reporting processes and drive adoption of best practices across the BI function
All MFA Oil employees are expected to know and adhere to company and position specific policies and procedures. While this job description contains the primary duties of the position, employees may be expected to perform other duties as assigned.

Job Requirements

Bachelor's degree in business, information technology, statistics, or other related field; or an associate’s degree plus related experience
Five or more years of experience building reports and dashboards in Power BI, with a strong track record of data storytelling for business audiences
Demonstrated ability to develop deep business knowledge and translate it into insights that influence decisions
Strong SQL skills for querying and validating data
Experience using Excel to test, cross-check, and validate report and data accuracy
Excellent written and oral communication and presentation skills, with the ability to both solicit information from and explain data clearly to non-technical audiences
Critical thinking and problem-solving skills
Self-motivated, with the ability to manage multiple deadlines and drive work forward with minimal oversight
Ability to thrive in a fast paced, growing organization and rapidly changing environment.
Detail-oriented with the ability to consistently provide accurate, high-quality work
Ability to work both independently and in a team environment
Ability to maintain the confidentiality of sensitive information
Ability to speak, read, write, and understand the English language to communicate accurately and effectively with customers, coworkers, and supervisors.
Ability to meet Company requirements, including successful pre-employment background and check and drug test.
Legal authorization to work in the United States

Preferred Skills

Experience with Power Platform tools, including Power Apps and Power Automate
Experience working with data warehouses or Lakehouse environments (Microsoft Fabric preferred)
Familiarity with Python for light data manipulation or validation
Experience with AI tools such as Copilot or data agents, including the ability to critically evaluate and verify AI-generated output rather than relying on it to understand the business or tell the story
Experience as a functional business analyst
Ability to think outside the box and research solutions to difficult problems
Ability to set priorities and goals and develop plans for achieving them

MFA Oil Company, formed in 1929, is a farmer-owned cooperative and a leading propane retailer in the United States. The company supplies fuels, lubricants, and propane to customers in Missouri, Arkansas, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Kentucky, Oklahoma, and Tennessee. Through a subsidiary, MFA Oil operates Break Time convenience stores in Missouri; a Big O Tires franchise in Missouri, Arkansas, and Kansas; a solar panel installation company, BluSphere Energy; and APM, a wholesale fuel distributor.

Benefits

Our benefits are designed to invest in you! We offer a comprehensive benefits structure for regular full-time positions, including competitive wages, paid time off, paid company holidays, and the opportunity for eligible employees to share in company success through profit sharing and/or performance incentives. Health benefits include medical, dental, vision, an employee assistance program and company-paid life insurance, and short- and long-term disability. new_jobs.title: Research Data Analyst
new_jobs.description:
Job Description

JOB SUMMARY

The Research Data Analyst (RDA) will support the Principal Investigator in a broad scope of research-related activities taking place in the United States The RDA will plan, coordinate, and oversee data systems for research studies i.e. database set-up, data management, developing and pilot-testing questionnaires, conducting quality assurance, preparing recruitment reports, overseeing system for data queries, and monitoring study retention. The RDA will function as a liaison between site data managers/programmers for the purposes of database creation and management, and will plan and coordinate weekly or semi-weekly meetings among data staff to regulatory track progress and troubleshoot issues. This position involves working with a variety of UCSF and non-UCSF faculty and staff to complete data entry and securely transfer data to approved academic partners. Study databases will be created and maintained in the UCSF secure research environment using RED-CAP. The RDA will oversee data entry, data management and storage, develop programming to generate weekly progress and monitoring reports, conduct data management and quality assurance, and provide technical assistance to research staff related to data entry and processing. The RDA will be responsible for using standard privacy and compliance procedures for the safe handling and use of electronic medical record and public health surveillance data for research purposes. The RDA may at times be required to conduct medical record chart reviews for completion of data elements and/or to assure data integrity.

The incumbent will also develop tables, graphs, and contribute to analyses for reports and publications under the direction of the study PIs and study statistician; and perform other data management/department tasks as assigned to meet the overall data and technical needs of the program.

This position requires the RDA work in the office a minimum of 4 days/week.

ABOUT THE DIVISION OF HIV, INFECTIOUS DISEASES AND GLOBAL MEDICINE

The Division of HIV, Infectious Diseases and Global Medicine at the University of California San Francisco (UCSF) is an internationally recognized global leader in clinical care, research, and education. With its home-base located at Zuckerberg San Francisco General Hospital and Trauma Center (ZSFG), the Division has been ranked as the top facility in the country for AIDS care since 1983. The Division’s work is featured frequently in the media, and it is often visited by numerous international, national, state, and local dignitaries and delegations. The Division consists of approximately 36 faculty members, 11 fellows/postdoctoral scholars and 170 academic and staff employees. It is the largest Division of the Department of Medicine (DOM) at ZSFG, with a total expenditure budget of approximately $52 million dollars.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in related area and / or equivalent experience / training
Working knowledge of research function
Working skills in system programming, database design and data security measures
Working skills in analysis and consultation
Skills to communicate complex information in a clear and concise manner both verbally and written
Organizational skills to manage complex information
Proficient in Microsoft Excel, REDCap
Demonstrated ability to prepare tables, charts and graphs for use in publications and presentations
Demonstrated ability to interact effectively with a wide range of team members, including faculty investigators, programmers, community partners, and other data managers from diverse cultural backgrounds
Ability to communicate clearly and succinctly in spoken and written English

Preferred Qualifications

Proficient in Qualtrics and other survey and database platforms

About Us

About UCSF

The University of California, San Francisco (UCSF) is a leading university dedicated to promoting health worldwide through advanced biomedical research, graduate-level education in the life sciences and health professions, and excellence in patient care. It is the only campus in the 10-campus UC system dedicated exclusively to the health sciences. We bring together the world’s leading experts in nearly every area of health. We are home to five Nobel laureates who have advanced the understanding of cancer, neurodegenerative diseases, aging and stem cells.

Pride Values

UCSF is a diverse community made of people with many skills and talents. We seek candidates whose work experience or community service has prepared them to contribute to our commitment to professionalism, respect, integrity, diversity and excellence – also known as our PRIDE values .

In addition to our PRIDE values, UCSF is committed to equity – both in how we deliver care as well as our workforce. We are committed to building a broadly diverse community, nurturing a culture that is welcoming and supportive, and engaging diverse ideas for the provision of culturally competent education, discovery, and patient care. Additional information about UCSF is available here .

Join us to find a rewarding career contributing to improving healthcare worldwide.

Company Description

Work with Us. Change the World.

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

Job Description

As a Digital Data Analyst, you will report directly to the Data Intelligence Lead. Your primary responsibility will be to create compelling data insights tailored to client requirements. You will collaborate closely with digital and engineering teams across our regional and global organization, analysing data and presenting stories that answer key questions and promote further engagement. This role requires a data-native mindset, with the ability to think outside the box and find true value in data that others might overlook.

Key Responsibilities:

Demonstrate ability and relevant qualifications in data analytics.
Work closely with Operations and Technical leads to ensure the delivery of project deliverables and all aspects of data visualization and analytics within agreed timescales.
Apply basic knowledge and experience in extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) processes to data.
Create basic dashboards in Power BI.
Produce solutions in accordance with current best practices and company standards.
Generate basic visual outputs in Geospatial Analytics Software (GIS).
Interpret and create metrics from large datasets.
Set up relational database tables, including but not limited to SQL Server and Dataverse.
Engage with clients and present data in layman’s terms.

Qualifications

Qualifications:

1-2 years of experience in a data analyst role.
Degree and/or experience in data analytics, computer science, or other related fields.
Basic knowledge of dashboarding platforms such as Tableau, Power BI, Looker, etc.
Ability to tell a story from data from the ground up.
Ability to recognize the tangible benefits of applying data analytics to client problem statements.
Ability to learn new software and technologies quickly.
Ability to follow instructions and work in a team environment.

Preferred Skills:

Experience and knowledge of basic coding languages including Python.
Experience and knowledge of using Geospatial Analytics Software (GIS).
Microsoft accreditation for PL-300 (Power BI) or other relevant certifications.

Additional Information

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.

About AECOM

AECOM is the world’s trusted infrastructure consulting firm, delivering professional services throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. On projects spanning transportation, buildings, water, new energy and the environment, our public- and private-sector clients trust us to solve their most complex challenges. Our teams are driven by a common purpose to deliver a better world through our unrivaled technical and digital expertise, a culture of equity, diversity and inclusion, and a commitment to environmental, social and governance priorities. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm and its Professional Services business had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. See how we are delivering sustainable legacies for generations to come at aecom.com and @AECOM.

Freedom to Grow in a World of Opportunity

You will have the flexibility you need to do your best work with hybrid work options. Whether you’re working from an AECOM office, remote location or at a client site, you will be working in a dynamic environment where your integrity, entrepreneurial spirit and pioneering mindset are championed.

You will help us foster a safe and respectful workplace, where we invite everyone to bring their whole selves to work using their unique talents, backgrounds and expertise to create transformational outcomes for our clients.

AECOM provides a wide array of compensation, benefits and well-being programs to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families. We’re the world’s trusted global infrastructure firm, and we’re in this together – your growth and success are ours too.

Join us, and you’ll get all the benefits of being a part of a global, publicly traded firm – access to industry-leading technology and thinking and transformational work with big impact and work flexibility. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in each person’s potential, and we’ll help you reach yours.

We are a Disability Confident Employer and will offer an interview to applicants who have a disability or long-term condition, who meet the minimum/essential criteria for the role. Please let us know using this email address ReasonableAccommodationsUKI@aecom.com if you would like to apply through the Disability Confident Interview Scheme.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

new_jobs.title: Innovation Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

Hoe maak jij mee het verschil?

Als Innovation Project Manager is het jouw missie om innovatieve projecten te ontwikkelen en te leiden binnen de hele NMBS. Het kan daarbij gaan om zowel digitale als niet-digitale initiatieven. Je speelt een sleutelrol in het verbeteren van de ervaring van onze reizigers en van onze collega’s.

Enkele voorbeelden van gerealiseerde projecten zijn onder andere: opleidingen met virtual reality, de invoering van stiltezones op de trein, ondersteunende tools voor onze techniekers en smart AI-assistants.

Meer info op deze pagina: Het Innovation Program | NMBS.

Wat is jouw rol bij NMBS?

Als Innnovation Project Manager Heb Je Volgende Verantwoordelijkheden

Je stuurt innovatieve projecten aan op een agile en pragmatische manier, van idee-generatie tot Proof of Concept, de testfases en de eind­evaluatie. Je ondersteunt ook de overgang van POC naar de pre-industrialisatie, samen met collega’s uit de directies en IT-partners.
Je bent verantwoordelijk voor alle sleutelelementen van projectbeheer: het bepalen van de scope, de planning, risicobeheer, communicatie, testen, budget en evaluatie.
Je stemt de verschillende interne stakeholders op elkaar af en werkt samen met technische experts, externe partners en/of interne teams om end-to-end oplossingen te ontwerpen, te testen en te integreren.
Je verkent actief opkomende technologieën, trends en innovatiemethodologieën, met een sterke focus op artificiële intelligentie en datagedreven oplossingen.
Je identificeert kansen om de klantervaring te verbeteren of de interne efficiëntie te verhogen en vertaalt deze naar concrete, haalbare initiatieven.
Je neemt deel aan de organisatie van evenementen, waaronder het faciliteren van workshops, idee-sessies en presentaties.

Waarom is deze job iets voor jou?

Je beschikt over een masterdiploma (of gelijkwaardig door ervaring) EN hebt minstens 5 jaar ervaring in project management, bij voorkeur binnen innovatie of digitale transformatie.

EN Je Beschikt Over De Volgende Vaardigheden

Je hebt een sterke beheersing van de principes en tools van projectmanagement.
Je beschikt over een uitgesproken can-do-mentaliteit, die je actief uitdraagt. Daardoor neem je spontaan initiatief en weet je obstakels weg te nemen om de voortgang van projecten te garanderen.
Je hebt een functioneel en strategisch inzicht in digitale technologieën en artificiële intelligentie.
Je communiceert vlot, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk, in het Nederlands, en je hebt een goede kennis van het Frans en het Engels. Dankzij je communicatiestijl kan je stakeholders overtuigen, aligneren en inspireren.
Je bent creatief en denkt graag out of the box.
Je hebt een uitgesproken interesse voor innovatie en voor de uitdagingen die verbonden zijn aan openbaar vervoer.

Indien je jouw diploma in het buitenland hebt behaald, dien je in het bezit te zijn van een gelijkwaardigheidsattest afgeleverd door de Vlaamse Overheid (NARIC-Vlaanderen) om deel te kunnen nemen aan de selectie.

We vinden het dan ook belangrijk dat je jezelf kan zijn. Want dat maakt NMBS sterker. Daarom hechten we veel belang aan diversiteit en inclusie.

Wat mag je van ons verwachten?

Kiezen Voor NMBS Is Kiezen Voor Een Omgeving Waarin Je Kan Bijleren En Groeien. Je Wordt Gesteund En Omringd Door Fijne Collega's. Als Innovation Project Manager Krijg Je Een Loonpakket Dat Bestaat Uit

Een aantrekkelijk salaris aangevuld met een 13e maand, onkostenvergoeding, maaltijdcheques en een collectieve en individuele bonus.
Een deel van het salaris wordt aangeboden als een flexibel budget. Je kan daarbij kiezen voor fietslease, lease auto, terugbetaling pensioensparen, ...
Een hospitalisatie- en groepsverzekering.
Flexibele werkuren, de mogelijkheid om te telewerken en 33 vakantiedagen per jaar.
Een treinabonnement in België, kortingen op internationale treinreizen en een fietsvergoeding.
Voordelen voor je gezin: o.a. kortingen op gezinsactiviteiten en in winkelketens.

Waar ga je werken?

Je werkt in de buurt van het station Brussel-Zuid, in de gebouwen Atrium en Innovation lab.

What’s next?

Je solliciteert online.
We screenen je CV en motivatiebrief. We bellen je eventueel op om kennis te maken.
We nodigen je uit voor een eerst (online) sollicitatiegesprek waarin je je motivatie en competenties kan tonen. Ter voorbereiding op dit gesprek vragen we jou om een online persoonlijkheidsvragenlijst in te vullen.
Je legt een business case af waarover je daarna uitleg geeft.
Je start in je nieuwe job!

Wij behouden ons het recht om deze procedure aan te passen of op te schorten indien nodig. Ons rekruteringsteam zal de profielen selecteren die het best aansluiten bij de functie-eisen om een optimale match te garanderen.

Heb je nog vragen?
